ye shes kyi sku la skye 'chi med pas/ de dag gis spru sku gzhan bzung nas bstan pas so zhe na/ 'bro lugs la'ang legs par mtshungs pas phyin ci log gi grub mtha' rnams sub par rigs so/ / gnyis pa bod du ji ltar byon tshul la'ang*/ rwa 'bro gnyis las/ dang po rwa lugs kyi lo rgyus ni/ snye nam snang yul du 'khrungs pa rwa rdo rje grags kyi sras po rwa chos rab kyi yab kyi chos rnams legs par thugs su chud de/ dus 'khor don du gnyer nas bal po mthil du byon| paṇa chen sa man+ta shrī lo lnga zla ba brgyad zhag lnga bar ma chad par bsten/ dbang bshad man ngag bum pa gang byo gnang*/ bod du gdan drangs nas bsgyur bshad gtan la phab nas gser srang brgya phul/ skyel ma yang skyid grong bar du byas pas paṇ+ḍi ta dgyes te/ paṇa chen 'bum phrag gsum pa'i prog zhu/ chags lham| rdo dril dus 'khor lugs kyi phyag tshad ma dang bcas pa gnang ngo*/ /rwa chos rab des nub mda' rdo can du bzhugs so/ /de'i sras rwa ye shes seng ge de'i sras rwa 'bum seng rnams kyis kyang rim par bum pa gang byor mkhyen no/ de la rong pa rga los zhus te/ 'di ni bod chos rgyal gyi dus su rgya nag nas hwa shang spyan drangs zla la mi nag hwa shang gcig yongs pa rgyal po'i mchod gnas su gyur pa nas gzung ste/ sngags 'chang bar ma chad pa'i rgyud pa la ya 'brog sgang du mi nyag gzhon nu snying po zhes bya ba byung*/ de'i sras gzhon nu seng ge de'i sras rig 'dzin snying po/ des rong gi rgya ma kha bzung*/ de'i sras rdo rje seng ges rong mkhar phug bzung*/ de'i sras rje btsun rga lo yin te/ mtshon ldan la rten nas sngon gyi khams pa rga lo'i skye bar yab kyis dgongs nas mtshan du'ang de ka btags| dgung lo gsum tsam gyi dus su kha che paṇa chen ngur smrig tu byon pa'i drung du yum ma gcig skyid mos bsnams nas byin rlabs zhus pas*/

dbu la phyag gis bzhams saṃ skṛ ta'i skad du/ dbugs dbyung byin gyis brlabs pas skyes bo kun gyis byin gyis brlabs skyes bu dam par 'gyur bar thag bcad do// yab kyi drung du mngon pa dang mdo sde dang man ngag mang du gsan/ dpyal chos bzang gi drung du rgya klog dang rgya yig dang saṃ skṛ ta'i skad dang*/ khyad par dgyes phag gnyis la sbyangs/ dgung lo drug pa la ngur smrig tu bshad par mdzad nas dgyes phag gsungs/ gzhan yang nā ro 'grel chen dang*/ bde mchog gzhung 'grel man ngag dang bcas pa gsan/ bde mchog gi gzhung zhu dus su dkyil 'khor gyi dbus nas ngo mtshar ba'i sgra thos/ shangs khrag zags shing zags par rmis nas sdig sgrib dag lus bde shes rab gsal bar gyur/ khyad par gshed dmar gyi dbang zhu dus bdud kyi bar chad las thar te 'di ltar/ dang po ngur smrig tu btsun pa lham mthil rdol gyi khres po khur ba zhig byung nas ngas 'di tsam zad zad du btsal bas de da rnyed pas a re dga' zer zhing phan pa mang du sgrub par byed/ phyis 'dul chung du bsnyung ba'i dus su/ 'gron btsun rgya dpe skod rtse gang khur ba gcig gis khyod mkhas na 'di rnams kyi don shod zer shing*/ dpe ris shad shud byed/ yi ge la ni ma bsten par/ dam pa'i don ni rtogs mi 'gyur| |zhes sogs zer/ de rjes yab kyi drung du byon pas mdang 'byung po'i chos 'phrul mang ba la de ring dge bshes byon pas de'i phan pa la yid ma gtod par thugs dam la 'bungs shig gsung ba bzhin du lha'i sgom bzlas drag tu mdzad pa dang*/ 'thab pa dang bgrang ba sogs mdzad kyang*/ de yi mi zhum par res 'ga' ni dge bshes gyi tshul du 'chos/ yun ring nas grogs su gyur pas skye ba 'di dang 'dir yang phan pa 'di dang 'di lta bu byas so zhes skye rgyud sna tshogs gleng*/ res 'ga' ni mkhas pa chen po ltar 'chos/ res 'ga' ni grub thob chen po ltar 'chos te/

kho bo'i gtsug lag khang 'di lta bu'o zhes sogs dang*| kho bo'i gzhung lugs ni 'di lta bu'o zhes sogs dang*/ kho bo'i rigs sngags ni 'di lta bu'o zhes sogs ston no/ /re 'ga' ni bya se mo chen po mi skad 'don pa'i gzugs su byas te/ tho rangs gshog pa bsdebs shing*/ zla 'od gzhon nu/ seng ge rgyal mtshan/ 'od kyi snye ma zhes 'bod cing yar longs shig gzhung shod cig lta rtog dang thugs dam mdzod cig ces chos la bskul ba ltar 'chos pa las/ thar par byon gshed dmar gyi dbang zhu bar brtsams pa na/ da ni yul du 'gro bar rigs so/ /yab yum la sogs pa na'o/ /dbang bskur ni phyis zhu bar rigs so zhes zer ro/ /phyis dka' bas da lan zhu'o zhes smras pa na| ngas de tsam du khyod la bsams nas khyod 'di ltar byed pa mi rigs pas da lta 'deng zhes smra zhing 'brang dang khres po rdeg par byed do/ /de ltar zer yang ma nyan pa na/ khres po skas 'og tu bskyur/ yun ring 'grogs pa'i grogs pos bslus so/ khyod nyid ci bder gyis shig

nga 'gro bas khyod kyis skyel thung gyis shig zer ba la thar pa'i mo dben sgang bar bskyal bas/ de na 'dug pa'i rta la zhon nam mkha' la 'phags/ rta de seng ger bsgyur/ dpon gu ru ces bya ba'i rnam pas lag pa g.yas pas 'gram pa skyor te glu len zhing la rgan la mgo ye re re rgal nas song ste de phyin chad bdud kyis ma tshugs so/ /gzhan yang chos rje sa paṇa/ lce ston mdo sde seng ge bi bhū ti tsan+d+ra/ khro phu lo tsā ba byams pa dpal la sogs pa bla ma mang po la zab rgyas kyi chos dpag med gsan/ rten dkar po yin kyang sngags mtshan nyid du ma la sbyangs te/ 'dis mdzad pa'i dbu tshad kyi bsdus chen sogs kyang yod do/ khyad par du 'jam gsar shes rab 'od zer la mdo sngags mang po dang dus 'khor 'bro lugs kyi dbang bshad man ngag thams cad rdzogs par nos/ bla ma rwa 'bum seng yun ring du brten nas dus 'khor rwa lugs kyi dbang bshad man ngag thams cad rdzogs par nos te rwa 'bro gcig tu 'dril ba'i zhal so yod do/ /gzhan yang 'di nyid kyi sku'i sras rgya gar grags dang slob ma gzhon nu rgyal mtshan gnyis byis pa chung ngur yod pa hor dmag gis khyer ba la sgrol ma btson 'don gyi cho ga mdzad pas/ sgrol ma'i sku nam mkha'i khyon tsam gyi lte khung na bu chung gnyis po mgo rug ge 'dug pa gzigs/ zhag gsum tsam nas khong gnyis thar/ snar bu'i dgon pa mdzo sgang na bza' mi gnyis la bu lo drug lon kyang lkugs shing 'gro mi shes pa gcig yod pa la byin rlabs mdzad/ gos brjes/ ming btags pas de ma thag 'gro ba dang smra ba shes par mdzad cing*/ gzhan yang lkugs 'phye mang po la de ltar mdzad/ thar pa na ston pa gzhon brtson zhes bya ba rma 'bras kyi rnag khrag zags pas glo snying phyi rol nas mthong ba gcig yod pa la ston pa rwa rtser ming btags nas/ ston pa gzhon brtson ston pa rwa rtse red/

/ston pa rwa rtses mi khar re tho bsad/ /ces pa sgo gong la bris pas de ma thag gsos pa dang*/ de bzhin du so na ba la thab kyi ser kha bsubs pa dang*/ klad pa gzer ba la sgo'i gzer phyung pas dang*/ bu med bu ma thon pa la thad ka'i gyeng la bug pa phug nas phan pa dang*/ smyo ba bsangs pa sogs snang ba la dbang bsgyur zhing rten 'brel la mnga' brnyes pa'i lo rgyus mtha' yas pa yod la/ rgo dkar la la byon pa'i tshe jag pa la lta stangs sdigs 'dzub mdzad pa tsam gyis bros pa la sogs pa grub pa'i mtshan ma yang bsam gyis mi khyab cing*/ khyad par du dus 'khor gyi bshad pa yun ring du mdzad nas slob ma mkhas par gyur pa nyid kyi sku'i sras rnams dang*/ sku de nyid po ta lar gshegs pa'i man lung gu ru dang*/ lho pa grub seng*/ la stod chos ldan/ dbus pa tshul dar/ thang stod lo tsā ba la sogs pa dus 'khor la mkhas pa'i mchog tu grags pa mang po dang*/ 'phags pa dang khro phu rin po che la sogs pa skyes bu dam pa'i slob ma mang po smin grol la bkod nas dgung lo brgyad cu bzhes pa chu pho rta'i lo cho 'phrul chen po'i yar ngo'i tshes gsum gyi snga dro ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas te gshegs so/ /de la sras bzhi byung ba'i che ba brgya grags rab tu byung ba'i mtshan nam mkha' dpal bas dus 'khor la sogs yab kyi chos ma lus pa mkhyen/ dben dmar gyi gdan sa bzung*/ gtsug lag khang du rten gsum mang po bzhengs/ chos kyi bya ba rgya cher mdzad nas/ sras gcig bla ma shes rab seng ge gzhon nu nas dus 'khor sogs yab kyi chos rnams mkhyen| dgung lo bcu drug pa la dus 'khor 'grel chen gsungs/ nyi shu pa la thar par byon/ dpyal pa'i chos rnams zhus/ nyer gnyis pa la stag sde seng rgyal la phar tshad mngon gsum gsan/ khyad par tshad ma la mkhas par gyur te grwa skor mdzad/ sum cu pa la 'gro mgon 'phags pa dang 'chims nam mkha' grags la rab byung bsnyen rdzogs mdzad chos mang du zhus/

lo tsā ba grags rgyal gdan drangs nas phreng ba skor gsum la sogs pa mang du gsan/ dben dmar gyi gdan sa bzung nas dus 'khor gyi bshad pa yun ring du mdzad/ gzhan yang thar pa/ khro phu/ bsam yas/ stag lung/ gzhu kun dga' ra ba/ shang rtse gdong*/ skyo mo lung*/ dbus dga' ldan la sogs pa rnams su dus 'khor gyi bshad pa rgya cher mdzad/ dgung lo zhe gcig pa la dben dmar gyi gdan sa bla ma rdo rje rgyal mtshan la btad nas mu la shaṃ 'bar gyi dgon pa btab ste/ gtsug lag khang dang gsung rab mang du bzhengs/ dus 'khor gyi bshad pa yun ring du mdzad pas ti shrī kun blo sku mched la sogs pa mi che ba'i slob ma du ma dang lo tsā ba yar thar dpang gsum la sogs pa mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi slob ma dang*/ khyad par dus 'khor la mkhas pa mang du byung*/ dgung lo drug cu rtsa lnga pa yos bu'i lo la sku gshegs te/ lugs 'di'i bshad bka'ang rga lo yab sras gnyis shin tu bka' drin che'o/ /sras gcig slob dpon rnal 'byor gyi yul 'khor bskyangs/ sras gcig bla ma a ka ra sidhi'i dus 'khor rwa 'bro sogs yab kyi chos phal che ba mkhyen/ de'i sras bla ma rdo rje rgyal mtshan chu mo lug gi lo la 'khrungs/ gzhon nu nas rgya bod kyi yig klog du ma mkhyen/ dus 'khor la sbyangs nas dgung lo bcu drug la rgyud 'grel gsungs/ sa skya'i shar pa 'jam dbyangs rin rgyal dang slob dpon shes rab rgyal la mkhan slob zhus/ dge tshul mdzad/ dgung lo drug cu nas dben dmar gyi gdan sa bzung ste/ dus 'khor gyi bshad grwa bskyangs/ bka' bzhi pa grags pa gzhon nu dang zhal snga mkhan po las bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad/ thar lo la sgra dang mngon pa gsang sngags mang du gsan/ khyad par bla ma sher seng la dus 'khor gyi gtso byas dbang bshad man ngag bum pa gang byo gsan/ dus 'khor la mi bde ba gang byung zhu yig tu bskur ba dang*/ dris lan gyi sgo nas kyang dus phyis kyi bar du gtan la phab nas shin tu mkhas par gyur to/

/gzhan yang bla ma mang du bsten mdo sngags du ma la mkhas/ bla ma shes rab seng ge gshegs nas shang 'bar dang gnyis ka bzung*/ dus 'khor gyi bshad nyan yun ring du mdzad/ de nas hor rgyal pos gdan drangs te rgya yul du byon/ 'gro don rgya cher mdzad/ glang lo la rgya yul du sku gshegs/ de la bu ston chos kyi rgyal pos gsan/ 'di ni gangs ri'i khrod du byung ba'i bstan 'dzin gcig la mkhyen brtse phrin las bstan pa la bya ba byas tshul/ ches mchog tu gyur par kun la grags shing rnam thar zhib par zur du blta'o/ / gnyis pa 'bro'i rgyud pa ni/ kha che zla mgon bod du byon/ kha rag gnyos yon tan grags la babs/ rgyud 'grel bsgyur ba dang gser srang brgya 'bul bar chad pa las/ phyed tsam 'gyur bas na paṇ+ḍi ta bros/ 'gyur byed 'phro bsnams te/ phan yul grab tu byon/ zhang po chung bas bteg 'bro lo tsā ba shes rab grags bos te/ rgyud 'grel rdzogs par bsgyur/ de kha rag gnyos kyis thos te/ zhang la yi ge bskur/ khyod kyis nga'i bla ma phrogs pa yin pas/ sba ba'i gseb tu yung kar tsheng nge ba zhig dgos na ma gtogs bla ma skyol zer ba byas pas/ zhang na re nga lha mo brgyas 'dzum bstan kyang mi chags/ khro bo brgyas mche ba gtsigs kyang mi 'jigs pa yin zer nas ma bskyal ba yun ring du zhabs tog byas/ gser srang bco brgyad phul/ gzhan yang gnyos ston ye shes mchog gis gser srang bco brgyad phul/ grwa pa mngon shes kyis lo gsum chos ston drangs/ mjal res kyi phyag rten ma chags par byas/ jo btsun tshul rin gyis gser srang drug phul/ g.yo ru ba mgar ston/ mang yul ba ston ma sri thar/ smon 'gro ba 'jam sgom la sogs pas kyang zhabs tog yun ring du byas kyang sor sdud tsam las ma gnang*/ 'phan yul grab tu sku 'khrungs pa'i sgom pa dkon mchog srungs zhes bya ba mngon pa dang sa sde dang sman spyad la shin tu mkhas shing yon tan che bar grags pa des yo byad thams cad bsdus pas gser srang drug byung ba dang bdag nyid kyi skye ba la dar yug btags nas phul/

zhabs tog yun ring du mdzad de/ ji ltar gsung ba bzhin sgrubs pas shin tu dgyes nas sems 'grel bskor gsum gzhung gdams ngag dang bcas pa ma lus par gnang ngo/ /bla ma 'di'i phyi rten ring srel mang po 'byung ba zhig 'phan yul rag ma'i nang na dus phyis kyi bar du yod ces zer la/ nang na phyag dpe dang rgyan drug sogs bzhugs pa'i phyi rten che ba gcig grab na bzhugs pa dus phyis zhig nas nang bzhugs rnams 'thor bar grags so/ de la sgro ston gnam la rtsegs zhes bya bas gsan/ 'di 'phan yul sgro rigs su 'khrungs/ dgung lo nyer drug pa la/ sbu sde'i dge bshes lo ro'i drung du g.yu che chung 'dres pa phul gang rgyags su khyer nas byon te dgung lo nga brgyad pa'i bar du slob gnyer rgya cher mdzad pa na/ lo ro ba'i gsung gis 'chims na sngags pa chen po gcig yod pa 'di rdo rje 'dzin pa dang 'dra/ nga ba lang dang 'dra bar yod pa la dus phyis ngas kyang lo tsā ba chen po lang shākya brtson 'grus| 'brog mi shākya ye shes/ 'gos khug pa lhas btsas rnams la thug pas rdo rje 'dzin pa dang 'dra bar song ste/ dus 'khor shes pa gcig dang thug na/ da dung ba lang dang 'dra bar 'dug gsungs pas bla ma gnam la rtsegs dus 'khor la shin tu dad par gyur te/ sus shes dris pas paṇ+ḍi ta so ma nā thas mkhyen zer nas de ma thag byon te/ gser srang bcu gnyis dang rta nag po gcig phul zhabs tog yun ring du byas kyang sor spor tsam las ma gnang*/ sgom pa la gser srang nyung shas gcig phul nas zhus kyang paṇ+ḍi ta'i bka' rgya yod gsung nas ma gnang*| paṇ+ḍi ta bal po snga ris su byon ring la/ snor bzangs su lo gsum dang yer par lo gsum bsgom pa la mgo bteg byas nas zhus pas yongs su rdzogs par gnang*/ paṇ+ḍi ta phebs pa dang gzhan rnams kyis bsgoms pas sgro ston la chos thams cad byin no zhus pas/ sgro ston la/

paṇ+ḍi tas da shog chos sbyin gyis gsungs pa na/ gzhon dus ni ma gnang*/ nga rgas pas mi zhu zhus pas/ kho dkon mchog srungs kyi chos kyis ngom 'dug ste/ de nga las ma byung na su las byung gsung nas phyag phab/ bla ma chen po'i bka' drin legs mod zhus pas gang gang byin gsung*/ 'di dang 'di thob zhus pas/ nga la'ang de las med/ da gzhan la ster ri'i mna' skyol gsung nas phyag phreng ske la bcug pa na bla mas ni ma gnang*/ sgom pa la zhus lags mod zhus pas ngan pa 'di gsung nas dbu la bye ma btab/ da chud ma gsan gsung*/ de gsum mi 'tshal zhus/ mdor na des paṇ+ḍi ta dang sgom pa gnyis ka la rdzogs par zhus nyams rtogs phul du byung ba brnyes so/ /'di'i phyi rten mchod rten khang bu rtsegs pa zhig 'phan yul sgro ris kyi gnas khang zhes bya ba na bzhugs pa zhig nas sa 'bum rtsi ru gyur pa'i gseb nas ring srel brgya phrag du ma nar mar 'byung ba yod pa/ bar skabs su dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'ga' zhig gis sāts+tsha btab nang du bzhugs pa'i mchod rten khang rtsegs ma byas pa yod do zhes grags so/ /de la yu mos zhus/ de ni gangs ti se'i 'gram du 'khrungs pa'i 'brog pa yin te/ rngam khro bo zhes bya ba la sras bzhi 'khrungs pa'i chung shos yin/ dgung lo bcu tsam la la stod lho ru byon/ lho mcher gnas su mkhan po stag lo gzhon byang la rab tu byung bas/ khyed rus pa rngam yin pa/ dad pa shin tu che ba zhig 'dug pas/ rngam btsun dad pa rgyal po zhes ming 'dogs so gsung nas btags/ lo gnyis mkhan po'i drung du chos gsan| de nas don ma rir byon te/ se ston sgra gcan dang*/ dge gnas su bar ston thos pa dga' la phar mngon gsan/ de'i tshe yu mo zhes mtshan yang rang nyid kyis btags/ de nas dba' dge mthong dang snyegs la dbu tshad gsan/ de nas lhan pa sor sog po tshul khrims bla ma la 'dul ba dang spyod phyogs dang gsang sngags 'ga' yang gsan/

'dul ba legs par mkhyen nas mdo rtsa rdzogs par thugs la gsungs/ de dus grogs po gcig gis khyed dgun 'di ci byed zer ba la/ gsang sngags kyi dpe 'dra 'bri byas pas/ kho na re cha lag tshang na rdo rje snying pos mdzad pa'i kyai rdor gyi 'grel pa 'dug zer ba mi 'bri'am/ zhes thos pa na/ sngon gyi bag chags kyis 'brel pa'i mtshan thos pas ba spu g.yos| de nas dpe g.yar bar btang nas bris/ gzigs pas dad pa dpag med 'khrungs/ 'di shes pa su yod dris pas so ma nā thas shes zer ba la sngon gyi mi gcig ka yin yong snyam ste rtsad ma bcad/ de nas dbus su byon/ khams pa ste'u pa la spyod phyogs nyan dus/ paṇ+ḍi ta zla mgon skar chung na bzhugs pa gsan/ sngar gyi gtam dran te des rdo rje snying 'grel mkhyen nam byas pas slob dpon na re/ der ma zad sems 'grel bskor gsum/ khyad par dus 'khor cha lag dang bcas pa la mkhas par grags gsungs/ zhus na gnang ngam byas pas/ spyir mtha' dog ste da lta bal yul du 'byon par chas pa la/ zhabs tog pa ma rnyed pa 'dug zer bas zhabs tog pa la 'gro nus na gnang ngo gsung*/ der spro ba chen pos mjal du byon/ sum pa rdo rje gzhon nu la zhus sna bcol te phyin pa na/ paṇ+ḍi ta dang sgro ston kyai+i rdo rje'i rtsa sngags dang yig brgya la zhus dag mdzad cing bzhugs pa dang thugachos 'brel zhus pas sngags de gnyis la bshad pa mdzad/ chang gsol 'phro dkar yol gang gnang ba ma 'thungs pas gzhan gyis 'cha' ba dang phyis kha chag byung*/ paṇ+ḍi ta gser thig po dang*/ gla rtsi'i rkyal pa mang po bstan pa 'di rnams bal yul bar du 'khur nus shing mgo thon na bod du 'ongs nas chos gang dgos sbyin no gsung ba la de ltar khas blangs| sgom pa tshul grags la dpe cha bcol yod pa len du byon/ rgyu mtshan bsnyad pas/ paṇ+ḍi ta la sngar yang mang pos chos ma khugs pa cig yin/ chos thams cad nged kyi bla ma rnor bzangs pa la yod pas der zhus pa mi 'thad dam byas pas blo 'gyur te kho la zhus sna bcol/

gser zho 'ga' dang dung chos legs pa gcig dang*/ ka pā li gcig rnams phul te zhus pas bla ma mnyes te/ khyed kyi 'bul ba 'di rnams kyang la nye bzang*/ sog 'dul ba 'dzin pa de gang zag khyad par can gcig yod 'dug pa/ khyed de'i thugs zin pa gcig yin zer bas khyed la yon tan gcig yod pa yin te gsungs nas chos gnang bar zhal gyis bzhes/ bla ma dgung lo bdun cu rtsa gnyis pa dang mjal/ lo bzhi bar ma chad du rten/ 'grel pa bskor gsum bshad pa man ngag dang bcas pa dang*| mtshan brjod man ngag gi bshad pa dang*/ gsang 'dus sgron gsal la sogs pa gnang ba'i dus su bsnyung ba bag re byung na'ang gtsang ston 'di la chos ma tshar gyi bar du nga ma gsod cig gsung nas chos skyong la gtor ma btang chos thams cad rdzogs par gnang ngo*/ /de nas dgung lo lnga bcu pa la 'u yug tu byon| nub ma'i mda' rgyal khab ces bya bar gzhi phab/ phu ru dben gnas gcig mdzad/ gag tshangs phu'i brag khung du yang bsgrub pa mdzad pas grub pa thob ste/ dbang khrid skor gsum gyi bshad pa dang bcas pa mang du mdzad/ gsal sgron dang gces btus la sogs bstan bcos kyang mang du brtsams/ mngon shes thogs med mnga'/ rang gi slob ma wa brag dkar ba'i brag khung 'gag tu skya kha ru sprul nas skad sna tshogs ston pas/ des kyang ngo shes nas bla ma rin po che bdag la de 'dra'i kyal ka mi mdzad par ces zhus so/ /rdzu 'phrul la dbang 'byor yon tan dpag med brnyes nas dgung lo brgyad cu'i bar du bzhugs te dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang bshad man ngag gi srol rgya cher dar bar mdzad do/ /des dgung lo lnga bcu nga lnga pa la rigs kyi sras bskrun pa'i cho ga mdzad pas yum gyi rdul stobs su gyur nas sras mo gcig 'khrungs pa ni ma gcig sprul sku jo 'bum du grags te/ lung rtogs dpag med mnga'/ 'grel chen thugs la rdzogs par gsung ba bod du 'di las ma byung bar grags//

de rjes sras gcig 'khrungs pa dharme shwa ra zhes grags/ chung ngu nas rgya bod kyi klog yig mkhyen/ dgung lo bcu gnyis pa la dbang mdor bstan gsungs/ bcu drug pa nas 'grel chen gyi thog drangs sems 'grel mtha' dag gsungs/ gzhan yang spyod phyogs dang*/ dbu tshad dang*/ lam rim dang*/ sngags kyi rgyud dang sgrub thabs mang po sogs la dgung lo sum cu'i bar du slob gnyer mdzad/ mkhas par sbyangs te gzhan phan rgya cher mdzad do/ /de la sras nam mkha' rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba/ la stod gtsang gi 'u lung gi dgon pa se mo che zhes bya bar bzhugs/ grub pa thob pas grub thob se mo che zhes grags/ yab la dus 'khor sems 'grel gsum gyi dbang bshad man ngag rdzogs par gsan/ sprul sku jo 'bum la yang 'grel chung pad+ma can dang sgrub thabs man ngag phran tshegs mang du gsan/ yab kyi bu chen khang gsar ba nam mkha' 'od zer la yang yab kyi chos 'ga' yar gsan/ bla ma 'di ni ting nge 'dzin la mnga' mnyes dus gsum lung ston pa lkog gyur gyi don hor bod du 'byung tshul sogs gsungs pa rnams ji ltar lung bstan pa bzhin byung bar grags so/ /rang gi skye ba du ma dran pa rnams ras bris la bkod pa yod par byed do/ /de la chos rje 'jam gsar gyis gsan/ de ni mtshan nyid phyogs la shin tu mkhas phar tshad kyi ṭik+ka khyad par can yod/ 'chad nyan bstan pa'i bya ba rgya cher mdzad/ 'jam dbyangs kyi zhal gzigs/ bdag rjes 'dzin gyi bla ma dang gdams ngag dang gnas la sogs pa ga na yod zhus/ grod chung du bla ma grub thob la dus 'khor zhus/ des lam bgrod par 'gyur zhes lung bstan/ dge bshes khyung la de'i gtam dris nas sos ka gcig gshegs par bzhed pa'i nub mo nam gung la nag phyogs mi ma yin gyi dmag tshogs cher 'dus te/ cho 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa ston du byung ba na/ dngos grub ster ba'i yi dam dang*/ /gnod par sems pa'i 'dre gdon gnyis/

/mi bdag la ro mnyam khyad par med/ /ces sogs mgur ma bzhengs pa chos thams cad du ma ro gcig gi don thugs la chud pas dngos grub thams cad zhi/ g.yas ru grod chung du byon dus gtsang po'i gzhung la byon pas/ nam mkha' thams cad sangs rgyas byang sems kyi gang ba gzigs/ bla ma grub thob dang mjal ma thag phyag rdor gzigs/ snang ba 'gyur ba'i mos gus skyes/ chog dbang zhus te sbyor drug gi khrid btab nas bsgoms pas zhag gnyis la sor bsam gyi rtags thams cad rdzogs/ yid ches gsum ldan gyi don mngon du gyur|

de nas legs par bsgom pa srog 'dzin la dbang thob/ yon tan dpag med mnga'/ des kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer la dus 'khor gyi dbang gnang dus rdo rje shugs su dngos su gzigs nas de ltar mthong lags zhus pas/ nga rang gi snang tshul dang mtshungs par byung 'dug 'u cag dpon slob la bgegs kyis mi tshugs gsung ba sogs zhib par dgos kyi rnam thar yod par 'dug pas der blta'o/ /sku gshegs dus nga 'di nas lan gcig bde ba can du 'gro/ zhing sbyong*/ sems can smin par byed gsung nas/ nyang stod kyang 'dur du sku gshegs so/ /de la rong pa rga los kyang rdzogs par gsan/ kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer gyis kyang rdzogs par gsan de la kun mkhyen 'phags 'od kyis gsan| de la bu ston chos rjes gsan/ de la chos rje bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis gsan/ de la chos rje lo chen skyabs mchog dpal bzang pos gsan| de la bdag gi rtsa ba'i bla ma sems dpa' chen po nam mkha' 'od zer bas rdzogs par gsan/ de'i drung du bdag gi dus kyi 'khor lo'i zur bka' ma gtogs dbang bshad man ngag mtha' dag tshang ma rdzogs par thob bo/ /yang bu ston rin po che la/ nyang stod gong gsum bde chen pa chos kyi dpal ba zhes pa mtshan nyid la'ang legs par sbyangs pa zhig phyis dusa'akhor nyid la dril nas gzhan du'ang bslabs/ phyis bu ston rin po che la rgyud 'grel tshar bcu bdun gsan nas legs par sbyangs shing*/ dus 'khor rang las mkhas pa'i bu chen du byed| de la bdag gi rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che bsod nams 'phel zhes bya ba/ zhwa lu na mkhas pa'i mchog tu grags pa des lo bcu gsum dus 'khor la dril nas gsan legs par sbyangs/ phyis the tshom cung zad 'khrungs na'ang*/ rnal lam du byon nas/ sngar sor dpon slob kyi dpyad pa mdzad pa bsnyel ba zhig yin na bka' skyon cung zad dang bcas te gsungs pa dang*/ de ma yin pa la mnyes bzhin du rgyu mtshan dang bcas te gsung zhes dngos las thos la gzhan yang mdo sngags mtha' dag la mkhas shing*/

'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi cha la mgran zla dang bral/ khyad par ting nge 'dzin gyi nyams rtogs sku'i cha byad dang bkod pa la yang dpag par nus pa dang*/ lkog gyur mngon sum du mkhyen pa'i gsung bgros thol byung du 'byon pa sogs lung rtogs mtha' yas pa la mnga' 'byor pa de'i drung du kho bos dbang bshad man ngag lag len sa ris sogs zhwa lu pa'i lugs kyi yi ge na gcig ma lus pa rdzogs par thob pa yang dgyes bzhin du legs par bstsal/ bstan pa spyi dgos kyi gnyer kha gtad pa yin no// de ltar na sangs rgyas nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du dbang bshad kyi rgyun ma chad/ dam tshig gi sel ma zhugs/ man ngag gi snyan rgyud ma chad pa yin no/ /de ltar na lugs 'di gangs ri'i khrod du dbang bshad man ngag gi sgo nas legs par spel ba'i rgyud kyi gtso bo rwa 'bro gnyis yin la/ gzhan yang*/ gyi jo zla ba'i 'od zer gyi dus zhabs pa'i slob ma shrī bha dra bo dhi la mnyan nas rgyud 'grel la gzhi 'gyur byas/ lo chung rnams la sogs pa la bshad pa yun ring du mdzad/ lo chung rnams kyis kyang rgyud 'grel dum bur bgos nas bsgyur ba la dus 'khor 'gyur mang du grags mod kyi mtshams zhig nas de dag gis bshad rgyun chad par byed do/ /dā na shrī'i slob ma dma' dge ba'i blo gros kyis kyang gyi jo 'gyur gyi steng nas 'gyur bcos byas/ mang 'or byang chub shes rab dang*/ blo gros snying po dang*/ bsod nams ye shes dang*/ 'a zha rgya gar brtsegs rnams kyis kyang 'gyur bcos dang bshad pa byas kyang bshad rgyun tshugs pa ma byung ngo*/ /tsa mi sangs rgyas grags ni/ kha cig nyang stod smad mtshams kyi 'khris rtsa kha ba yin zer| kha cig e rong gi rtsa pa yin zer ba ni/ kho rang gis mdzad pa'i rgyud 'grel gyi 'gyur byang du/ byang phyogs mi nyag yul du skyes par bshad pa dang 'gal bas mi nyag yin la/ gzhon nu dus nas rgya gar du byon/

yun ring du bzhugs| mkhas par sbyangs/ rdo rje gdan gyi gdan sa mdzad/ dus 'khor rgyud 'grel bsgyur cing bshad/ de'i slob ma ding ri chos grags/ a bha ya'i slob ma/ khe gad 'khor grags/ ga rong tshul khrims 'byung gnas dang*/ rong rlings lo tsā ba| ra byid lo tsā ba/ se lo tsā ba sogs kyi kyang*/ rtsa mi la mnyan nas/ 'gyur bcos byas kyang gzhan rnams kyi bshad bka' ma zin/ se lo tsā bas gnyos 'od 'bar la bshad/ de la grub thob u rgyan par grags pa rin chen dpal gyis zhus nas dbang bshad khrid bka' rnams bskyangs/ da lta'ang u rgyan bsnyen bsgrub tu grags pa rnams yin no/ /shong ston rdo rje rgyal mtshan ni la stod lho'i dpyad lung pa shar kha'i bong ra zhes bya bar 'khrungs/ bla ma go lung pa rdo rje rgyan mtshan la rgyud sde du ma dang phreng ba bskor gsum sogs la sbyangs/ gar thig lnga bsdus gza' lnga g.yul rgyal sogs la mkhas par gyur nas gza' rnams gsal bar byed pa'i sgron ma la sogs pa'i bstan bcos du ma mdzad/ mngon pa ba rin chen rtse mo'i bu chen/ stag bde ba seng ge rgyal mtshan la phar tshad mngon gsum dang spyod bsdus la mkhas par sbyangs/ der dus 'khor 'bro lugs kyi dbang bshad man ngag gi bka' thams cad rdzogs par gsan/ 'phags pa rin po che gong nas sa skyar phebs par drung du bstod pa'i tshigs bcad spel ba legs pa phul/ lo tsā slob tu 'gro bas rdzong thar zhu zhes zhus pas| de lta bu'i blo skye ba bzang*/ gzhung gsar pa 'gyur ba'i nus pa 'ong ba dka' na'ang*/ paṇ+ḍi ta la dri gtug dang slob gnyer legs par gyis/ kho bos kyang chos rje brten yun thung pas sdeb sbyor me tog gi chun po dang tshig gter la sogs pa mi go bar snang bas 'di rnams cis kyang shes pa zhig gyis la shog cig gsungs nas de dag gi dpe dang gser srang lnga dar yug bcu rnams gnang*| rten 'brel yod pas do nub rje btsun gong ma'i gzims khang du nyol gsungs*|

khong gis thugs la nga skye thob kyi shes rab ni che/ sbyor byung gi nan tan yang mchog tu gyur na/ legs bshad gsar pa mang du ci'i phyir bsgyur bar mi nus snyam du dgongs te/ 'phags pa'i gzims g.yog pa blo gros rgya mtshan dang 'grogs nas bal yul du byon te/ paṇ+ḍi ta mahā bha dra'i drung du sgra snyan ngagasdeb sbyor/ mngon brjod/ zlos gar te rig gnas chung ba lnga la sbyangs/ khyad par sgra rig la shin tu mkhas par gyur/ sa skyar byon nas dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud dang 'grel pa la shin tu rnam par dag pa'i 'gyur bcos mdzad/ slar yang ma hā bo dhi mchod pa sogs la rdo rje gdan du byon/ paṇ+ḍi ta chen po lak+ṣ+mi ka ra spyan drangs nas dpag bsam 'khri shing dang klu kun du dga' ba'i zlos gar dang*| snyan ngag me long dang*/ 'jig rten dbang phyug gi bstod pa brgya pa dang*/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi bstod pa bṛt+ta ma la'i bstod pa dang*/ sgra tsan+d+ra pa'i mdo la sogs pa sngon bod du ma 'gyur ba rnams bsgyur/ a ma ra ko ṣa la sogs pa la'ang mchan bu gsal bar bkod de rig pa'i gnas 'di dag shin tu dar bar mdzad/ de dang de'i gcung po shong blo brtan gnyis ka la lo tsā ba mchog ldan gyis gsan/ de ni mang 'khar khra tshang du 'khrungs/ gzhon nu'i tshe 'phags pa rin po che la rab byung zhus/ mchog ldan pa'i blo gros dpung rgyan mdzes pa'i tog ces 'dogs par zhu zhes zhus nas ming de ltar btags/ bod du 'gyur ba'i bka' thams cad dang*/ bstan bcos phal che ba dang dbang dang man ngag phal mo che'i lung bzhugs/ de la bla ma dpal ldan seng ges gsan/ de la bu ston rin po ches/ chos dang dbang bka' mang du gsan na'ang*/ rgyud 'grel gyi bshad pa ma gsan/ dka' gnas la gsung gleng dang dri gtugs mang du mdzad/ 'on kyang 'gyur mi 'dra ba bcu bdun 'dug pa de thams cad kyi nang nas shong 'gyur nyid mchog tu dgongs nas bshad pa thams cad 'gyur de'i steng nas mdzad/

da lta'i bar du de ltar byed pas shong ston 'di yang lugs 'di la bka' drin che'o/ /bzhi pa la mdo sde'i phyogs la rten pa'i bstan rtsis yongs grags bshad pa dang*/ dus kyi 'khor lo nas bshad pa'i bstan rtsis tshad grub bshad pa'o/ / dang po ni/ spyir bstan pa'i gnas tshad la/ bskal bzang gi yi ge kha cig dang*/ blo gros mi zad pa'i mdo'i 'grel pa dang*/ mdzod 'grel gyi kha che ba'i rang lugs rnams su lo stong dang*/ snying rje pad dkar du phyed dang nyis stong*| zla ba'i snying po'i mdor nyis stong*/ rdor gcod 'grel par phyed dang sum stong du gnas par gsungs la/ skal bzang gi yi ge kha cig las lnga stong dang*/ sangs rgyas drin lan bsab pa'i mdo las bdun stong gnas rgyu la bud med rab tu byung bas nyis stong 'grib par bshad pa dang mthun par/ yum gsum gnod 'joms las bshad cing*/ daṃṣ+ta se nas 'bum ṭika tu'ang bshad/ gnod 'joms 'di ni dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad par grags na'ang*/ rnam bshad rigs pa sogs kyi mdo 'chad tshul dang mi mthun pa'i nor ba mang du 'byung bas dbyig gnyen gyis ma mdzad kyi/ daṃṣ+ta se nā byas pa'am/ lo tsā ba ye shes sdes byas pa gang rung du mkhas pa dag bzhed do/ /'on kyang slob dpon 'jam dpal grags pas kyang lnga stong du gnas pa dang*/ de la lnga brgya pa phrag bcur phye nas/ rtogs pa'i dang*/ sgrub pa'i dang*/ lung gi lnga rgya pa gsum gsum dang*/ rtags tsam gyis gcig tu phyes nas gsungs pa bzhin 'bum ṭīka las kyang 'byung bar kun la grags/ mdzod 'grel du/ kha cig rtogs pa'i bstan pa yin gyi/ /lung gi ni de las ring bar yang gnas so zhes bshad do/ /de dag las lnga stong du gsungs pa nges don du byas nas/ gzhan rnams drang don du bzhed pa mang la/ sher phyin dang*/ gsang 'dus sogs kyi rgyud sde 'ga' rer mdo rgyud de dag 'jig rten na ji srid du spyod pa de srid du bstan pa gnas par bshad pa dang*/

byams pa lung bstan pa'i mdor/ tshe lo yar 'phel gyi drug brgya pa'i bar du gnas par bshad pa sogs mang du byung ngo*/ de lta mod kyi de dag ni/ lung rtogs thugs rgyud la ldan pa'i gang zag khyad par can re re tsam 'jig rten na bzhugs pa lta bu la dgongs nas gsungs pa yin pas/ lo grangs kyi gnas tshad gsungs pa dgongs gzhi mi gcig par nges so/ /'o na lo grangs kyi gnas tshad gsungs pa'i dgongs gzhi gang yin zhe na/ 'dul ba lung gi gleng gzhi las| btsun pa/ ji tsam gyis na dam pa'i chos mchis pas zhes bgyi/ ji tsam gyis na zhig pa zhes bgyi/ u pā li/ las kyang yod la nan tan byed pa yang yod pa'i bar du ste/ de tsam gyis na mchis pa zhes bya'o/ /las kyang med la nan tan byed pa yang med na dam pa'i chos zhig pa zhes bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ las mtshan nyid pa la rten nas dge slong gi sdom pa gsar du skye ba nam yod kya ི bar du yod la/ de med pa nas zhig pa yin te/ thogs med kyis/ dam pa'i chos nub pa na las kyi mtha' rnams med pa'i phyir dge slong gi sdom pa ma blangs pa ni blang du med pa la blangs pa ni mi gtong bar rig par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /de ltar na so sor thar pa bstan pa'i rtsa bar gsungs pa yang de la dgongs la/ de 'dra'i las mtshan nyid pa 'grub pa la/ dge slong rnam dag grangs dang mtshan nyid tshang ba mtshams nang gcig tu 'tshogs pa dgos pas/ sngon dang phyis kyi mkhas pa dag gis dge 'dun gyi sde dang 'dul ba'i lag len la gtso bor mdzad pa yin pas gang dag nags khrod sogs su gcig pur gnas pas bstan pa 'dzin par 'dod pa ni bstan pa'i rtsa ba la gces spras med pa yin no/ /de ltar na gnas tshad ni rang lugs yang lnga stong la bya'o/ /'o na lnga stong las sngar ji tsam 'das/ da ji tsam gnas snyam na/ 'di la sngar rabs la grags pa ni rgyal ba 'das nas lo brgya dang so bdun na/ rgyal po dga' byed/

de nas brgyad brgya na/ zla srungs/ de nas nyis brgya so brgyad na mdzod mang*/ de nas bdun brgya nyer bzhi na bal por chos kyi go cha/ de nas brgyad brgya bcu bzhi na 'od zer go cha/ de nas nyis brgya zhe gnyis/ bod du mnga' bdag khri ral byung ste/ de man chad la nyis stong dgu brgya dang nga lnga 'das so zhes bal po lo bcos dang bod kyi rgyal pos rtsis pa las byung*/ de nas brgya dang go bdun 'das pa me pho 'brug la lha bla ma yab sras kyis rtsis pas sum stong brgya nga gnyis/ de nas so lnga 'das pa lcags mo yos la jo bo rjes rtsis pas sum stong brgya brgyad cu rtsa bdun/ de nas nga dgu 'das pa/ sa mo glang la lo chen blo ldan shes rab 'das pa'i phyis lo brtsis pas sum stong nyis brgya zhe drugade nas lnga bcu 'das pa lcags pho 'brug la phya pa'i chos grwar rtsis pas sum stong nyis brgya go drugajo bo rje'i bzhed pas/ sangs rgyas shing pho byi ba la lhum su zhugs/ shing glang la bltam/ sa mo phag la sangs rgyas/ shing pho spre'u ston zla tha chung gi yar ngo'i tshes brgyad la mya ngan las 'das par bzhed pas 'di'i rjes su 'brangs nas 'chims nam mkha' grags kyis me mo sbrul la brtsis pas sum stong sum brgya go gsum song bar byas so/ /chos rje sa paṇa ltar na/ rgyal ba me mo yos la lhums su zhugs pa nas brtsi/ de'i dbang du byas nas rje btsun grags rgyal gyi gshegs rdzong me pho byi ba la mdzad dus rtsis pas/ sum stong sum brgya zhe dgu 'das/ de nas drug cu re gcig 'das pa me mo glang la chu mig chos 'khor du chos rgyal 'phags pas brtsis pas sum stong bzhi brgya dang bcu song*/ de nas zhe gnyis 'das pa sa mo lug la phar phyin bu ṭika brtsam pa'i bar la sum stong bzhi brgya dang gnyis/ de nas brgya dang so drug 'das pa da lta'i shing mo phag 'di yan la sum stong lnga brgya dang gya brgyad 'das/

da stong dang bzhi brgya bcu gnyis lus par bya dgos pa yin no/ /paṇa chen shākya shrīs khro phur yang rtsis/ sol nag thang chen du me mo yos la rtsis dus/ smin drug zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi/ /tshes brgyad nam gung mnyam pa la/ /zla ba ri bo la nub tshe/ / thub dbang yongs su mya ngan 'das/ /de rjes lo ni stong phrag gcig /bdun brgya dang ni lnga bcu dang*/ /zla ba gnyis dang zla ba phyed/ /de bzhin nyi ma lnga rabs 'das| |lo ni stong phrag gsum dang ni/ /nyis brgya dang ni bzhi bcu dgu/ /zla ba dgu dang nyi ma bcu/ /ma 'ongs bstan pa'i lhag mar gnas/ /zhes lo de'i dpyid 'bring gi tshes lnga la brtsis par bshad pa la/ chos rje sa paṇa gyis/ lugs de ni rgya gar na nyan thos sen dha ba rnams/ zhag re bzhin dus brjod pa'i tshe ston pa 'das nas 'di song brjod pa la/ ma ga dha'i byang chub chen po de/ slob dpon mtho brtson 'grus rje dang bde byed dga' bas mdzad par bzhed nas tsan+dan gyi lde gu spungs pa las rang byung du byon pa'i nub mo nas byang chub chen po dang ston pa 'das pa'i dus gnyis nor nasabarjod pa'i 'khrul pa yin pas| rgya bal kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta mang po lugs de 'dod kyang legs pa ma yin te/ lha mo dri ma med pa lung bstan pa'i mdor/ nga mya ngan las 'das nas lo nyis stong lnga brgya nas gdong dmar can gyi yul du dam pa'i chos 'byung bar lung bstan pa'i gdong dmar can bod la byed dgos pa dang*/ gzhan yang klu sgrub sogs lung bstan pa'i lo grangs dang rgyal po'i rabs la sogs pa rtsis nas mi 'grig pas lugs snga ma legs so zhes gsungs mod kyi kho bo ni zlog nas smra ta| bstan rtsis grags che ba 'di shin tu mi rigs pa'i phyir ro/ /'di ltar/ sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das nas lo stong du nye ba na thogs med sku mched byon par gsungs zhing 'thad la/ dbyig gnyen gyi slob ma blo brtan/

de'i dngos slob dzi na mi tra/ des bod du byon nas ka cog dang lo paṇa byas pa gang zhigaka cog khri ral gyi dus kyi lo tsa ba yin/ des dus lo gsum stong du zhe lngas khyad pa song bar khyed rang gis khas blangs/ dbyig gnyen dus 'das dus lo stong las ma song zhing*/ blo brtan sku tshe ring po ma byung bar grags shing grub pas/ dzi na mi tras bod du byon dus lo nyis stong bzhes pa'i skyon du 'gyur/ de bzhin du slob dpon ye shes snying pos cog ro dang lo paṇa mdzad par dbu ma rtsa sher sogs kyi 'jug gis gsal la/ de dang klu sgrub kyi bar na'ang*/ legs ldan byed dang dpal sbas las med pas de gnyis kyi sku tshe stong bzhugs nas snga ma'i sku tshe'i mthar phyi ma slob mar byung ba sogs khas len dgos par 'gyur/ gzhan yang zla grags dang mgos lo tsā ba'i bar na/ slob pon rdo rje/ nag po spyod pa/ btsun mo can gsum las med pas de gsum gyis brgyad brgya re tsam bzhugs pa'i snga ma 'grongs khar phyi mas zin dgos par 'gyur la/ de bzhin du mdo sngags kyi brgyud rim mtha' dag la rtog pa bcug pas shes pa'i phyir ro/ /

rgyas par tsan+dan jo bo'i lo rgyus sogs la brten nas dgag sgrub rgyas par zur du bkod pa ltar ro/ /des na lugs 'di ni/ rgya gar du rgyal po pā la lnga dang*/ se na brgyad la sogs pa'i ring la nyi ma zlog thebs re la lo re ru byed pa'i phyed lo rtsi ba yun ring du byung bar grags la/ da lta'ang de lta bu'i lugs yod par 'dug pas de 'dra ba zhig bar skabs su zhugs par gsal lo/ /des na bcom ldan chen po rigs ral gyis kyang dus 'khor la brten pa'i bstan rtsis gtso bor mdzad la/ phyis kyi mkhas pa gzhan dag kyang de ltar du 'dod pa ltar/ kho bo yang*/ 'das lo mdo rgyud la rten rgyu med par gtam rgyud rnying pa'i rgyun la rtsi ba 'di ltar bor nas/ dus kyi 'khor lo 'di nas bar du 'di song nges pa can gyi lung dang*/ nyi zla gzas 'dzin dang gza' lnga sogs sa ris dang legs par mthun par rigs pas grub pa'i tshad ma la brten pa 'di khas len no/ /gnyis pa ni/ lugs 'di la bstan pa yun 'di srid du gnas zhes pa'i lo grangs sogs mdo sde'i phyogs bzhin du lung bstan pa dang gsal bar bshad pa med mod kyi/ rgyal ba mya ngan las 'das nas lo drug brgya na 'jam dbyangs grags pa byung ba dang*/ de nas grags pa rang nyid kyi lo brgya dang bcas pa'i dgu brgya na kla klo 'byung ba dang*/ kla klo'i chos de lo stong brgyad brgya'i bar du 'jug cing*/ de nas 'khor lo can gyis kla klo bcom ste sangs rgyas kyi chos 'jog par bshad pa rnams kyis/ 'dzam gling chung ngu 'di'i bstan pa'i gnas tshad rtogs par nus la| debazhin du sa dum bu re re la/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos 'jug pa dang*/ de kla klo'i chos kyis nyams par byed pa dang*/ de 'khor lo can gyis bcoms nas rang gi chos kyang dum bu re la lo stong brgyad brgyar gnas par bshad pa rnams kyis 'dzam gling chen por ji tsam gnas pa'i tshad kyang rtogs par nus so|

|'o na rigs ldan rgya mtsho rnam rgyal khri thog tu byon gyi bar/ rigs ldan shin tu bzang yan chod ni re res lo brgya brgyar chos ston par shin tu gsal mod kyi/ rgya mtsho rnam rgyal man chad kyi rigs ldan rnams kyi ji tsam chos ston pa mi gsal zhing*/ drag po 'khor lo can rigs ldan nyi shu rtsa lnga'i nang du 'grong ngam| rtsa drug par byed pa'ang mi mthun par smra ba mang bas the tshom za zhing*/ rtsa drug par byed na'ang rgya mtsho rnam rgyal man la bcu drug las med pas/ kla klo'i lo stong drug brgya las mi rdzogs par 'gyur te/ drag po 'khor lo can gyis ni de ma thag tu kla klo 'joms pas so zhe na/ 'di la kha cig 'khor lo can rigs ldan nyer lnga par byas/ de rang gi lo brgya po rtsis kyang stong drug brgya las ma byung bas| me mkha' rgya mtsho la rgya mtsho rnam rgyal dang de'i sras rgyal dkas bgos so| |yab la lag pa gdeng can zla ba dang*/ sras la nyis brgya nyer gcig sbyar nas de gnyis la brgya brgya'i nges pa mi sbyor/ gzhan thams cad brgya brgyar nges pa 'dod par byed do/ /de ltar na deng sang rigs ldan mtha' yas kyis chos bstan nas lo nyi shu rtsa brgyad 'das par 'dod/ 'di ni lung rigs kyi sgrub byed gsal po med bzhin du 'dod pas sbyar ba'i rnam bzhag tu snang ste/ rigs ldan nyer lnga la gzhan rnams brgya brgyar nges nas de gnyis la zur pa 'ong ba'i rgyu mtshan med pa'i phyir ro/ /'khor lo can nyer lnga par byed pa'ang mi rigs te/ 'od zer bdun dang ri gza' thub rnams 'dir ni de bzhin snying stobs ldan pa'i lha'i skye gnas te/ zhes go sla'i skabs su gsungs pa'i/ bdun dang ri dang gza' dang thub pa ste lha'i skye gnas bdun bzhi nyi shu rtsa brgyad mi tshang ba'i phyir ro| |'di ltar rigs ldan nyer lnga'i steng du drag po 'khor lo can dang*/ de'i sras 'jal dpal dang 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sprul pa tshangs pa dang brgya byin rgyab dang mdun du ston par 'gyur bar bshad pa gnyis dang bcas pa'i nyi shu rtsa brgyad la byed dgos pas so/

/'o na sum cu rtsa gnyis gdan gyi mthar ni lha min dgra bo tshe lo brgya pa phyag na 'khor lo 'gyur/ /zhes dang*/ de'i dbus su gdan ni nyi shu rtsa lnga rim par yongs su bgrangs pa dag gi dus kyi mthar/ / rigs ldan rigs la lha yi dbang po lha ni mchog gis btud pa drag po'i rigs ldan 'byung bar 'gyur/ zhes pas nyi shu rtsa lnga par bstan pa ma yin nam zhe na ma yin te/ mtha' ni zad dang 'jug cha dang zhes bshad pas 'jug gi cha la mthar bshad pa'ang yod mod kyi da lan zad pa la byed pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na pad dkar gyi rjes su/ khro bo bcu dang sems dpa' bcu gsum spel nas lung bstan pas/ drag po 'khor lo can la lung bstan med pas mi 'thad do zhe na/ med pa ma grub ste/ mtha' yas rnam rgyal rigs ldan no/ /de sras 'khor lo chen po can/ / rigs ldan drag po 'byung 'gyur ba/ /rigs ldan grags pa de nyid slar/ grags pa rigs ldan de nas slar/ 'gyur khyad yin/ zhes 'jam dbyangs grags pa nyid drag po 'khor lo can du bstan pas so/ /nyer lnga la mi gtogs na rigs ldan du mi 'thad do zhe na/ ma nges te/ 'khor lo can gyi kla klo bcom nas| tshangs pa dang dbang po mdun rgyab tu chos ston pa'i tshangs pa'i dus su mi lo stong brgyad brgyar 'phel ba dang*/ de'i phyed ni 'od srung gi'o zhes sogs tshe lo rim gyis 'gribs nas rdul gyi skye gnas brgyad po'i mthar yang rigs ldan du bshad pa'i phyir te/ rigs ldan mthar ni ji srid brgya phrag gcig gis lo'i grangs kyi skye bo'i tshe ru rab tu 'gyur/ /zhes bshad pas so/ /drag po byon ma thag tu kla klo 'joms pa'ang ma grub ste/ de lta na byon ma thag tu bde ba'i gnas su gshegs par 'gyur te/ rdzogs ldan mtshams su kla klo'i chos rnams mtha' dag srid pa gsum gyi bla ma dag gis bcad byas nas/ bcad nas lo ni brgyad brgya rnams su tshangs pa bzhag pa mdzad nas bde ba'i gnas su 'gro bar 'gyur|

|zhes gsungs pas so/ /des na de'i sku tshe ni lo brgya yin par/ sum cu rtsa gnyis zhes pa'i rgyud tshig gis grub bo/ /'o na kla klo'i lo stong brgyad brgya la stong bdun brgya las ma tshang ngo zhe na/ ma tshang mod kyi rags rtsis dbang du byas so| |'di ni gling 'dir de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa lo lnga stong gnas par mdo sde'i phyogs su rgyas par gsung pa dang bstun pa'i ched yin nam snyam ste| 'di ltar sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das nas ma kha'i yul du kla klo byung gi bar la lo stong lnga brgya/ kla klo'i chos byung nas rdzogs par bcom gyi bar la stong bdun brgya ste sdom pas sum stong nyis brgya ni bstan pa/ drag po 'khor lo can gyi ma gsos bar gyi lo grangs yin la/ de rjes kla klo bcom rjes su'ang sangs rgyas kyi chos 'jug par yang yang gsungs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos ni/ sangs rgyas 'di nyid kyi bstan par byed dgos te/ de dag la 'khor lo can gyi dus bzhir bshad pa yod kyang*/ de bstan 'dzin yin gyi ston pa min pa'i phyir ro/ / des na/ des gsos pa'i bstan pa'ang sa dum bu re la stong brgyad brgya re 'byung ste| des na lo ni stong phrag nyi shu lag pa brgya dang bral bar sangs rgyas chos ni rab tu 'jug/zhes pa/ nyi khri chig stong drug brgya'i steng nas stong brgyad brgya gling chung 'dir kla klo bcom rjes su 'jug la/ de bcad rting*/ nyi khri nyis brgyas chad pa gling gzhan rnams la 'jug par bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /des na gling 'di'i stong brgyad brgya po de nyid sngar gyi sum stong nyis brgya dang bsres pas lnga stong nyid du legs par grub pas so/ /ma grub ste/ kla klo rnams ni 'khor gyi skye bo dang bcas rab tu bcom nas mi rnams lo ni brgya phyed na/ rigs ldan grub par gyur te lha yis bkod pa'i pho brang mtho ba kai la sha yi rgyab tu'o/

/zhes 'khor lo can gyi lo brgya po'i phyed na kla klo 'joms par bshad pas so| |zhe na/ de ltar 'chad pa 'ga' res snang mod kyi/ de ni de ltar ma yin te/ kla klo 'joms khar/ de'i chos dar sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dus bzhi'i nang nas rtsod dus kyang zer/ skye dgu'i tshe lo rim gyis 'gribs nas tshe lo lnga bcu gyur pa'i tshe na/ kla klo 'joms pa rdzogs zhes pas don du snang ste/ tshangs pa sogs la mi rnams lo ni brgya phrag bco brgyad dang ldan 'di dag mi rnams dag gi tshe/ / de'i phyed ni 'od srung gi'o/ /zhes so/ /kla klo bcom nas/ 'khor lo can gyi rdzogs ldan du gyur nas tshe lo yar 'phel te/ de'i sras tshangs pa dbang po'i ming can 'jam dpal dang 'jig rten dbang phyug gi ring la mi rnams kyi tshe lo stong brgyad brgya/ de gnyis kyi rjes su 'od srung kyi rings la tshe lo dgu brgya sogs te/ nya dang rus sbal phag pa sogs rdul gyi skye gnas brgyad kyi ring la rim gyi bri nas mthar tshe lo brgya par 'gyur bar bshad pas so/ /'di rnams ni sngon chad legs par 'chad shes pa ma byung bar snang bas rnam dpyod ldan pas legs par dpyad na spro ba skyes bar 'gyur ro/ /de ltar na gling bcu gnyis po kun tu/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa ma gsos pa dang gsos pa zhes pa'am/ yang na snga dar dang phyi dar zhes brjod kyang rung ste/ gnyis gnyis byung bar rig par bya la/ gling bcu gcig tu ni snga phyi gnyis ka'ang lo stong brgyad brgya bar mtshungs pa dang*/ 'dir kla klo ma zhugs gong gi phyed dang nyis stong po lhag pa dang*/ zhib pa na/ 'di'i kla klo zhugs rjes kyi snga dar la stong bdun brgya las med pa rnamasagrub bo/ /de ltar na snga dar bsdoms pa la/ nyi khri chig stong lnga brgya/ phyi dar sdoms pa la nyis khri chig stong drug brgya'o/ /'dir gling kun tu sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'jug pa mi 'thad de/

mngon pa sogs nas sgra mi snyan pas dge sdig gi rten du mi rung bar bshad pas so zhe na/ skyon spong sngar bshad zin pa bzhin/ mngon pa dang 'gal ba spong na/ shin tu mang po zhig spong dgos pas ha cang thal ba dang*/ ri gling mtha' dag mi bstun par nges bzhin du sgra mi snyan la dogs pa gcod don yang med la/ cis kyis sgrig na'ang*/ mngon pa nas gsungs pa lus ngag gtso bor gyur pa sor thar gyi bstan pa dang*/ 'dir gsung pa yid gtso bor gyur pa sngags kyi bstan pa'i dbang du byas pas ci zhig 'gal zhes kyang brjod par bya'o/ /da ni gsum pa tshig don gtan la dbab pa la/ brjod byed kyi tshig dang*/ brjod bya'i don gtan la dbab pa'o/ dang po ni/ bstan pa'i mthar thug 'di'i rjod byed kyi tshig ni/ bsdu na rtsa rgyud dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa dang*/ bsdus rgyud dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa gnyis su 'dus mod kyi| phye na drug tu dbyer yod pa dang*/ drug po de la mtha' drug tu byed de/ drug ni mdor bstan dang rgyas bshad gnyis/ rab tu mdor bstan dang rab tu rgyas bshad gnyis/ mdor bstan chen po dang rgyas bshad chen po gnyis/ mtha' drug ni| mdor bstan gyi mtha' dang rgyas bshad kyi mtha' zhes sogs re re la sbyar ba'o/ /mtshan gzhi ni/ mdor bstan ni bsdus rgyud/ rgyas bshad ni rtsa rgyud/ bar pa gnyis pa ni rim pa ltar de gnyis kyi bka' 'grel/ tha ma gnyis ni de gnyis kyi 'grel bshad so so'o/ /de skad du rtsa rgyud kyi dum bur dbang mdor bstan las/ rgyud ni mdor bstan rnams gsum dang*/ /rgyas par bshad pa rnams gsum 'gyur/ /mdor bstan rab tu mdor bstan che/ /rgyas bshad rab tu rgyas bshad gzhan/ /mdor bstan rgyas par bshad pa ni/ /bsdus dang yang dag rgyud yin no/ /rab tu mdor bstan rgyas bshad pa/ /bka' 'grel tshig ni byed pa po/ /mdor bstan chen po rgyas bshad pa/ /'grel bshad don kun ston byed pa'o/

/de ni mngon shes thob rnams kyis/ /bya yi mkhas rnams kyis min nyid| |de ltar mtha' drug rnams kyis dag /rdo rje'i rnal 'byor rnam bzhi dang*// rdzogs pa'i byang chub bzhi rnams dang*/ /phung khams skyed mched rigs drug rnams| |dag pa 'jig rten khams la sogs/ /le'u lngar ni 'dod rnams kyis| |bden gnyis dang po'i sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /dus kyi 'khor lo mngon brjod byed/ /ces gang gsungs pa 'dis dus 'khor gyi brjod bya rjod byed brjod tshul rnams bsdus nas bstan no/ /de la mdor bstan gyi mtha' ni bsdus rgyud/ rgyud phyi ma dang bcas pa yin la/ bsdus rgyud ni tshig rkang pa re la yi ge nyi shu rtsa gcig pa me tog phreng 'dzin gyi sdeb sbyor gyi tshigs bcad gcig ma lus par bcings pa tshigs bcad kyi grangs ni sum cu lhag pa yi phyogs brgya zhes stong dang sum cur 'dod pa dang*/ stong dang sum cu lhag tsam du 'dod pa la sogs pa ni rags pa'i rnam gzhag tu gsal te/ mchog mi 'gyur du/ da lta'i rgyud na med pa'i rgyud tshig 'ga' res yang lung drangs mod kyi/ da lta'i rgyud la'ang tshigs bcad stong dang lnga bcu nga brgyad yod de/ 'jig rten khams le la brgya drug cu re dgu/ nang le la brgya bdun cu don bzhi/ dbang le la nyis brgya dang gnyis/ sgrub le la nyis brgya dang so bzhi/ ye le la nyis brgya re gcig byung ba'i phyir ro/ /'o na phreng 'dzin gyi sdeb sbyor de ji lta bu zhig la zer zhe na/ rgyas par pa ni/ phyi rol pa'i mkhas pa dmar ser dang rgyal ba lha'i gzhung dang*/ de dag gi skyon rnams bkag nas rang lugs yon tan brgyad ldan du ston pa/ shan+ti pas mdzad pa'i rin chen 'byung gnas las shes dgos pa 'dir nyer mkho mdor bsdus brjod na/ spyir sdeb sbyor gyi lus la tshigs bcad dang rkyang pa gnyis su nges la/ dang po la bṛt+ta'am 'phel ba dang*/ dza tī'am bskyed ma gnyis su nges shing*/

dang po la yi ge gcig pa dang lnga pa'i bar yang mi bzhed pa ma yin gyi/ dngos bstan rkang pa re la yi ge drug pa nas nyer drug pa'i bar la sdeb sbyor ming 'dogs so so ba dang*/ nyer bdun pa yan gyi tshigs bcad la rgyun chags zhes ming 'dogs pa dang*/ de re re la yang nang gses kyi dbye ba mang po dang bcas pa mdzad pa'-i yi ge nyer gcig pa yin la/ de rin chen 'byung gnas kyi rtsa ba kho bos 'gyur bcos pa las/ ma ra ba dang na na ba/ /ra ra ba rnams bdun gsum gyi/ /bstod pa phreng ba 'dzin zhes bya bar 'gyur/ /zhes pas mtshan nyid bshad do/ /de yang thog mar yi ge bcu gnyis kyi ming 'dogs kyi brda chad shes dgos la bcu gnyis kyi nang nas ba dang ka gnyis ni ngal gso'i yi ge re re btags te/ ngal gso lci ba la ba zhes brjod/ ngal gso yang ba la ka zhes brjod do/ /la dang ga ni ngal gsor ma nges pa'i yi ge re re la btags te| la ni yang ba ga ni lci ba'o/ /bha*/ sdeb sbyor la/ thog bar mtha' kun lci ba/ bha dang dza dang sa dang ma/ thog ma bar mtha' kun yang ba/ ya dang ra dang ta dang na/ zhes bshad la der blta'o/ dang dza dang sa dang ma dang*/ ya dang ra dang ta na rnams ni tshigs bcad kyi nang gi yi ge gsum gsum la ming du btags shing 'dir yi ge bgrang ba ni dbyangs bgrang ba'o/ /zhes pas dbyangs kyi yi ge la bya'o/ /dbyangs kyang yang lci'i sgo nas shes par bya la/ yang lci yang*/ yi ge so so la 'greng bu na ro ring cha klad kor mtha' rten rnams med pa ni yang ba dang yod pa ni lci ba'o/ /de yang yi ge gsum po'i thog ma lci ba ni bha/ bar pa lci ba ni dza/ mtha' ma lci ba ni sa/ kun lci ba ni ma'o/ /de bzhin du thog ma dang bar dang*/ mtha' dang kun yang ba ni rim pa bzhin du/ ya dang ra dang ta dang na rnams so/ /de ltar na 'dir rkang pa gcig la yi ge nyer gcig yod pa la bdun gsum yod pa'i bdun dang po ma ra ba ste/ gsum tshan gnyis kyi dang po kun lci ba dang gnyis pa'i bar pa yang ba dang bdun pa ngal gso lci ba yod pas so/

/bdun bar pa na na ba yin te/ kun yang ba gsum tshan dang gnyis dang bdun pa snga ma bzhin yin pas so/ /bdun tha ma ra ra ba yin te/ gsum tshan dbus yang ba dang bdun pa ngal gso lci ba yod pas so/ /dper na/ gleng gzhi'i rkang dang po/ thams cad mkhyen pa ye shes sku dang nyin mor byed pa'i sku ste pad+ma'i 'dab ma rgyas pa'i spyan/ /zhes pa'i saṃ skṛ ta la/ sa rba dz+nyā dz+nyā na kā yaṃ/ di na ka ra wa pu ṣa pad+ma pat+tā ya ta k+ṣoṃ/ bud+dha

sangs rgyas seng ge'i khri la bzhugs pa lha mchog rnams kyis btud la rgyal po zla ba bzang po yis/ /mgo bos rab tu phyag 'tshal lag pa'i pad+ma sbyar ba yan lag mchog la bzhag nas zhus pa yis/ /rnal 'byor dpal ldan dus 'khor ka phreng ldan pa'i a 'dus la ste mi rnams grol ba'i don du'o// si~Xṃ hā sa nas+thaṃ/ su ra ba ra mi ta mastaṃ ke na pra ṇa myaṃ/ pṛts+tsha ra dzā pū tsan+d+raḥ ka ra ma la pu ṭaṃ s+thā/ pa yī tot+tai māṅga*/ yo ga sha kā lā tsakra/ ka li yu ga sa ma yaṃ/ muk+ti he t+no re ṇaṃ/ zhes pa lta bu'o/ rkang pa thams cad lci yang la sogs pa de ji lta ba bzhin du gnas pas shin tu ngo mtshar te yi ge mang du dogs pas snying po tsam zhig bkod do/ /yang lci'i brda chad ni/ prastā ra zhes 'khyog yod med kyi ri mos shes te/ 'khyog po rnams lci ba dang drang po rnams yang ba dang*/ klad dkor can rnams ngal gso'o/ /de dag ni/ yi ge bgrang ba bṛt+tā dper brjod skabs su bab pa yin la/ zhar la dza ti ni phyi mo bgrang bar bshad pa'i phyi mo ni/ yi ge'i gcig yun gnyis yun gsum yun sogs so sor bgrang bas te/ dbyangs thung ngu ni phyi mo gcig pa/ ring po ni phyi mo gnyis pa/ shin tu ring po ni p+lu ta'i ming can gyi phyi mo gsum par bshad do/ /de ltar byas na/ da lta'i rgyud 'di la/ tshigs bcad stong dang nga brgyad| rkang pa bzhi stong nyis brgya so gnyis*/ yi ge brgyad khri brgyad stong brgyad brgya don gnyis/ phyi mo ni rkang pa re re la phyi mo bcu gnyis re lhag pas tshigs bcad re la zhe brgyad re lhag po bsdoms na lnga khri bdun brgya gya bzhi lhag po bsnan pas phyi mo 'bum gsum khri dgu stong drug brgya nga drug tu 'gyur la/ p+lu ta ni re re tsam yod srid kyang mang po yod par ma mthong zhing gang yod kyi phyi ma re re lhag pa yang bsnan dgos so/ de ltar na rgyud 'di sdeb sbyor nges pa can gyi tshigs bcad ma lus pa bcings pa ni 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi mkhyen rab la shin tu gus pa skye ba'i rgyu yin te/

gzhung lugs gang la'ang tshigs bcad rnams yi ge'i grangs mnyam pa srid kyang sdeb sbyor gcig gis gzhung ma lus par bcings pa re re tsam du zad pa'i phyir te/ 'dul ba sum brgya pa yi ge bcu gcig pa'i bye brag dbang po rdo rje dang*/ nyan thos zhi tshol gyi tshigs bcad gcig po yi ge bcu dgu pa stag rnam rtsen dang*/ bshes pa'i springs yigadzā ti la 'phags ma dang ro langs can dang*/ phyi mo mnyam pa'i/ dzā ti gsum yod pa'i 'phags ma'i bye brag gis bcings pa lta bu srid tsam las mi snang ba'i phyir ro| de ltar na sder sbyor nges pa bcings pa'i dgos pa ni/ mkhas rlom dag gi chos la tshig don gyi lhad 'jug pa mang bas de mi 'jug pa'i ched yin te/ sder sbyor nges pa dang tshigs bcad kyi grangs nges pa mdzad pas yi ge gcig kyang 'dzud par mi nus pa'i phyir ro/ /yang sgra'i rnam dbye la dang po ngo bo brjodapa/ gnyis pa las brjod pa dang*/ gsum pa byed pa/ bzhi pa dgos ched/ lnga pa 'byung khungs/ drug pa 'brel sgra/ bdun pa gnas gzhi brjod pa de bdun dang*/ de re re la gcig tshig/gnyis tshigamang tshig ste gsum gsum dang*/ kha gcig bod pa dang brgyad du 'dod kyang bod pa ngo bo brjod pa'i nang du 'du ste/ de ltar rnam dbye nges pa med na/ brjod bya gsal bar mi rtogs te/ bod skad la'ang*/ shing*/ shing la/ shing gis/ shing gi ched/ shing las/ shing gi/ shing la gnas zhes pa rnams nyams pa'am gzhan dang gzhan du brjod na don mi rtogs pa yin no snyam pa lta bu/ sgra la mkhas pa'i nga rgyal can rnams la/ tshig la mi ston gyi don la ston dgos pa tshig grogs dang skabs thob sogs la don go na tshig la zhen mi dgos so/ /zhes bstan pa dang*/ sgra la mkhas pa'i snod min dag gis glegs bam mthong na gsal bar rtogs kyis dogs pas kyang rgyud 'di la rnam dbye rnams ni nyams pa dang gzhan dang gzhan du bstan par gsungs so/

/rgyud phyi ma ni sngar gyi 'gyur 'di rwa 'gyur ngan pa gcig tu yod pas/ rkang pa re re la yi ge bcu dgu pa tshigs bcad kyi grangs kyang nges pa mi 'dug pas nges pa can gyis legs par bcos nas bshad par bya'o/ /dbang gi rab dbye rgyud kyi snying po la sogs pa ni/ bsdus rgyud 'di nyid kyi dbang la dgos pa dang rdzogs rim la dgos pa rnams zur du phye nas slob dpon dā ri ka pa sogs kyis 'grel pa byas pa yin pas rgyud zur pa min no/ /gnyis pa rgyas bshad kyi mtha' rtsa ba'i rgyud la nges don kyi rtsa rgyud ni/ mtshan brjod yin la/ 'di ni rgyud kyi rgyal po sgyu 'phrul drwa ba khri drug stong pa'i le'u zhe gsum pa rdo rje glur blangs kyi le'u yin par gzhung gzhan nas bshad mod kyi/ gzhung lugs 'dir de 'dra'i nges pa ma byung ngo*/ /'on kyang de nas dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang zhes pa nas ye shes sku nyid khyod la 'dud ces pa'i bar gyi tshigs bcad brgya dang re gnyis kyis dbang bzhi pa'i ye shes kyi sku bstan pa ni yang dang yang du gsungs so/ /de la tshigs bcad kyi grangs de ltar yod pa ni rgya dpe kun las le'u so so'i mtshams su tshigs bcad kyi grangs bshad yod pa bzhin du mchog mi 'gyur du bshad de/ zhus pa'i tshigs bcad bcu drug lan gyi drugarigs drug la gzigs pa'i gnyis/ sgyu ྄'phrul drwa bas byang chub pa'i gsum/ rdo rje'i dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i bcu bzhi/ chos dbyings ye shes kyi rkang pas dman pa'i nyer lnga/ me long ye shes kyi rkang pa lhag pa'i bcu/ sor rtog ye shes kyi zhe gnyis/ mnyam nyid ye shes kyi nyer lnga/ bya grub ye shes kyi bco lnga/ ye shes lnga la phyag 'tshal ba'i lnga rnams yod pas so| |de rnams kyi mtshams ni/ lus btud nas ni spyan sngar 'dug gi bar dang*/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de ni legs zhes gsol gyi bar dang*/

de nas cher gzigs nas kyi bar dang*/ de nas na ma/ 'i bar/ theg pa chen po'i tshul gyi mchog gi bar dang*/ de nas rdo rje lcags kyu zhags pa che'i bar dang*/ de nas sgra dang ldan pa rnams kyi mchog gi bar dang*/ de nas 'od rab gsal gyi bar/ de nas rin chen tog gi bar/ de nas 'jam dpal dpal dang ldan pa'i mchog gi bar| de nas ye shes sku nyid khyod la 'dud kyi bar ro/ /des na sgrub le'i 'jug tu 'di ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das nas ye shes sku nyid khyod la 'dud kyi bar la brgya re gnyis yod par bshad pa 'dra mo yod pa ni brgya re gnyis po'i nang nas nges don ston pa'i mgo 'jug sa ngos bzung ba'o/ /rgya dpe la lar/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ mnyam nyid ye shes la tshigs bcad re re/ lhag par mar la brgal nas bgrangs pa ni/ yo ga'i 'grel pa 'ga' re dang bstun pa'i bshad pa yin no/ /de ltar brgya dang re gnyis po ni/ nang skyes bu'i lus la gtsug tor dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying kha/ lte ba/ gsang ba rnams su rim pa bzhin rtsa'i 'khor lo 'dab ma bzhi dang*/ bcu drug dang*/ so gnyis dang*/ brgyad dang*/ re bzhi dang*/ so gnyis rnams sdom pas brgya dang nga druga'akhor lo drug gi dbus drug bgrangs pas brgya dang re gnyis po rnam par dag pa dang*/ gzhan la pad+ma gdan can gyi lha brgya dang nga drugaphyag rgya drug rnams rnam par dag pa'o/ /pad+ma gdan can gyi lha ni nang ler/ nus ma rnams dang khro bo rnams ni rim pa bcu ru 'gyur te zhes sogs kyis bstan te/ nus ma bcu/ gshegs pa gshegs ma bcu/ sems dpa' sems ma bcu gnyis/ khro bo bcu/ lha chen bcu gnyis/ rnal 'byor ma dang*/ klu dang gtum mo rnams brgyad brgyad de/ bdun cu don brgyad po yab yum gnyis su bgrangs pa'o/ /de nas phan yon gyi le'u drug dang*/ sngags kyi bstod pa tshigs bcad gsum dang*/ bsdu ba mthar phyin pa'i bya ba tshigs bcad lnga po rnams ni bsdu tshig yin mod kyang*|

nges don dngos su mi ston pas dag pa sogs kyang mi sbyor la bshad pa yang ma mdzad do/ /'di yang tshigs bcad ni yi ge brgyad pa yin mod kyi/ rjes sngags kyi sdeb sbyor gyi nges pa med do/ /drang nges thun mong gi rtsa rgyud ni/ byang sham+bha la na bzhugs pa/ rgya bod du dum bu re tsam las ma byon pa/ rjes sngags kyi mtshan nyid stong phrag bcu gnyis/ rkang pa bzhi khri brgyad stong*/ yi ge gsum 'bum brgyad khri bzhi stong gi bdag nyid do/ /'di rjes sngags ni/ bṛt+tā yi ge brgyad pa'i tshigs bcad kyi spyi ming yin la/ dbye na/ 'dra mtshungs dang*/ gzhal dpag dang*/ rkang dkra dang*/ glog phreng dang*/ bram ze'i bu ste lnga/ de'i mtshan nyid ni/ ga dang la tshar bzhi spel ba ste/ lji yang spel mar gnas pa dang*/ la dang ga spel ba ste/ yang lji spel mar gnas pa dang*/ bha dang ga sgrigs pa lan gnyis te/ gsum gyi thog ma lci ba gcig bzhag pa lan gnyis su gnas pa dang*/ ma dang ga spel ba lan gnyis te/ yi ge brgyad ka lci ba dang*/ bha dang ta dang la ga gnyis rnams bsgrigs pa ste/ gsum gyi thog ma lci ba dang*/ gsum gyi tha ma yang ba dang*/ yang ba dang lci ba rnams su gnas par bshad de/ lci yang bzhi pa de 'dra mtshungs/ /la ka bzhi pa de gzhal dpag /gal te bha ga gnyis rkang bkra /gal te ma ga zung glog phreng*/ /bha las ta dang la dang ni/ /ga rnams yod pa bram ze'i bu/ /zhes so/ /de ltar na rtsa rgyud ni/ rjes sngags lnga po de dag gang rung gcig tu yod dam/ nges med ci rigs su yod pa ni/ rgya dpe ma mthong zhing gzhan gyis bshad pa yang ma mthong bas khong du ma chud do/ /rgya bod du byon pa'i rtsa rgyud kyi cha shas kyi gtso bo ni dbang mdor bstan yin te/ dus zhabs pa dang*| dpal nā ro pa'i 'grel pa dang bcas pa yod de/ 'di la yi ge brgyad pa'i mtshan nyid brgya dang don bzhi bzhugs pa la/ /rtsa rgyud kyi 'jig rten khams kyi le'u dum bu re tsam las ma byon la/

rjes sngags kyi mtshan nyid stong phrag bcu gnyis gsungs shing*/ dbang bcu gcig gis mnyam bzhag gcig mgo ru gsung nas/ rtsa yi kun spyod rtsol ba pau/ /mdor bsdus pa yis khyod la bshad| |ces pa ltar rtsa rlung gi thig le'i rnam bzhag rgyas pa dang bcas nas sbyor ba yan lag drug 'bras bu dang bcas pa rgyas par gsungs so/ /gzhan yang khri rgyab kyi rgyan sna drug ston pa'i dum bu sogs phran tshegs 'ga' re yang mthong la/ gtso bor 'grel chen rnams kyi lung du drangs pa ste/ rdo rje snying 'grel dang phyag rdor bstod 'grel gnyis su bgrangs pa 'di na med pa yang 'ga' re snang zhing*/ 'grel chen 'di na bgrangs pa la khams le na tshigs bcad gya bzhi/ nang le na bcu gnyis rkang pas chad pa dbang le la zhe bzhi/ sgrub le na don dgu/ ye le'i mdor bsdus dang po na nyer gsum/ gsum pa na so gcig bzhi pa na lnga ste bsdoms pas lnga bcu nga brgyad/ bsdoms pas nyis brgya dang don gsum tsam snang ste/ lugs 'di la sngar ma grags so/ /le'u snga phyi na mdams pa re tsam dang*/ rtsa rgyud kyi lung yin min cung zad the tshom za ba'ang 'ga' re yod do/ rab tu mdor bstan dang rab tu rgyas bshad kyi mtha' gnyis kyi mtshan gzhi ni lugs 'di la sngar ma grags so/ /dus zhabs pas byas pa'i bsdus brgyud kyi bka' 'grel pad+ma can lta bu ma yin nam zhe na/ ma yin te/ mtha' drug tu bsdu ba'i 'grel pa yin na/ mngon shes dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpas mdzad pa yin dgos pa'i phyir te/ de ni mngon shes thob rnams kyis/ /bya'o mkhas rnams kyis min nyid/ /ces 'byung bas so/ /de dag la brten nas ni mkhas pa gzhan gyis kyang byar rung bas na/ rje btsun re mda' bas/ mngon shes med pas rgyud la bshad pa gtan byar mi rung bar go nas dgag pa byas pas ni/ phyogs snga ma dgongs par zad do/ /mdor bstan chen po'i mtha' ni bsdus rgyud kyi 'grel chen stong phrag bcu gnyis pa 'di yin la/

rgyas bshad chen po'i mtha' ni rtsa rgyud kyi rgya cher 'grel stong phrag drug cu pa sham+bha la na bzhugs pa de yin no/ /de yang 'grel chen 'dis ni bsdus rgyud dbyangs so gnyis dag pa'i mdor bsdus so gnyis kyis 'chad la/ stong phrag drug cu pas ni rtsa rgyud dpe byad brgyad cu dag pa'i gnas pa brgyad cus 'chad pa yin no/ /des na mkhas pa chen po bu ston gyi bsdus rgyud rtsa 'grel gnas pa dang sbyar nas bsdus don nan gyis mdzad pa bzhin du mkhas pa gzhan gyis sbyar ba ni bsgrig par dka' ste/ bsdus rgyud du gnas pa rnams stod smad phyed tshal byas pa dang rim par dkrugs pa sogs du ma yod pas so/ /yod tshul mdor bsdus gnyis par gsungs pa'i gnas pa rnams dang sbyor tshul la bltas pas shin tu gsal bas ma spros so/ /de yang gnas pa gya gcig tu gsal ba ltar byed na gang la brgyan rgyu'i sku dang brgyan byed dpe byad brgyad cu dang bcas par bya la/ brgyad cur byed na/ sgrub le'i gnas pa dang po gnyis gcig tu bgrangs par gsal te/ brjod bya rjod byed shin tu nyung bar snang bas dbye rin ma chog pa'i phyir dang*/ dag pa sbyor ba'ang zung bdun dang skye bdun lta bu la sbyar dgos pas mi 'grig la| gnas pa drug tu byas na/ bskyed rim la bsgrub bya rigs drug dang*/ rdzogs rim la yan lag drug dag par byas pas shin tu bde ba'i phyir ro/ /a yig rnams yin pas de dag la sbyar ba na/ sgrub ler mngal skyes kyi ma'i lus dang sbyar ba'i skabs su/ /ma'i dpral mgrin snying kha lte ba rnams rlung me chu sa lto ba ri rab/ gsang gnas pad+ma mas sna'i rtsa gsum zla nyi sgra gcan lus rim pa [ ril po zer ram ] kun gyi khyab byed du byas so/ 'di ni phyi dang gzhan gnyis dang go rim shin tu 'grig la/ nang ler/ lus kyi sra ba/ dro ba/ gsher ba/ g.yo ba rnams 'byung bzhi/ sgal tshigs ri rab/

lus kyi stod smad bar gsum/ mtho ris sa 'og mi lus gsum du tsam dang*/ snying ka'i rtsa brgyad dang*/ bug pa dgu gza' dang sbyar ba tsam las med pas mi gsal la/ ye le'i re gsum par| lus la rnam pa bcu bshad pa'i skabs su/ skra dang ba spu nam mkha' sha dang lpags pa rlung*/ khrag dang dmar cha me/ rngul dang dri chu chu/ rkang dang rus pa sa| rtsa dang rlung rnams ye shes/ ro rkyang gnyis/ dbu ma'i yas sna dang mas sna rnams nyi ma zla ba sgra gcan dus me ste rdo rje bzhi dang sbyar nas bshad de/ ri rab dang bcud kyi sems can la sbyar ro/ /de ltar na yang*/ phyi dang gzhan kun gyi 'byung bsdud kyi gzhi ni nang lus la gnas la/ de'i yang rtsa ba mthar thug ni/ shin tu phra ba'i sems dang rlung thig le rnams ngo bo gcig tu gyur pa gzhom med gzhi'i dus 'khor/ cha med kun 'gro'i chos dbyings kyi rten du gyur pa 'di nyid yin la/ 'di'i steng na/ lus kyi rlung sogs khams rags pa bzhi dang*/ de rnams 'dus pa'i rtsa rlung rags pa dang*/ nang gi rtsa khams phra ba dang*/ dkar dmar rnam shes ye shes bzhi dang*/ kun la khyab pa'i nam mkha' rnams kyi nus pa khyad par ba'i cha bcu/ rang rang gi chos dbyings dang bcas pa yod pa ni/ nges don bzhi yi rnam bcu dbang ldan yin la/ de rnams las yi ge bcu 'grub ste| de yang phra rim kyis 'grub pas na/ g.yon bskor du brtsams te/ thig le dang tsheg drag dang a yig dang*/ i dang ṛ dang u dang l̥ dang ma dang k+ṣa dang ha rnams dgod par bya la/ ma k+ṣa ha gsum gsal byed srog med yin pas/ gsal byed dbyangs med pha rol yi ge drang ngo zhes pas ha srog med k+ṣa'i steng du dang*| de gnyis srog med pa'i steng du drang*/ de rting*/ tsan+d+ra par ṛka'i aṇa la ra la dgod/ zhes dang*/ kā lā par i'i yi ge 'dra ba'i yi ge ma yin pa ya ste/ pha rol dbyi ba yang ma yin no/ /u'i yi ge wa'o/ ṛ'i yi ge ra'o/
/l̥'i yi ge la'o zhes pas/ li yig

pha rol gyi u mthong bas sa ru bsgyur/ de bzhin du u wa dang*/ ṛ ra dang*/ i ya rnams su bsgyur zhing*/ de rnams kyang sngar bzhin gyi phyi ma'i steng du drangs zhing thams cad a yig gi steng du drangs pa ste a yig srog tu bcug pa'i steng du tsheg drag zla phyed du byas*/ de'i steng du thig le nā das mtshan pa bsnan pas rnam bcu dbang ldan gyi yi ge 'grub pa'o/ /de bcu las sngar bshad pa'i bstan g.yo bcu po tha snyad tsam du 'grub cing*/ de rnams kyang mthar yi ge bcu dang*/ de yang gzhi'i nges don gyi rnam bcu dbang ldan la dang*/ de yang shin tu phra ba'i rlung sems chos can du gyur pa la bsdus nas de tha snyad du thog mtha' med par gnas pa dang*/ las kyi nus pa smin res kyi sngar bzhin 'grub pa dang*/ 'phen pa tshar gcig gi nus pa zad pa na sdud pa yin la/ don dam du de yang spros bral chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin las ma 'das pas/ 'khor 'das don dam du gzhi med dang*/ tha snyad du 'khrul pa'i gzhi dang gnyis ka med bzhin du blun sgom byed pa ma yin par legs par grub pa yin no/ /'o na 'khrul pa gzhi bcas yin na/ zlog par mi 'gyur ro zhe na/ dmigs pa'i gzhi bcas min kyang 'dzin stangs bden grub tu dang*/ rags par 'dzin pa gzhi med yin pas skyon med do/ /de ltar gang gis yang dag rigs pa de ni phyugs min zhes pa blun po min pa shin tu mkhas pa yin la/ snod bcud dang phyi don bden 'dzin gyi kun tu rtogs pa dag las grol te/ rags snang gi rtsa ba rang gi rlung sems la thug par legs par grub pas so/ / gnyis pa ni/ phyogs bzhir zung bdun bkod nas/ de stong chen yig lnga la dang*/ de yang dbus kyi gzhom med la bsdud cing 'byung 'jig byed par sgrub pa yin la/ zung bdun bzhir ma 'dus pa'i phyi nang gi 'jig rten yang med pa yin no/ /de'i tshul ni phyogs rer bdun tshan re re yod pa phyogs gnyis bsdoms pas zung bdun yod pa la zung bdun du grags pa yin no/

/de yang tshigs bcad drug pa bdun pa'i don bsdu na/ dbus su sngags tshigs bcad gnyis pas bshad pa'i stong chen yig lnga ste/ e waṃ gnyis kyi nang nas baṃ yig gi cha shas lnga 'god pa yin la/ de yang dbus su rnam shes sgrib bral chos dbyings ye shes kyi rang bzhin/ wa yig gi khog pa gri gug gi rnam pa nam mkha'i khams dang*/ g.yas sam lho ru tshor ba sgrib bral mnyam nyid ye shes kyi rang bzhin zla phyed kyi rgyu tsheg drag me'i khams dang*/ g.yon nam byang du 'du shes sgrib bral sor rtog ye shes kyi rang bzhin thig le chu'i khams dang*/ mdun nam shar du 'du byed sgrib bral bya grub ye shes kyi rang bzhin wa'i rkang pa dbyug pa'i rnam pa rlung gi khams dang*/ rgyab bam nub tu gzugs phung sgrib bral me long ye shes kyi rang bzhin wa'i mgo bo thong gug gi rnam pa sa khams rnams bgod de rnams bsdus pa las waṃ yig zlum po 'grub pa ni dbyangs dang zla ba'i chos mtha' dag bsdus pas thabs gtso bor gyur pa dang*/ zhar la khams drug gi rang bzhin gsal byed sde pa drug gi re re la mtshon byed stong pa'i thig le dbyug pa'i rnam pa re re ste drug 'byung*/ drug po sa rlung gnyis/ chu me gnyis/ nam mkha' rnam shes gnyis rnams zung gsum du byas te gshibs pa gsum 'byung ba rtse sprad pas e yig gru gsum 'grub pa ni/ gsal byed dang nyi ma'i chos thams cad 'dus pas shes rab gtso bor gyur pa ste rgya gar dha ri'i yi ge la e waṃ gyi dbyibs༈'di bzhin du yod pa legs par 'grub pas 'di'i nang nas da lan e yig nam mkha'i khams thams cad kyi gzhi ru byas nas waṃ yig gi yi ge so so ba lnga po dbus dang phyogs bzhir bkod pa'i de ma thag tu lnga po rang rang gi 'od zer/ byang du dkar po 'bar ba/ lho ru dmar po 'bar ba/ shar du nag po 'bar ba/ nub tu ser po 'bar ba rnams bgod pa dang*/

g.yon du sgra gcan*/ zla ba/ lhag pa/ pa sangs/ 'jug rings/ char pa/ chu rnams/ g.yas su dus me/ nyi ma/ mig dmar/ phur bu/ spen pa/ glogame rnams bgod pa'i sa bon/ nang nas g.yon g.yas gnyis sbyar te/ aṃ aḥ u ṛ/ ū ṛ/ o ar/ au ār/ wa ra/ wā rā rnams yin pa'i bar la su yang rtsod pa med la/ shar nub kyi zung bdun la rtsod pa shin tu che ste/ rwa pa snga mas/ nub tu sa gsum dang rlung bzhi/ shar du rlung gsum dang sa bzhi ste spel nas bgrangs/ de la 'bro pas/ g.yas g.yon gnyis me chu so sor nges pa bzhin du/ nub tu sa dang shar du rlung yong rgyu la spel bas nor zhes dgag pa byas/ rwa pa phyi ma rdo rje rgyal mtshan pas/ 'bro pa'i dgag pa la dag pa byin/ rang lugs/ nub tu skar ma phra rags gnyis/ sa phra rags gnyis/ rdo phra rags gnyis te drug las bgod rgyu ma rnyed pas/ rlung nor las rgyal bsnan/ de rlung yin yang nub tu bgod nyan te/ ma ning du bshad pa'i phyir/ de yang ma ning la pho mo gnyis ka'i chags pa yod cing bya ba byed pa bzhin du sa dang rlung gnyis ka yin pas sa'i nang du bzhag go zhes zer ro/ /'bro pa snga ma dang*/ shong pa dang*/ jo nang pa rnams kyis ser po 'bar ba dang nor las rgyal bgrangs nas gzhan lnga la/ skar ma phra rags gnyis/ lha gzhu/ sa rdo gnyis rnams bgrongs te/ rgyud du rnam bzhi gnyis kyi dbye bas so zhes bshad pas/ rnam bzhi ni/ ser po 'bar ba/ skar ma phra rags/ lha gzhu rnams yin/ gnyis ni sa rdo yin pas so zhes zer/ bu ston rin po ches/ de thams cad 'gog ste/ rwa pa phyi mas lha gzhu la phra rags gnyis byas pa mi 'thad de/ rgya dpe la tshig tu yod kyi gnyis kyi rnam dbye med pas so/ /'bar ba grangs su bgrang ba mi 'thad de/ phyogs gzhan gyi 'bar ba la'ang mtshungs pas so/ /nor las rgyal bgrang ba mi 'thad de/ ma ning la mtshan gnyis 'byung ba bzhin du de'i sa bon k+ṣa yin pa de zung bdun gyi sa bon las logs su bshad pas dang*/

bi bhu tis mi bgrong bar bshad pas so/ / des na snye mdo bas/ sa la sa phra rags gnyis dang*/ rdo phra rags gnyis te bzhi| skar ma la phra rags gnyis te rnam bzhi gnyis su dbye nas lha gzhu bsnan pa shin tu legs par gsungs pa 'di 'dir yang rang lugs su khas blangs par bya'o/ /'o na jo nang phyogs pas/ nor las rgyal mi bgrong na/ khams kyis ma bsdus pa dang*/ stong chen yig lngas de la ma khyab par 'gyur ro zhes skyon brjod pa ji ltar spang zhe na/ 'o na lus dang snod rags pa'ang der thal lo/ / skyon med de/ 'dir bshad pa rnams su 'dus so zhe na/ mtshungs pa nyid do/ / shar du ni/ rlung mnyam gnas dang*/ gyen rgyu dang*/ khyab byed dang*/ rus sbal dang*| klu dang*/ rtsang pa dang*/ lha sbyin rnams 'god la/ rlung bcu'i srog 'dzin nam mkha'i khams pa steng du dang thur sel ye shes yin pas 'og tu 'god/ nor las rgyal ni shi ba'i lus la yang 'byung bas ma ning yin pas phyir skabs 'dir grangs su mi 'dzud pa yin no/ steng 'og gi rlung gnyis kyi sa bon ni ha hā yin la/ shar nub kyi zung bdun gyi sa bon ni/ shar dang nub kyi dang po nas re re spel te rim pa bzhin/ a ā/ i l̥̄/ ī l̥̄/ e al/ ya la/ yā lā rnams yin la/ 'di'i mthar k+ṣa yig byung ba ni sngar bshad pa ltar nor las rgyal gyi sa bon yin te/ sa bon 'di rnams bshad sngon de ma thag tu rlung bcu bgrangs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na kha cig nor las rgyal gyi sa bon ma yin gyi/ 'og tu rdo rje sems dpa'i yul yig lnga waṃ yig dang yig drug e yig yin pa bzhin du/ rdo rje yan lag med pa'i yul la yig lnga haṃ yig dang*/ yig drug k+ṣa yig tu bshad pa'i k+ṣa yig yin no zhes zer ba ni mi rigs te/ de ltar na sa bon 'di rnams kyi nang zhig tu haṃ yig kyang 'byung bar rigs te/ rgyu mtshan khyad med pa k+ṣa yig byung 'dug pas so/ /des na ma ning ma yin pa rnams kyi sa bon thams cad dbyangs su 'dug pa/

ma ning de'i sa bon gsal byed 'dus pa'i k+ṣa yig de byung bar gsal lo/ /de ltar phyogs bzhi'i yi ge nyer brgyad po thams cad res gza' bdun gyi lhag pa'i lhar bshad de/ nyin zhag phrugs gcig gi thun mtshams bzhi la gling bzhi ru 'char ba'i phyir te/ gling 'dir de ring res gza' spen pa la yod pa'i do nub mtshan phyed kyi dus su gza' nyi ma shar lus 'phags po na shar te/ de na snga gro'i dus yin pas so/ /'di'i nam langs pa'i dus na lho ru shar te/ gling rang rang gi res gza' shar ba'i dang po nam langs yin pas so| |'dir nyi ma phyed pa'i dus nub tu shar te/ ba longs spyod kyi snga dro yin pas so/ /'dir sa sros kyi dus su byang du 'char te/ sgra mi snyan pa'i snga dro yin pas so/ /de bzhin du zla ba sogs drug la sbyor/ 'dir res gza' 'pho mtshams nam phyed kyi dus yin pas bstan zhes lho pa grub seng zer yang mi 'thad de/ 'dzam bu gling gi nam phyed na shar lus 'phags por res gza' dang po shar ba'i phyir ro zhes par song la/ de ltar na nyin phyed dang sa sros mtshams yin par yang 'gyur te/ 'di'i dus de gnyis la rim pa bzhin ba longs spyod dang sgra mi snyan du dang po shar bas so/ /des na 'dis gling rang rang gi res gza' rang rang gi snga dro bu ston gyi gsung gi zin bris byang mchogagi byas par nyi ma phyed 'pho gsung bar snang*/ dang por 'pho zhes bstan la gling bzhi ka'i bsdoms na zhag gcig la res gza' dang por 'char dus bzhi yod ces bstan to/ /shugs la sa dum bu bcu gnyis la ltos te bcu gnyis su yang 'gyur mod de*/ 'dir zung bdun gyi sa bon nyer brgyad res gza' bdun gyi 'char dus bzhi la sbyar ba yin no/ / de yang nyi ma'i gzhi la rim pa bzhin du a aḥ ā aṃ/ de bzhin du zla ba'i i ṛ l̥ u/ mig dmar gyi ī ṝ l̥̄ u/ lhag pa'i e ar al o/

phur bu'i ai ār al au de bzhi ring po/ pa sangs kyi ya ra la wa/ spen pa'i yā rā la wā de bzhin ring po rnams sbyar ro/ /de ltar zung bdun gyi rnam gzhag gi nges don bstan bya'i gtso bo gang yin zhe na/ dngos su khyab bya/ phyogs bzhi'i rlung me chu sa/ steng 'og gi nam mkha' ye shes rnams kyi bstan pa'i chos sum cu la/ khyab byed/ gzhom med kyi stong pa lnga po 'od zer dang bcas pas khyab ste/ gzhom med kyi brda'i yi ge lnga pos sa bon gyi yi ge sum cu po thams cad la khyab pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes pa'i don ni kun tu ye shes dang ni stong pa zhi ba gnas dang bcas pa zhes pas bstan to/ ston tshul kha cig 'dis dbus kyi yi ge lnga las waṃ grub tshul bshad zer ba dang*/ kha cig sngags kyi sa bon rnams la thig les brgyan pa dgos par bstan la/ des bskyed rdzogs kyi gnad chen po bstan zhes pa zer yang ma yin te| 'grel par/ phyi rol gyi yi ge'i chos thams cad la rkang pa dang mgo bor rlung dang sa dag grangs ji lta ba bzhin no zhes bshad pas/ dbus kyi waṃ yig mtshan ma'i yi ge lnga las bsgrubs nas/ mgo bo sa rkang pa rlung*/ lus kyi khog pa nam mkha' steng gi zla phyed me/ thig le chu/ nā da ye shes su yod pa bzhin du/ zung bdun steng 'og gnyis dang bcas pa'i sa bon gyi yi ge sngar bshad pa rnams la yang de bzhin byas pas zla phyed dang thig les brgyan par gyur pa'i dpe brjod dngos su bstan pa yin no/ /de ltar na khyab pa'i don/ des de la dbang bsgyur zhes pa tsam dang*/ thams cad mthar waṃ yig la/ sdud ces pa tsam min pa/ ngo bo gcig pa'i tshul gyis khyab pa yin la/ de ltar bshad pas/ nges don bzhi'i ye shes lnga pos bzhi'i khams lnga'am drug gi bsdus pa'i chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ngo bo dbyer med du dang*/ lam dang 'bras bu la yang de bzhin du sbyar bas/ snod bcud du dang lam 'bras kyi snang ba thams cad ye shes lnga'i rnal rol dang 'od zer 'phro ba las byung zhing*/

gzhom med kyi 'gyur med lnga'i rtsa ba can du rtogs nas spyir tha mal gyi snang zhen phra rags dang khyad par can snod bcud kyis ma dag pa'i snang ba la mtshan mar 'dzin pa log nas rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi stong chen yig lnga'i rang bzhin mngon du byed par 'dod pa'i don gnyer khyad par can bskyed pa'i ched du kho bos rtogs so/ / gsum pa ni/ phyi nang gzhan gsum thams cad bden don bcu gnyis dang*| de nyid bcu drug tu gnas te phyi ma nyi ma'i khyim bcu gnyis dang dus sbyor bcu gnyis/ gling bzhi spyi la gnas dang nye ba'i gnas sogs bcu gnyis dgos 'dzam bu gling la sa dum bu bcu gnyis/ nang la lte ba'i rtsa 'dab bcu gnyis/ bu ga bcu gnyis/ rlung 'pho ba bcu gnyis/ rten 'brel bcu gnyis/ lus la gnas sogs bcu gnyis mang du sbyar ba/ rdo rje snying 'grel nas sems can skye ba la rten 'brel bcu gnyis/ gzhan bskyed rim la/ steng sgo dang sgo khyud rta babs sogs bcu gnyis/ brtan pa la rten 'brel bcu gnyis sbyor ba/ bsnyen sgrub bzhi la dman 'bring mchog gsum du dbye ba rdzogs rim la'ang de dang sbyor drug la stong gzugs dang bde chen yul yul can du dbye ba sogs 'bras bu la sa bcu gnyis rdzogs pa sogs yin pas so/ /de thams cad la nges don gyi rdo rje nyi ma'i snang ba ches khyab pa dang*/ yang phyi la zla ba'i cha bcu drugades bzhag pa'i tshes bcu drug nang na thig le'i gnas bcu drug 'pho mtshams bcu drug de gnyis kyis bzhags pa'i thig le bcu drug rtsa so gnyis la dkar phyogs dang nag phyogs su phye ba'i bcu drug pa gnyis/ spu lpags pa/ sha khrag rus pa/ rtsa/ rkang*/ khu ba rnams la phra rags gnyis gnyis te khams bcu drug mtshan phyed nas nyin phyed kyi bar du rlung rgyu ba rnams dkar phyogs bskyed rim gyi 'pho ba bco lnga dang*/ de'i mthar bcu drug pa/ nyin phyed nas mtshan phyed kyi bar nag phyogs kyi 'pho ba bco lnga ste/

rlung 'pho ba bcu drug dbang dang lam la dga' ba bzhi la re re yang bzhi bzhi phye ba'i bcu drug dang*/ stong pa nyid dang de kho na nyid dang*/ snying rje rnams bcu drug 'bras bu la sku bcu drug la sogs pa yin la/ de thams cad la nges don gyi rdo rje zla ba dri med 'od kyis legs par khyab pa'i tshul ni tshigs bcad brgyad pas 'chad la/ de'i tshul ni/ dang por rdo rje zla ba'i chos bshad na/ dkar nag re re la'ang cha bcu drug bcu drug ste tshes dga' ba/ bzang po/ rgyal ba/ stong pa/ rdzogs pa ste lnga ni/ nam mkha' rlung me chu sa'i rang bzhin rim pa ltar yin la/ de lnga yar ngo la tshar gsum dang*/ mar ngo la tshar gsum 'char ba rnams la/ dang po/ gnyis pa/ gsum pa zhes bya ste/ dper na yar ngo'i tshes gcig ni/ yar ngo'i dga' ba dang po/ tshes drug ni yar ngo'i dga' ba gnyis pa/ bcu gcig ni yar ngo'i dga' ba gsum pa zhes bya la/ de bzhin du bzang po sogs la'ang sbyar zhing*/ mar ngo la'ang 'don pa spo'o/ /de dag ni cha rags pa bco lnga yin la*/ gnyis ka'i mtha' ru cha bcu drug pa re re byed pa ni cha bcu drug pa ste/ 'di brtag gnyis su/ gang phyir bcu drug cha med pas| |'bad pas kun gyi lhag ma spangs/ /zhes bdag med lha mo bco lnga las mi yong ba'i rgyu mtshan du bshad pa'i dngos bstan lta bus 'khrul nas don steng na med kyi blos bzo ba yin no/ /zhes zer ba mang mod kyi/ don la yod de/ tshes bco lnga'i zla ba nub ba glang spyod kyi dbus drang po rang du ma sleb tsam na/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor shar lus 'phags pa'i dbus drang por re 'ga' yang ma sleb pa yod pas/ zla ba'i shar du

zla ba dgos pa srang ba'i shar yin gyi/ gling gi shar min no/ 'dun nam sha ra| zhes bshad la/ nyi ma'i 'od zer cung zad phog pas ma gang la/ de nas nyi ma rlung 'gros mgyogs pas/ zla bas nub kyi drang po sleb pa na/ nyi mas kyang shar gyi drang por sleb nas/ nyi ma'i 'od zer cung zad kyang mi reg pa'i tshes nya gang ba'i mthar thug pas tshes bco lnga legs par rdzogs/ de nas nyi mas shar lho'i zur du sleb pa na zla bas nub byang gi zur du sleb ma nus par zla ba'i nub rgyab bam nub zhes bshad pas zla ba'i nub yin kyang nub gling gi shar ngos su nyi ma'i 'od zer reg pa zhes pa'i tha snyad dgos so/ zur na nyi ma'i 'od zer phra mo phog ma thag nag po'i tshes gcig gi mgo rtsom la/ de gnyis kyi bar du ri rab kyi nyi ma bsgribs nas/ zla ba la nyi ma'i 'od zair phog 'phro rdzogs nas rting la phog pa'i bar skabs yod pa'i phyir dang*| nag phyogs la yang*/ nyi zla ya yo med par drang thad rang du nam sleb ma thag nag po'i bco lnga zad cing*/ yang nyi ma mgyogs pas/ nub tu cung zad thal| zla ba'i nub tu rang gi kha khyer gyi grib ma shin tu phra ba'i mgo brtsams ma thag nas/ dkar phyogs kyi mgo brtsams pas/ de gnyis kyi bar skabs de nag po'i bcu drug par grub pa'i phyir dang*/ spyir cha 'jig rten spyi 'gro la ltos pa'i shar nub yin zer/ bcu drug pa phyi na med na/ nang lus la yang cha bcu drug med par 'gyur la| de gnyis med na/ gzhan yi ge la dbyangs bcu drug pa dang*/ lam la snying rje sogs bcu drug pa dang*/ 'bras bu la sku dang ye shes bcu drug med par yang 'gyur bas so/ /'o na brtag gnyis sogs su med par bshad pa ci zhe na/ de ni tshes gzhan bco lnga po dang yun tshad mnyam pa'i rags pa med pa la dgongs nas rags rtsis mdzad pa'o/ /de ltar na dkar phyogs kyi cha rnams khams dang yi ge bskyed rim gyi mthar thig le dang*/
