nag phyogs kyi cha rnams sdud rim gyi mthar rnam dpyad sbyar te yar ngo zla ba dang mar ngo'i nyi ma'i chos yin pas so/ / de yang yar ngo'i yi ge thung ngu dang mar ngo'i yi ge ring po'o/ /yar ngo'i lnga tshan gsum yang rim pa bzhin du mun pa dang rdul dang snying stobs kyi rang bzhin yin pas rtsa ba dang rang byung gi yi ge a i ṛ u l̥/ de'i yon tan a e ar o al*| rtsa ba'i yaṇar bsgyur ba ha ya ra wa la rnam rim pa bzhin du sa bon du 'gyur zhing*/ mar ngo'i lnga tshan gsum ni yon tan snying stobs rdul mun gsum la zer/ gsum yang zlog pas/ yan ring po lnga dang*/ yon tan gyi 'phel ba lnga dang*/ rang byung ring po lnga rnams te/ lā wā rā yā hā/ āl au ār ai ā l̥̄ ū ṝ ā+-i ā rnams so/ /slar yang yon tan gsum po re re yang chung 'bring chen po gsum du bya zhing*/ dkar phyogs la mun pa gsal ba zhes pa dang*/ nag phyogs la mun pa 'jug pa zhes pa'i tha snyad byas la/ tshes re re yang*/ bu mo dang gzhon nu dang*/ lang tsho dang rgan mo dang smin pa zhes pa lnga lnga tshang ba dang*/ de re re yang chung ngu dang 'bring dang chen po'i tshad gsum gsum rdzogs pa na nub nas phyogs gzhan gyi cha dang por 'jug pa yin no/ /dper na/ tshes gcig gi zla ba'i dkar cha gyu tsam de nyid/ tshes gcig la mun pa'i mun pa bsal ba chung ngu'i bu mo/ tshes gnyis kyi nyin mun pa'i mun pa gsal ba chung ngu'i gzhon nu ma/ de bzhin du tshes gsum bzhi lnga rnams la de'i lang tsho rgan mo smin pa zhes bya la/ tshes drug nas bcu'i bar la 'bring po'i lnga/ bcu gcig nas bco lnga'i bar chen po'i lnga rdzogs nas/ mar ngo'i tshes gcig la de nyid snying stobs kyi mun pa 'jug pa dang po'i bu mor 'gyur zhing*/ sngar bzhin du sbyar bas yar ngo'i tshes gcig shar ba dang sngar gyi de nyid du zlog go /de bzhin du tshes gnyis la sogs pa re nas sbyar te/

tshes drug gi zla ba'i cha kho rang gi thob bya de nyid*/ tshes de la/ rdul gyi mun pa bsal ba chung ngu'i bu mo sogs sbyar nas/ tshes nyi shu la/ rdul gyi mun pa bsal ba chen po'i smin par gyur nas nyer gcig la rdul gyi mun pa 'jug pa chung ngu'i bu mor gyur pa dang*/ tshes bcu gcig gi cha de nyid/ tshes de la snying stobs kyi mun pa bsal ba chung ngu'i tshad kyi bu mo yin pa sogs sbyar bar bya'o// de ltar na zla ba'i dkar cha ni/ nub nas rim gyis bsags nas shar du cha rdzogs par 'gyur zhing*/ cha bcu drug pa rtsom pa dang mnyam du sgra gcan 'jug pas zla ba gzas 'dzin na shar nas 'dzin par khyab par bu ston rin po che'i gsung pa ni legs la/ bla ma des nag cha shar nas bsags nas nub tu rdzogs pas nyi ma nub nas 'dzin pas khyab ces gsung pa ni mi rigs te/ tshes gcig gi cha de zla ba'i nub nyid na je gsal du song nas gnas yod pa de/ tshes bcu drug la mun pa 'jug pa yin par rang gis bshad pa'i khas blangs dang*/ de las ma 'das pa'i rigs pa dang 'gal bas so/ /des na rang lugs ni/ dkar cha nag cha gnyis ka rtsom pa nub dang rdzogs pa shar du khyad med pa yin no/ zla ba'i nag cha nub tu rdzogs na nyi shu dgu'i zla ba'i gras kha'i 'gyur de nub tu bstan zhing nyi ma'i phyogs la sgyur gyi kha bltas yong bar thal ba las mngon sum gyis gsal lo/ kha cig gong gi cha bcu drug pa'i sgrub byed mi 'thad de/ nyi mas sa gzhi la gling bzhi'i phyed las lhag pa gsal mi nus pa bzhin du/ nam mkha' la yang rgyu skar gyi phyed las lhag pa gsal mi nus pas tshes bco lnga la nyi ma'i 'od zla ba la reg par 'dod pa mi 'thad pas so zhe na/ skyon med de/ sa gzhi la gling bzhi'i phyed las gsal mi nus pa nam mkha' dang sa gzhi'i bar 'gyangs ches pas yin pa'i phyir te/ nyi ma'i gnas nas drang thad kyi sa gzhi'i bar la yang rgyu skar 'khor lo'i phyed kyi thag tsam yod pas so/

/'o na zla ba 'phel 'grib tu snang ba'i rgyu ci yin zhe na/ chos mngon pa las/ nyi ma dang nye ba las rang gi grib ma che ru 'gro bas sgrib la/ nyi ma'i 'od zer phog pa'i cha mthong bar bshad zer ba dang*/ kha cig nyi ma'i 'od zer phog pas mthong na/ bco lnga'i mtshan phyed na nyi ma ri rab kyi byang drang thad na yod par yin par 'gyur ba dang*/ skar ma nyin par mthong bar gsal ba sogs kyis gnod pas/ zla ba'i kha khyer gyi grib ma phog pa'i cha de mthong la/ nyi ma dang nye ru song nas grib ma de je chung du 'grib pas gnam gang la/ nyi ma'i 'od zer rdzogs par babs pas mi mthong ba yin no zhes 'dod pa dang*/ kha cig de gnyis ka la/ nyi mas rgyu skar gyi 'khor lo'i phyed las lhag pa mi mthong ba'i rigs pas gnod pas/ me long gi steng du snam spu'i ras ma bcu drug rim gyi bsgrigs nas bzhag pa bzhin du sa'i rdul lta bu'i rdul gyis sgrib pa chos nyid kyi rigs pa ma gtogs rgyu mtshan med ces zer yang*/ de thams cad kyi nang gi rgyu mtshan cung zad kyang ma 'byor pas/ kho bo ni 'di ltar sems te/ spyir snang ba thams cad nang gi rtsa rlung dang des sad pa'i bag chags kyi dbang gis yin la/ khyad par zla ba'i 'char nub lta bu ni 'gro ba kun la mtshungs par med de/ lha phal cher la nyi zla mi snang zhing snang ba rnams la'ang zla ba'i 'phel grib med pas/ mi dang dud 'gro'i dgos chos yin| mi yang 'dzam gling chen po las kyi sa pa'i yin gyi nang gi gling drug gi mi la nyi zla'i 'char nub med par bshad do/ /des na las kyi sa pa'i khams drug ldan la zla ba 'phel 'grib tu snang ba ni/ rlung la sbyar na g.yas g.yon gyi 'pho rlung gi steng na ye shes kyi rlung zhag re la drug brgya don lnga re chad pa'i steng nas zla ba'i bu lon la ye shes re bzhi cha de'i cha re las med kyang nyi ma'i bu lon la so gnyis cha yod par bshad la/

nang gi nyi ma ni g.yas 'pho dang*/ g.yon 'pho ni zla ba yin pas/ de gnyis kyi myur bul gyi khyad kyis phyi ru yang de ltar byung ba yin no/ /de las kyang nang gi dkar cha'i 'phel 'grib kyi dbang gis yin te*/ nang gi zla ba ni dkar cha dang dmar cha ni nyi ma yin par kun la grags shing*/ phyi'i nyi ma'i nye ring gi dbang gis zla ba la 'phel 'grib 'byung ba 'di yang nang gi nyi mas zla ba mnyam par byas pa yin la/ de'i tshul ni/ sgrub le'i brgya nyer lnga par bshad pa bzhin du/ lus kyi g.yon phyogs kyi gnas bco lnga la thig le mas rim gyis yar 'gro ba dang*/ g.yas kyi gnas bco lnga la yas rim gyis mar 'gro bar gzhung gzhan nas kyang bshad la/ de yang 'jam dpal zhal lung sogs nas tshul gzhan du bshad kyang*/ 'dir rkang pa'i sor tshigs gsum/ long bu/ dpus mo/ dpy-i'i tshigs gsum/ lag pa'i sor tshigs gsum/ 'khrig ma/ dpung pa/ phrag pa'i tshigs gsum/ snying kha/ mgrin pa/ dpral ba'i tshigs rnams ni gnas bco lnga ste/ de yang yar ngo'i tshes gcig la rkang pa g.yon pa'i tshigs mtha' ma/ tshes gnyis la/ tshigs bar ma sogs rim gyis sbyar nas tshes bco lnga la dpral bar sleb nas nya gang ba'i mtha' cha bcu drug pa la gtsug tor du 'gro zhing*/ bcu drug pa rdzogs pa na/ gtsug tor nas 'ongs nas mar ngo'i tshes gcig la/ dpral ba gnyis pa la mgrin pa sogs sngar gyi lugs zlog g.yas la 'ongs nas tshes bco lnga la rkang pa g.yas kyi tshigs tha mar sleb nas gnam stong rdzogs pa'i mthar cha bcu drug pa la sen mo'i rtse'i bar du 'gro zhes gsungs pa 'di'i steng nas legs par shes dgos sa de yang 'di ltar gnas de dang der 'gro zhes pas thig le ri lu lta bu gcig gnas gnyis par 'phos pa na/ dang po'i gnas su gtan med du song ba lta bu ni 'ong don med do/ /de ltar na yar ngo la 'phel ba dang*/ mar ngo la 'grib pa'i khyad par mi 'thad pa'i phyir ro/

/des na yar ngo'i tshes gcig la rkang sor gyi tshigs mtha' mar tshes gcig gi zla ba'i cha tsam skya khyug pa gcig shar ba de/ tshes gnyis la gnas de dang tshigs bar pa gnyis kar du tshes gnyis kyi zla ba'i dkar cha tsam re shar/ tshes gsum la de gnyis dang rtsa ba'i tshigs gsum char du tshes gsum gyi dkar cha tsam du 'gyur ba nas gzung ste/ tshes bco lnga la dpral ba'i bar gyi gnas bco lnga po thams cad du nya gang ba'i tshul gyis rdzogs shing*| zla ba phyed po de'i bar du g.yon phyogs kyi dkar cha rnams rim gyis 'gribs shing g.yas phyogs dmar cha kho nas gang nas dkar cha mi mngon par gyur pa yin no/ /de nas cha bcu drug pa rdzogs pa'i mthar dkar cha g.yas kyi phyogs la bab par brtsams pa na/ dpral bar dkar cha'i cha cung zad nyams pa dang dus mnyam du/ rkang pa g.yon gyi tsh-igs phreng tha ma'i cha nas kyang cung zad nyams te tshes bcu drug gi zla ba bzhin du gyur/ de bzhin du g.yas phyogs kyi dkar cha mar babs rim gyis chung ngu 'gyur ba bzhin du g.yon gyi dkar cha yar 'dzegs rim gyis je chung du gyur te/ gnam gang la lus kyi phyogs gnyis ka'i dkar cha rnams dmar chas non nas mi snang bar 'gyur te/ nyi ma kho na 'byung la 'di'i mthar dmar cha la dang*/ snga ma'i mthar dkar cha la nang gi sgra gcan dbu ma la 'jug pa'i skabs khyad par ba cig yod par sems so/ /de lta na| gnam gang la gnas thams cad dmar chas gang ba bzhin du bco lnga la dkar chas gang bar rigs mod/ bco lnga lus kyi g.yas phyogs mtha' dag dmar por mi 'thad do zhe na/ de nyid kyi tshes bco lnga'i nub mo gling bzhi'i phyed nyi mas khyab cing zla ba mthong ba yin la/ gnam gang gi nyin zhag la ni/ gling bzhi mtha' dag na zla ba mi snang bar 'grub pa yin pas/ nang gi nyi zla'i 'char nub kyi dbang gi phyi rol gyi nyi zla'i 'char nub dang 'phel 'gribs grub pa yin te| sngon chad gangs ri'i khrod du mngon du ma gyur pa'i phyi nang gi rdo rje nyi zla'i rnam bar bzhag pa 'di lha dang bla ma la gsol ba btab pas legs par rnyed pa ni skal ba bzang zhes gtam du brjod par bya'o/

/'di'i mtshon nas/ las mthun snang du bsags pas bag chags mthun zhing de'i dbang gi nang gi rlung dang byang sems kyi gnas tshul mthun pa dag la phyi rol gyi snang ba mthun par 'char ba yin no zhes yid ches par bya ste rgyas par spros pas chog go /da ni rdo rje nyi ma'i chos bcu gnyis kyi 'phel 'grib dang sa bon gyi yi ge cung zad brjod na| zla ba'i chos de nyid bcu drug zla ba re re la sbyar dgos pa bzhin du nyi ma'i chos bden don rnam pa bcu gnyis lo re la gtso bor sbyar dgos pas/ lo gcig la khyim mam dus sbyor bcu gnyis de re re la zhag sum cu sum cu bsdoms pas zhag gsum brgya drug bcu/ de yang sdu na byang bgrod dang lho bgrod kyi bgrod pa gnyis su 'dus te/ bgrod pa re la khyim drug re dang zhag brgya dang brgyad cu re yod pas so/ /de yang khyim gyi rnam gzhag rgyas pa gcig 'og tu 'chad dgos pas/ 'dir skabs su bab pa tsam brjod na kar seng bu mo gsum| srang sdig gzhu gsum po lho bgrod kyi khyim yin te*/ dbyar nyi log nas dgun nyi ldog ldog gi bar gyi khyim yin pas so/ /chu srin bum pa nya gsum/ lug glang 'khrig gsum rnams byang bgrod kyi khyim yin te dgun nyi ldog nas dbyar nyi ldog ldog gi bar yin pas so/ /de yang da lta dus sbyor gyi rtsis dang nyi ma ldog mtshams ma mthun pa byung ba ni/ gzhung nas bshad pa kai la sha'i dbang du byas la/ 'dir bod kyi nyi ma ldog mtshams ma mthun pa yin la zhib par na 'dzam gling la/ yul dum bu drug dang de rnams la nyin mtshan 'phel 'grib kyi yun tshad byang nas rim pa bzhin du lnga cha dang*/ drug cha dang bdun cha dang brgyad cha dang dgu cha dang bcu char bshad pa'i khyad par yin la/ dum bu drug pa ni/ gangs ldan chen po dang*/ sham+bha la'am/ kai la sha dang*/ rgya nag dang*/ li yul dang*| bod dang*/ 'phags yul rnams so/

de ltar lho bgrod drug la/ gsal byed ka tsa ṭa ta pa rnams kyi sde pa re re zhing lnga pa nas bgrangs pa'i yi ge re re la| dbyangs la a i ṛ u l̥ aṃ ste drug drug tu sbyar/ de yang gsal byed re re la dbyangs thung ngu zhugs pa ste/ dper na nga ngi ngu ng-i ngaṃ zhes sogs sde pa re re'i sum cu sum cus zla re spyod la/ byang bgrod drug la/ dbyangs thig le can gyi tshab tu tsheg drag can bcug la/ dbyangs ring por byas pa snga ma las zlog nas sdud rim bzhin dang*/ gsal byed kyang sa sde nas mgo btsugs shing*/ re re'i yang dang po nas sdud rim du byas pa'i gsal byed nyis brtsegs byas te/ dper na| s+sāṃḥ s+suḥ s+s-iḥ s+s-iḥ s+sīḥ s+sāḥ zhes sogs sbyar ba'i sum cu pa drug gi zhag re la spyod pa yin te/ mdor na lho bgrod la dbyangs gsal thams cad spro rim dang*/ byang bgrod la sdud rim du sbyar ba'o/ /de'i rgyu mtshan yang*| spyir nyin mtshan gnyis kyi mtshan mo zla ba'am thabs kyi chos dang*/ nyin mo nyi ma'i shes rab kyi chos yin la/ lho bgrod la mtshan mo 'phel zhing byang bgrod la nyin mo 'phel ba'i phyir dang*/ zla ba'i chos la spro rim dang nyi ma'i chos la sdud rim du 'byung ba nges pa yin phyir dang*/ gsal byed kyang re re la zla ba dang*| nyis rtseg nyi ma yin zhing*/ dbyangs kyang thung ngu zla ba dang ring po nyi ma yin zhing*/ zhar la shin tu ring po gsum yun can lta bu rnams sgra gcan yin/ spyir dbyangs zla ba dang*/ gsal byed nyi ma yin pa sogs nges pas/ gsal byed gcig la dbyangs thung ngu zhugs pa zla nyi sbyar ba yin kyang dbyangs thung ring la ltos pa'i cha nas zla ba rkyang pa/ gsal byed nyis rtseg la dbyangs ring po zhugs pa nyi ma rkyang pa des mtshon nas gzhan la'ang sbyar ba'ang bshad do/ /de ltar sa bon nam yi ge rnams tshes de dag la 'char zhing sa bon byed zhes pa'ang*/ 'og dbyangs 'char nas 'byung ba bzhin du/

tshes de dag gi dus kyi nang gi rlung rnams de ltar 'char bar bshad pa bzhin du nang gi rlung gi byed las phyi ru spyir dus sbyor che chung 'char zhing khyad par khyim rnams kyi tshes kyi yi ge 'char bas/ gtso bor gzhan yi ge dang phyi nang sbyar pa'i phyi nang gzhan gsum gyi rnam gzhag yin la/ 'dir zla nyi sgra gcan gsum po thung ring shin tu ring por bshad pa la/ bu ston rin po ches/ 'di rnams kyi nor gyi cha rnams zlog nas gnas kyang*/ bu lon gyi dbang gis yin te/ zhag re'i ye shes cha'i drug cu rtsa bzhi cha dang*/ so gnyis cha dang*/ bcu drug cha rim bzhin gyi bu lon du yod pas so zhes gsungs nas de'i rgyu mtshan ma bshad kyang*/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni/ g.yon dang g.yas dang mnyam rgyu'i rlung gsum rgyu ba dal myur bas yin no/ /de ltar na phyi'i dus sbyor dang nang gi dus sbyor thams cad gtso bor khams drug dang yi ge'i nang nas gsal byed gtso bo che bas/ stong pa yig drug gtso bo che zhing*/ snga ma rdo rje zla ba'i chos ni phung po dang dbyangs gtso che bas stong chen yig lnga gtso bor gyur pa yin mod kyi snga ma la bcu drug cha yod pas gnyis ka sbyor ba bzhin du 'di la'ang dbyangs dang phung po'i chos kyang yod pas gnyis ka sbyor bar shes par bya'o/ /de ltar na 'di gnyis kyang stong chen yig lnga dang thig le yig drug gis khyab bya las ma 'das so/ /de gnyis ka la sbyar du rung ba'i zhag re'i chu tshod drug cu la ni| ha ya ra wa la lnga la dbyangs sngar gyi bcu gnyis po spro rim dang*/ sdud rim du sbyar nas mtshan mo 'phel ba la dbyangs thung ngu spro rim sbyar ba sum cu/ nyi ma phyed nas mtshan phyed kyi bar gyi chu tshod sum cu

ha hi hri hu h+li haṃzhes pa la l̥ l̥r lu ll̥ laṃ/ la spyodacing nam phyed nas nyin phyed kyi bar la yang de nyid skyar nas spyod la/ nyin mo 'phel ba la dbyangs ring po sdud l+lāṃḥll̥̄ḥl+lul+la l+lā/ ha h-i h+la ha hū h-i hra ha hi hā ha hā rnams mtshan phyed nas spyod 'grel pa na 'di bzhin/ rim gyis mtshan phyed nyin phyed kyi bar la spyod cing de bzhin du skyar nas spyod de/ 'o na zhag re la nyin mtshan gyi chos dang zla nyi dang thabs shes ma tshang bar mi 'gyur ram zhe na/ thung ngu thabs kyi cha yang lus kyi sgo nas yin gyi bsam pa'i cha nas shes rab yin la/ ring po de las zlog pas so/ /de ltar na zhag re la yang nyi zla dbyangs gsal thabs shes sbyar bas gzhi'i rdo rje zla nyi legs par gnas pa yin la/ nyi zla'i 'char nub dang 'phel 'grib phyi nang du 'byung ba'i phra rags 'di thams cad kyang*/ rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi rlung sems kyi 'pho 'gyur mtha' dag bcom pa na/ sgrib bral gyi rdo rje nyi zla dang e waṃ dang rnam bcu dbang ldan mngon du gyur par shes par bya'o/ / gnyis pa ni/ dbyangs gsal gyi khams dang 'byung ba'i gnas rnams gang zhe na/ 'dir tshigs bcad dgu pa dang*/ sgrub le'i sngags bzlas pa'i rnam gzhag gi skabs dang*/ ye le'i tshigs bcad drug pa sogs kyis gsungs pa'i don bsdu na/ dbyangs kyi a yig gis/ de rang gi ring po dang yon tan dang 'phel ba dang*/ yaṇar bsgyur ba thams cad mtshon par byed pas 'byung ba'i gnas dang khams rnams gcig ste/ dper na/ a dang de'i ring po ā dang yon tan a e ar o al gyi nang tshan gyi a dang*/ 'phel ba ā ai ār au āl gyi nang tshan gyi ā dang*/ yaṇar bsgyur ba ha ya ra wa la'i nang tshan gyi ha ring thung rnams gcig pa'o/ /de bzhin du is kyang*/ ī dang e dang ai dang ya ring thung sogs so/ /de bzhin du uta kyis sde dang bcas pa'o/ /zhes bshad pas/

ku zhes pas ka sde dang*/ tsu zhes pas tsa sde sdud pa sogs yin la/ sa sde so sor phral nas sbyor dgos pas bsdoms tshig tu brjod na/ a ku ha tha mgrin 'byung ba'i gnas mgrin pa khams nam mkha' gnas kyi rtsa ba gtsug tor kha dog ljang*/ pa las/ i tsu ya sha rkan/ ṭu ra ṣa spyi bo las/ /u su wa k+pa mchu las 'byung*/ /l̥ tu la sa so las te| |rjes su sna ldan sna las kyang*/ /zhes par 'du la/ 'di la ni yaṇar bsgyur ba rnams kyang a yig sogs las zur du byas pa'o/ /rjes su sna ldan ni sde pa'i lnga pa rnams dang klad kor gyi ming yin la/ tsheg drag ni ka dang kha'i steng du bzhag pa ni/༵༵ ྈྐ zhes pa lce rtsa can du grags la/ pa dang pha'i steng du bzhag pa ni/ ྉྤ zhes pa mchu can du grags pa ste/ de gnyis gang nas 'byung ni bshad zin la/ tsheg drag can gzhan rnams ni grogs kyi dbang gis ra dang pa gang rung du 'dus pa yin/ de dag gi khams ni/ mgrin pa dang*/ rkan dang*/ spyi bo dang*/ mchu dang*| so las 'byung ba rnams rim pa bzhin du nam mkha' rlung me chu sa'i khams yin la/ spyir pa sde zur du bgrangs nas ye shes kyi khams gnas gsang gnas kha dog sngon po/ de dang dbyangs gsal gyi ha sogs lnga yang ye shes kyi khams su bshad la/ gnas kyi rtsa ba ni/ mgrin 'byung sogs sde lnga po rim pa bzhin du/ gtsug gtor/ snying kha mgrin pa/ dpral ba/ lte ba rnams kyis 'khor lo rnams yin par gsungs te/ bzlas pa byed pa'i tshes skye gnas dang khams kyi steng nas rang gi ming yig dang po dang dgra grogs phal gsum brtsi bar bya la/ bsgom pa'i tshe 'khor lo de rnams su bskyed rim gyi phung po lnga dang khams lnga'i lhag pa'i lhar gshegs pa gshegs ma sogs dang ldan par/ kha dog rim pa bzhin ljang nag dmar dkar ser ba dang*/ khams drug pa byed na sngon po gsang gnas kyi 'khor lo bsgom par bya la/ de ltar gnas dang yi ge khams ma 'khrug par 'og gi yan lag drug kyang 'god dgos par 'dir gsungs pas/

gang dag yan lag drug dgod 'og ma mi 'dod pa mi rigs so// 'di dag gi rnam gzhag rgyas par sgra ka lā pa'i spyi don chen mor bshad zin cing*/ thun mong ma yin pa rnams 'og dbyangs 'char dang bzlas pa'i skabs su bshad par bya'o/ / da ni gnyis pa/ kun rdzaub drang don gyi 'jig rten bshad pa la gsum/ chags zin ji ltar 'jig tshul/ zhig nas ji ltar chags tshul/ chags pa ji ltar gnas tshul lo/ / dang po ni/ spyir rgyud sde gzhan rnams sbyang gzhi sbyor ba sogs kyi 'jig rten 'jig 'byung gnas pa'i tshul ni/ chos mngon pa dang stun par rnam bzhag rim pa dang man ngag snye ma sogs nas bshad la/ 'dir mu stegs rdul phran 'dod pa rnams rjes su bzung ba dang*/ rdo rje slob dpon thos pas rgan par byed pa la nyan thos kyi sde snod shes dgos la/ de khyim pas rdzogs par bslab tu mi rung pas slob dpon gyi gtso bo dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa la gus pa bskyed pa'i phyir du/ bye brag smra ba 'dod pa ltar gyi rdul phran tsam zhig 'jig 'byung gnas pa'i rgyur khas len par/ khams le dang*/ ye le gnyis kar du gsungs shing*| de yang khams ler 'byung ba'i rgyu gtso bo gsungs la/ ye ler thog mara'ajig pa'i rgyu gsungs pa dang bstun nas bshad par bya la/ spyir stong pa'i rdul du grags pa/ khams rang rang gi phra ba'i mthar thug pa drug ste/ sa chu me rlung nam mkha' ye shes kyi stong rdul drug 'dod kyang*/ 'jig byed kyi rdul ni phra rags pa bzhi'i steng nas bshad la/ de yang mngon pa dang 'jig byed mi mthun la| mngon pa nas/ me yis bdun no chu yi gcig /de ltar chu bdun thal nas kyang*| |me yis bdun no de nas kyang*/ /'jug tu rlung gis 'jig pa yin/ zhes 'jig byed me chu rlung gsum du nges pa dang*/ de yang mes 'jig nga drug la chus 'jig bdun rdzogs pa dang*/ kun gyi mjug tu rlung gis 'jig thengs gcig las mi 'byung ba dang*/

'jig cha yang mes 'jig la bsam gtan dang po man dang*/ chus 'jig la gnyis pa dang*/ rlung 'jig la gsum pa man 'jig go| bzhi pa yan chad 'jig byed kyi mi 'jig pa sogs bshad kyang*/ 'dir dag pa'i 'jig rten las kyis ma bskyed pa rnams mi 'jig par mngon pa bzhin du bshad/ ma dag pa las nyon gyis skyed pa mtha' dag 'jig byar bshad cing*/ 'jig byed/ 'byung byed dang*/ gnas byed mtha' dag rlung gi steng nas 'jog la| de yang 'jig byed la/ brtan pa'i dang*/ g.yo ba'i rlung rdul gnyis su bshad pa'i dang po ni/ nam mkha' de nyid du mi mngon par gnas pa dang*/ gnyis pa ni/ rnam par shes pa'i chos can yin pas zhing gzhan du 'gro ste snga mas snod 'jig 'byung dang phyi mas bcud 'jig 'byung ba'i rgyu byed do/ /de gnyis kyang sems can gyi thun mong dang so so'i las kyi bskyed pa ste/ rtsa ba'i rgyu las nyon kho nar rnam pa kun tu gsungs so/ /de yang spyir las kyi mthu las nang du srog gi rlung bcu 'grub pa bzhin du phyi rol du yang rlung bcus bya ba byed la/ de'i tshul ni/ chags pa'i tshe/ bsrub byed kyi rlung gis khams thams cad sra bar byas nas gnas pa de spyi mthun gyi las zad pa na/ snod 'jig byed kyi rlung rdul des| dang por sa'i rdul chu sogs phye nas sil bur gnas pa de chu la lan tshwa bzhin du 'ju bar byed cing*/ de las chu rdul phye ba de me yis skems pa dang*/ de las phye ba'i me de rlung gis gsod cing*/ rlung rdul de nyid nam mkha' la mi snang bar gnas la/ 'di bye brag pa 'jig pa rtag par 'dod kyang 'dir mi rtag pa dang*| da bzod 'jig rten chags pa'i rgyur khas len no/ /de ltar na mu stegs kha cig 'og nas dus kyi me zhes bya ba'i lha zhig gis 'ongs nas des 'jig rten za bar 'dod mi rigs so zhes bkag nas/ 'jig byed kyi rlung rdul de la dus me zhes 'dogs na ni mi 'gog par gsungs so/

/g.yo ba'i rdul de ni sems dang ngo bo gcig pa'i rlung yin pas/ de nyid zhing gzhan du song ste sems can rang rang gi lus 'grub par byed la de'i tshe dag pa'i zhing khams mi 'jig pa'i tshul yang dag pa'i rdul phran stong gzugs kyi rang bzhin sa bcu po rnams la rten nas gnas pa ste/ ji srid sems can kyi tshogs gnyis mngon du ma gyur gyi bar du nam mkha' chos sku'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa dang*/ las bzang po mngon du gyur pa na gzugs sku snang bar gsungs te/ ye le'i brgya re lnga re drug pa rtsa 'grel du shes par bya'o/ /de yang snod zhig pa'i rjes su rnam par shes pa'i chos can gyi rlung ma dag pa'i zhing gzhan du 'gro bar gsungs pas/ snod bcud rags pa'i khams rnams mnyam du 'jig par grub bo/ /gnyis pa ni/ spyir snod bcud kyi 'jig rten sdug bsngal gyi bden pas bsdus pa 'di'i dngos kyi rgyu ni stong pa'i rdul phran drug po yin te/ ye shes khams kyi stong rdul ni/ chos nyid la rdul du ming btags pa yin pas chos thams cad chos nyid kyi dbang gis 'byung bar mdo sngags gzhan nas 'byung ba bzhin du kun gyi thun mong gi gzhi'am rgyu yin la/ nam mkha'i stong rgyud 'di la bsdus pa 'di'i dngos kyi rgyu ni gzugs can kun gyi go 'byed pa'i nam mkha' la bzhag pa gcig dang*/ sgra'i yon tan gcig pu dang ldan pa'i nam mkha' gzugs med khams pa'i rgyur 'gro ba gcig kyang khas len dgos par dngos su ma bshad kyang rigs pas 'grub cing*/ rlung rdul sogs bzhi pos 'jig rten rags pa rtsom tshul khams le'i tshigs bcad bzhi pa'i 'grel par 'byung ba bzhin/ rlung rdul nam mkha' la ma 'byar ba'i dbang gis mi snang bar gnas pa rnams las kyi nus pas 'dab 'byar du gyur pas rlung gi dkyil 'khor dang*/ de dang me rdul 'byar ba 'phrad nas me ste glog dang*/ de dang chu rdul 'byar ba 'phrad pas char pa dang*/

de dang sa rdul 'byar ba 'phrad pas 'ja' tshon rnams dang po 'grub la de nas rim gyis| rlung rdul 'phel ba 'dzin byed dang bsrub byed dang*/ dbyibs byed pa'i rlung gsum du gyur pa'i dang pos mi ltung bar nam mkhar 'dzin/ gnyis pas lan tshwa'i chu nyi mas gdung pa bzhin du sra bar byed/ gsum pa stong pa'i rdul gyi dbus su snod skyed pa la chu la lan tshwa bzhin du dang bcud skyed pa la sgo nga'i dbus su sgong skyes kyi lus dbyibs rim gyis dod pa bzhin du sgrub par byed pas| snod kyi dkyil 'khor chen po bzhi dang ri rab lhun po dang*/ gzhan ri bdun dang*/ gling bdun dang*/ rgya mtsho bdun dang*/ rgyu skar dang*/ nyi zla gza' skar dang*/ drang srong bdun gyi gnas la sogs pa 'grub cing*/ bcud kyi lha klu 'byung po/ dud 'gro mi dang dmyal ba sogs 'grub par byed do/ /'dir dud 'gro skye gnas rnam pa bzhi zhes pa'i skabs su/ rdzus te skyes pa ni ljon pa la sogs pa ste sa'i skye gnas so zhes gsungs pa la rten nas/ kha cig gis/ ljon shing dud 'gro'i skye gnas su bstan pas sems ldan yin zhes zer/ kha cig de gcer bu pa'i lugs dang khyad med pas dus 'khor skyon bcas su grub zer| bu ston rin po che/ 'di rwa pas shing du bsgyur zhing shing gi skad dod yod mod kyi/ ljon pa rta mgo can nam/ ljon pa'i ming can dud 'gro mi gzugs can nam| yang na mdo sde mdzangs blun nas shing la srin bus zos pas shing nyen skad 'don par bshad pa lta bu nyi tshe ba'i dmyal ba yin gsungs/ bla ma dam pa ljon pa rta mgo can dud 'gror bsdud pa yin gsungs so/ /'di ni mi 'thad de/ rgya bod gnyis ka'i skad la shing tu yod kyang shing ma yin zhes par 'dug pas 'grel pa 'gog par gsal la/ de ltar bkag na/ gnas skabs mang por 'grel pa 'gog dgos par 'gyur te/ 'og tu lha min gdengs can 'byung po'i skye gnas zhes pa'i 'grel par 'byung po'i skye gnas ni sngar brjod pa bzhi'o/

/ brtan pa'i skye gnas ni lhun po dang shing la sogs pa de dag thams cad sngags kyi ming gis ming can du byas pa'i sngags su 'gyur ro zhes bshad pa dang*/ zhe bdun pa sgrub ler dngos po'i skye ba rnam pa brgyad kyi skabs su/ de ltar sa'i skye ba ni shing la sogs pa brtan pa rnams so/ zhes pa rnams kyi shing thams cad rta mgo can nam/ dud 'gro'am/ dmyal bar sdud dgos par 'gyur ro/ khyad par 'di sa'i skye gnas su bshad pa 'di/ dmyal ba yin zhes gsungs ba ni mi mad pa shin tu che ste/ skye ba brgyad kyi skabs su sa chu me rlung gi bzhi dang*/ nam mkha'i skye ba la zla ba'i skye ba klu dang lha min/ nyi ma'i skye ba lha dang 'byung po ste gnyis rnam shes kyi skye ba la/ sgra gcan gyi skye ba gzugs med/ dus me'i skye ba la dmyal bar bshad pas/ dmyal ba skye gnas phra ba'i mthar thug ste/ rags pa'i mthar thug tu mdzad pas so/ bla ma dam pas kyang de bzhin ro'i skye gnas ni rdzus te skyes pa yin no/ /zhes pa ro'i skye gnas kyi mtshan gzhi sgrub ler bshad pa'i gzugs med la mdzad pa'i 'di yang mtshan gzhi'i gtso bo ma yin te| ro zhes pa nam mkha' la zer bar khas blangs nas rnam shes kyi skye ba mtshan gzhir bzung bas so/ /des na jo nang phyogs pas/ 'dir brtan g.yo gnyis ka'i skye gnas ngos bzung ba yin pas ljon pa dang lhun po sgra drang thad yin la/ de lta yongs grags kyi rdzus skyes dang mi gcig zhes bshad pa legs mod kyi des kyang de ma thag pa'i rdzus skyes chen po 'di rtsa tshig gis ma bstan zhes bris pas/ ljon shing*/ dud 'gro skye gnas rnam bzhi zhes pa'i nang du bsdus pas ljon pa de dud 'gro gzhi mthun khas blangs so/ /des na brtan pa'i skye ba 'di zhar byung yin la/ ro'i skye ba 'di la dud 'gro'i rdzus skyes la skye ba brgyad kyi nang gi nam mkha'i gnyis dang rnam shes kyi gnyis po thams cad bsdus te/

mdor na dud 'gro la mtshan gzhi gtso bor sbyar ba'i 'gro ba kun gyi skye gnas bzhi dang*/ zhar la snod 'grub pa yang rdzus skyes bzhin du nam mkha' la rang 'khrungs lta bur yod pas rdzus skyes dang 'dra bas rdzus skyes te de yang sa'i rdzus skyes yin pas so/ /des na/ ljon shing la sogs dud 'gro'i skye bar bsdus/ /'di ni gcer bu pa yi lugs bzang yin/ /zhes pas skyon med de/ dud 'gro'i skye bar ma bsdus pa'i phyir te/ rtsa bas kyang dud 'gro'i skye gnas rnam pa bzhi dang*/ zhes ma gsungs kyi/ dud 'gro'i skye gnas rnam pa bzhi zhes gsungs pa dang*/ 'grel pa'i dgongs pa yang ji skad bshad pa bzhin gnas pas so/ /yang 'di rnams su sa'i skye gnas sogs bshad pas 'khrul nas/ 'gro ba 'byung ba'i skye gnas can du bshad/ /'di ni tshu rol mdzes pa'i gzhung lugs yin/ /zhes zer ba'ang mi 'jug ste/ rgyang 'phen pa/ sa sogs rnam shes kyi nyer len du 'dod la| 'dir lhan cig byed rkyen du 'dod pas so/ /de lta min na/ mngal skyes sgong skyes kun la grags pas/ mngal dang sgo nga rnam shes kyi nyer len du 'gyur ro| |gsum pa don dam par tshad dang dbyibs nges pa med/ kun rdzob tu tshad dbyibs nges pa'i rgyu/ 'dir bstan gyi snod rgyas par bshad pa gsum/ dang po ni| skabs 'di lta bu la sogs pa rnams su don dam dang kun rdzob bshad pa'i don ni/ 'jig rten pa'i las snang ngam 'khrul snang la kub rdzob dang*/ las snang las grol ba'i gzugs kyi snang ba don dam du byas pa yin no/ /des na don dam par nges pa med de/ nges pa gcig yod na/ 'jig rten gyi tshad dbyibs mtha' gcig tu nges dgos la/ nges na tshad dbyibs mi 'dra ba gsungs pa rnams kyi gang rung gcig las gzhan pa rnams tshad mas ma grub pa'i drang don 'ba' zhig tu 'gro dgos so/ /'di la gong du brjod pa ltar/ kha cig mngon pa nas gsungs pa nges don dang 'dir bshad drang don/

kha gcig zlog ste smra ba dang*| kha cig gzhi tha dad du smra ba dang*/ kha cig snang ba sems su ston pa yin pas gnyis ka la don med par smra ba sogs mang du byung yang*/ las snang mi mthun pa la ni/ gnyis ka yang mi snang la/ las snang mthun pa so so la ni gzhi gcig tu gnyis ka snang ba mi 'gal zhing*/ 'phral gyi 'khrul rgyus ma bslad pa'i las snang brtan shos kyi mngon sum la tshad mar ma bzhag na tha rnyad pa'i tshad ma mi rnyed pas na/ tha snyad pa'i tshad ma'i ngo na 'di grub la 'di ma grub pa'i rnam dbye med la/ las snang sa bon dang bcas pa'i skyon las grol ba'i sangs rgyas la ni/ 'di la snang ba 'di shar 'dug na'ang*/ 'di la de dang mi mthun par 'dir shar 'dug ces pa'i ye shes kyi gzigs pa thogs med du zhugs nas rang rang gi snang ba dang mthun par chos ston gyi rang dbang gi snang ba gcig tu nges pa cung zad kyang med par ye shes le'u'i re dgu pas legs par bstan no// de bzhin du mdo dang bstan bcos du ma las/ snang ba ngan pa thams cad mi dge ba dang*/ bzang po thams cad dge ba'i dbang gis 'char bar mgrin gcig tu gsungs pa bzhin khams le'i mdor bsdus brgyad pa'i mgor yang*/ khru lnga pa'i sa phug tu/ 'khor los bsgyur rgyal sde dang bcas pa yang dog pa med pa shong ba de der bzhug byang sems lta bu'i ye shes kyi mthu dang*/ 'khor los bsgyur ba'i bsod nams kyi mthus yin pa'i rigs pa dang*/ 'jug tu rtsa rgyud kyi lung gis legs par bsgrubs so/ /

gnyis pa ni/ 'o na mngon pa dang mi mthun pa'i tshad gsungs pa'i rgyu mtshan dang dgos pa ci zhe na/ sangs rgyas kyi mdzod dang*/ rig byed kyi grub mtha' sna tshogs nas tshad dbyibs sna tshogs gsungs pa rnams las snang so so'i dbang gis mi 'gal yang 'dir 'bum phrag bzhi pa'i 'jig rten 'di nyid ston cing tshangs pa'i yul la dpag tshad dbye ba'i khyon 'gog pa'i rgyu mtshan/ nang lus dang gzhan gyi dkyil 'khor dang dag pa'i chos mthun nam sbyang gzhi sbyong byed sbyor ba na 'di kho na ltar gnas la gzhan la de ltar mi 'grig pas so// des na 'dir/ ji ltar phyi rol de bzhin lus zhes gsungs pa'i phyir 'jig rten gyi khams kyi tshad 'jig rten gyi khams dkyil 'khor gyi don dang lus kyi tshad lus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi don du ste/ lus ni dkyil 'khor zhes brjod do zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes pa'i 'grel tshig 'gyur cung zad bcos te/ lus kyi don gyis dkyil 'khor lus kyi tshad dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi don du 'jig rten khams kyi tshad kyis 'jig rten gyi khams te zhes par shin tu gsal lo/ / dgos pa ni/ tshangs pa'i yul la dpag tshad bye ba'i khyon yang las snang mthun pa la mi 'gal mod kyi/ de ltar 'dod pa de nyi ma'i shing rta sogs kyi dgag yul yin pas de dang mthun par 'gog pa'i bstan na de dag yongs su smin cing lam dang 'bras bu chen po la 'god pa'i dgos pa gzigs pa ste bshad kyang zin to/ /de ltar na rgyu mtshan sbyang gzhi 'grig pa dang dgos pa drang srong 'dul ba'i phyir na/ kun rdzob las snang mthun pa la skabs 'dir 'di kho na bshad par bya'o/ gsum pa la/ las dang longs spyod kyi 'jig rten spyi'i rnam gzhag bsdus te bstan/ las sa gtso bor gyur pa'i 'jig rten gcig rgyas par bshad pa'o/ / dang po ni/ brgya re brgyad par/ ye ler dbyibs kyi rlung srog thur la sogs pa bcu yis sangs rgyas kyi zhing mtha' yas pa dus gcig tu chags par byed pa'i gling bzhi pa so so ba thams cad 'khor yug gi ri bo chen po gcig gis bskor nas gnas de nang gi rlung bcus lus kyi rtsa du ma chags par byed la thams cad kyi mtha' pags pa dang ba spus bskor ba bzhin du gnas pa dang*/

rtsa'i nang nas gtso bo a wa dhū tī sogs gsum steng 'og gi lam drug dang bcas pa dbus na gnas pa lta bu ni/ las sa gtso bor gyur pa'i gling bzhi pa 'di yin la| rtsa lhag ma rlung mi rgyu bar khrag gis gang ba lta bu ni gling bzhi pa gzhan rnams longs spyod kyi sa yin par bstan no/ /'dir a wa dhū tī ji ltar ba bzhin zhes pa ni/ gzhan rnams khrag gis gang ba'i rtsar bshad pa'i shugs kyis 'khor dang bcas pa la dgongs par byed dgos te gzhan du na ro brkyang nas rlung mi 'bab par 'gyur ro/ /'di dag gis ni bcom ral la sogs pas 'jig rten gyi khams rgya chad du bshad ces/ mngon pa nas 'byung ba'i stong spyi phud la sogs pa'i rnam gzhag dang mthun par 'jig rten mtha' med du ma bshad do zhes zer ba rnams legs par bkag ste/ dgag sgrub byed pa kun gyis gzhung lugs 'di'i stod smad kun la gzigs long yod pa re mdzad du gsol/ 'di ni mdo sde 'ga' zhig tu stong gsum mi 'jed 'di yi nang tshan gling bzhi pa gzhan mang po dag pa'i 'jig rten dang*/ gling bzhi pa 'di ma dag pa'i 'jig rten du bshad pa dang mthun par snang ngo*/ / gnyis pa la/ snod bcud spyi'i rnam gzhag thun mong du bstan/ /'dzam gling chen po'i rnam gzhag khyad par bshad/ 'dzam gling chung ngu'i rnam gzhag bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ / dang po la/ gang du 'khor ba snod kyi 'jig rten/ gang zhig 'khor ba bcud kyi sems can/ ji ltar 'khor ba dus bzhi'i rnam gzhag go /dang po la snod zlum po'i tshad dbyibs rgyas par bshad/ de nang dang gzhan gyi tshad dbyibs la sbyar ba'o/ / dang po la dngos dang*/ 'jal byed bshad pa'o/ /dang po la dkyil 'khor bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa'i dang*/ ri mtsho gling bdun gyi tshad dbyibs sogs/ dang po ni/ 'og nas rlung me chu sa'i dkyil 'khor bzhi dang*/ sa'i steng gi ri rab dang bcas pa thams cad dbyibs zlum po/

rgya dpangs gnyis tshad mnyam pa ste 'bum phrag bzhi bzhir mnyam pa'i phyir te/ rgya la rlung gi shar mtha' nas nub mtha'i bar la dpag tshad 'bum phrag bzhi yod pa bzhin du/ rlung gi 'og mtha' nas ri rab kyi skra rtse'i bar la yang de yod pa'i phyir te/ dkyil 'khor bzhi'i 'thug rngam la 'bum phrag phyed phyed de/ ri rab kyi sa mtshams bar la yod cing*/ ri rab kyi lus dpung pa'am mgrin phreng 'og ma'i bar la gcig dang*/ mgrin phreng ngam dpung pa nas yar bcal ba'i mgo bo la gcig yod pa'i phyir te/ gdong la stong phrag lnga bcu dang*/ mgrin pa dang skra gnyis la nyer lnga re yod pa rnams bsdoms pas sa mtshams yan la gnyis yod pas so/ /'dir mgrin pa dang gdong la sogs pa rnams kha cig lha de rnams kyi gnas so so la de ltar btags pa yin gyi mgrin pa sogs kyi dbyibs su med ces zer kha cig dbyibs dang rgyu la sogs pa ji bzhin yin zer/ nang gzhan gnyis dang sbyar dgos pas dbyibs ni ji bzhin la/ rgyu bshad pa ni dpung pa man gyi dbang du byas kyi yan chod rgyu'i khams je phra je phrar gyur pa der gnas pa'i lha'i khams dang mthun pas so/ /dkyil 'khor bzhi'i 'thug rngam kyang sa'i dkyil 'khor ni 'bum phrag phyed pa nyid du nges la/ gzhan rnams ni mchod rten gyi bang rim bzhin du med par mtha' rnams phyi ma phyi mas nang ma nang ma rnams skyor ba'i tshul du gnas pas brtsegs pa'i 'thug rngam 'bum phrag phyed par nges kyang*/ mtha' rnams ni tha dad de rlung gi mtha'i rngam la 'bum phrag gnyis dang*/ me la phyed dang gnyis dang chu la gcig yod pas so/ /ri rab ni phyi dbyibs zlum po la dkar yol kha blang ba lta bu rtsa ba'i thad kar stong phrag bcu drug dang*/ steng gi 'grel par sor du yod par/ thad kar lnga bcu pa zlum po thams cad mtha' gsum 'gyur du nges pa ltar gnas pa/ steng brgya 'di yang skyes bu'i lus dbyibs su gnas pa'i dpung pa'i thad kyi dbang du byas te gzhan 'phrul dbang byed man chad kyi gnas yin no/

/mgrin pa'i sor bzhi yan chad khams gong ma gnyis kyi gnas su bshad la mgrin pa'i smad sor gnyis ni mtha' bral man chod 'dod lha'i gnas su bshad pas/ mngon pa nas tshangs pa'i 'jig rten yan chad gling bzhi pa las rgya che bar bshad pa bzhin du 'dir mi 'dod do/ /de rnams kyi rgyu la| dkyil 'khor bzhi ni gtso bo'i dngos rnams chung ba'i dngos rnams gnas par lan mang du gsung pa bzhin du khams rang rang gtso che ba la rdul rdzas brgyad 'dus pa ste/ mngon pa nas chu dang chu'i khams la kun rdzob dang don dam bden par bshad pa dang mthun no/ /ri rab ni/ shar in+d+ra nī la/ lho pad+ma rā gnub kar ke ta ser po/ byang zla ba chu shel dkar po/ dbus mar gad ljang khu ste/ ya ra la wa ha rnams kyi rang bzhin no/ khyad par ri rab kyi dbyibs dbus su lhun po stong pa'i rnam pa zhes pas 'khrul nas khong stong du 'dod pa dang*/ stong pa gcig ni 'khor yug tu bshad pa ri rab kyi pags pa'i 'thug rngams su 'dod pa rnams la ni/ ye ler 'grel pa na sor du yod pa'i/ brgya re dgu par/ ri rab kyi dbus kyi ljang khur bshad pa dang*/ steng du dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor bzhugs par bshad pas khegs so/ /des na stong pa'i rnam pa zhes pa ni/ khams thams cad 'dus pa nam mkha'i khams yin pa la dgongs so/ /ri rab kyi rwa lnga bshad pa la 'dod pa mi mthun pa shin tu mang te/ rwa pa ka ba la phub lnga je chung du brtsegs pa bzhin du steng gtor sku'i rnam par 'dod pa dang*/ bi bhū ti dang tsa mi rwa gcig ri rab kyi steng du dang bzhi zur bzhi nas gangs can gyi steng du zug zer ba dang*/ kha cig rdza ma dang rdza lung gi tshul du 'dod pa rnams la/ rwa gangs ri la reg pa dang bshad pa dang*/ nyi ma dus thams cad du rwa la reg par bshad pa rnams kyis gnod la/ rang lugs ni/ rwa gangs ri la reg pa dang rwa bzhi'i nang du gling drug shong bar bshad pas/

sder ma mas kha 'phyangs lnga je cher song ba brtsegs pa'i phyi rol 'og phyogs bzhin du/ mtha' 'khor yug tu gnas pa'i nang ma 'og ma 'gram stegs stong phrag gcig pa khor yug tu yod par bshad pa dang mnyam shing*/ phyi ma gangs ri dang mnyam por kha sbyar ba bzhin du gnas pa bar ma gsum gyi 'og na gling drug mtsho drug ri lnga rnams gnas pa yin no// gling de rnams la nyi zla'i bya ba med kyang longs spyod kyi sa pa'-i mi rnams gnas pas rang 'od kyi 'tsho ba yin no/ / gnyis pa ni/ de ltar ri rab kyi rtsa ba'i 'gram skyor lta bu'i khor yug dpag tshad stong phrag gcig po de'i phyi nas gling zla ba dang*/ 'od dkar dang*/ ku sha dang*/ mi'am ci dang*/ khrung khrung dang*/ drag po ste longs spyod kyi sa dang*/ bdun pa las kyi sa 'dzam gling chen po ste bdun/ gling re re'i mthar rim pa bzhin/ sbrang rtsi dang*/ mar dang*/ zho dang/ chu dang*/ chang dang*/ lan tsha'i rgya mtsho ste bdun*/ mtsho re re'i mthar rim pa bzhin/ 'od sngon dang*/ man+ḍa ra dang*/ ni ṣa ṭa dang*/ nor bu'i 'od dang*/ dro ṇa dang*/ bsil ri'am gangs ri dang*/ rdo rje'i ri ste ri bdun rnams gnas pa'i ri tha ma 'di la rgya dpangs kyi tshad ma bshad pas rta gdong gi me dang gcig par 'dod do/ /mtsho phyi ma ni/ 'bum phrag phyed kha zheng la yod la/ gling phyi ma ni stong phrag nyi shu rtsa lnga kha zheng la yod cing*| gzhan drug gsum bco brgyad po ni rags rtsis/ dpag tshad brgyad brgya brgya cu gya dgu re zheng la mnyam por yod par rgyud nas gsungs la/ zhib tu rtsi na| stong phrag bcu drug la bco brgyad kyi bgos pa'i thob nor yin te/ bgo byed ri gling mtsho gsum re re la drug drug ste bco brgyad yod la/ bgo bya la/ ri rab kyi dbus nas 'dzam gling chen po'i bar la stong phrag nyer lnga yod pa'i steng nas| ri rab nang gi rtsa ba stong phrag bcu drug pa'i phyed dang 'gram skyor gyi stong gcig ste dgu po bcad pa'i lhag ma bcu drug yod pas so/

/'di zhib por rtsis na dpag tshad brgyad brgya gya brgyad/ rgyang grags gsum/ gzhu stong dang brgya dang bcu gcig sor bcu/ nas lnga/ shig gnyis/ skye tshe lnga/ skra rtse gnyis/ rdul phra mo lnga dang phra mo'i sum cha gcig rnams re re la 'byung ngo*/ /skabs 'dir/ de yi phyi rol stong pa gcig pu srid pa gsum bral yon tan med cing de nyid kyis dman pa'o/ /zhes pa'i 'grel par/ rdul phran so so'i ngo bo khams lnga pa stong pa gcig pu'o/ /nam mkha' ni min te/ thams cad la khyab par byed pa'i phyir stong pa gcig pur rtogs pas mi bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don la/ stong pa gcig pa'i 'di rdul de rdul phran so so bzhi/ skal pa chags pa'i tshe yang 'byar mi srid pa'i cha nas nam mkha'i rdul dang mtshungs kyang*/ nam mkha'i rdul ni khams lnga min te nam mkha' gcig pu'i khams yin pas so/ /srid pa gsum dang ma bral te| gzugs med khams kyi snod bcud nam mkha'i khams kyi phye bas so/ /sa sogs kyi yon tan med cing de nyid kyis dman pa yin te/ sgra'i yon tan dang ldan pas so/ /gnas nges pa med de/ gzugs can gar yod na yod pas so/ / 'di ni nam mkha'i rdul la med pas thams cad khyad chos su ldan la/ gnas 'bum phrag bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi phyi rol na ra gur gyi tshul du gnas pa yin la| tshad dngos su ma bshad kyang*/ ye ler 'khor lo sdom chen gyi dkyil 'khor 'jig rten gyi khams 'bum phrag lnga pa dang dag pa sbyar bas/ phyogs rer stong phrag lnga bcu pa'i tshad can du bya zhes bu ston rin po ches gsungs so/ /bla ma dam pa ni/ khyab par byed pa'i phyir zhes pa 'di'i khyad chos yin te/ khams lnga po thams cad la khyab pa yin la nam mkha' khams gzhan la ma khyab ces gsungs te/ gong du stong rdul drug pa ni chos kyi dbyings te/ thams cad la khyab par byed pas so/ zhes gsungs pa dang bstun par snang ngo*/ spyir na*/

mngon pa nas bshad pa'i rdul phran ni/ 'dir 'byung bzhi rdul phran nyid yin la/ nam mkha'i rdul dang stong pa gcig pa'i rdul 'di lta bus ni mngon pa nas bshad pa'i rdul gyi go mi chod la/ don smra gnyis kyi don dam du grub par 'dod pa'i rdul phran cha med kyang don steng nas 'grub thabs med pas blos phye nas 'jog pa las ma 'das la blos phye ba'i rdul phran ni khams phra ba la'ang bzhag tu rung ngo snyom du dgongs par gsal gyi/ rdul phran gyi sgras 'khrul nas nam mkha'i khams bem po'i gzhi mthun gyi grub mtha' khas blangs par mi bya'o/ /nam mkha' tsam dang bem po'i gzhi mthun ni/ mngon par yang bshad de/ mngon par skabs yod ces pa rgyan nam mkha' dang bu ga nam mkha' la bzhag pas so/ / gnyis pa ni/ chos mngon pa las rdul dang ni/ lcags chu ri bong lug dang glang*/ /nyi zer rdul dang sro ma dang*/ /de las byung dang de bzhin nas/ /sor tshigs zhes bya gong bdun bsgyur/ /zhes dang*/ lung rnam 'byed las de rnams snga ma las phyi ma drug 'gyur du bshad pa'ang yod kyang*/ 'dir phra rab dang*/ phra mo dang*| skra rtse phra mo dang*/ ske tshe dang*/ shig dang*/ nas dang*/ sor rnams snga ma las phyi ma brgyad 'gyur du bgres po'i sor mo nyer bzhi la 'khru dang*/ de bzhi la gzhu byed pa ni kun mthun la/ gzhu lnga brgya la brgya grags dang*/ de brgyad la dpag tshad du mngon pa nas bshad cing*/ 'dir gzhu nyis stong la rgyang grags/ rgyang grags la bzhi 'gyur gyi khyad yod pa mdzad nas/ rgyang grags bzhi la dpag tshad du gsungs pas mngon pa'i dpag tshad las nyis ldab kyi ring ba yin no| |de ltar na mngon pa nas bshad pa'i gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten la mngon pa rang lugs kyi dpag tshad 'bum phrag so drug lhag pa yod kyang 'di'i dpag tshad bco brgyad lhag pa las mi 'byung la/ 'di la rang lugs kyi 'bum phrag bzhi las med kyang*/ mngon pa'i 'bum phrag brgyad du 'gyur ba'i bzhi ldab cung lhag las khyad med do/

/ gnyis pa ni/ spyir phyi ru 'jig rten khams la dpag tshad 'bum phrag re dang nang lus la 'khru re mgo brdos sbyar nas lus la rags rtsis khru bzhi mchu zheng mtshungs pa bzhin du/ 'jig rten 'bum phrag bzhi bzhir mchu zheng mnyam pa dang*| gzhan dkyil 'khor la yang*/ sku dkyil gyi thig nas rtsa thig gi bar la slob dpon gyi khru bzhi mchu zheng la mnyam par bshad la/ dkyil 'khor la bri bya kho na'i dbang du byas nas/ phyi 'jig rten dang nang lus gnyis ka'i rgya dang dpangs gnyis ka dkyil 'khor gyi rgya kho na la skyar nas sbyar mod kyi shugs la/ sgom bya dang blos slongs kyi dpangs kyang rgya dang mnyam par 'grub ste/ sku dkyil gyi brgya'i phyed kho rang gi dpangs la bya zhing*/ de dang mnyam pa'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi dbus 'bur ba'i steng du sku dkyil gyi dpangs phyed gsung dkyil bya/ de bzhin du byas nas thugs dkyil la gsung gi phyed/ thugs kyi nang gi ye shes 'khor lo phur bu bud pa'i dpangs ni thugs dkyil nyid kyi rgya dang mnyam por byas pas dkyil 'khor la yang dpangs brgya dang mnyam par 'grub po/ /skyes bu'i lus 'doms gang gru bzhir bshad pa yang mchu zheng gab pa'i gang zag so skye khyad par ba'i dbang du byas kyi spyi rigs nas zhib tu rtsis na ma nges te phal pa'i 'dom la sor dgu cu go drug yod kyang dpangs la brgyad cu gya bzhi las med pa dang*| de nas las rlung rim gyi 'gags te rdzogs par 'gags pa'i sangs rgyas kyi longs sku khru lnga gru bzhi mnyam pa dang*/ khru re la'ang rang sor nyer lnga re re bsdoms pas sor mo brgya nyer lnga yod pa dang*/ sa bcu gnyis po re re la sor mo phyed dang gsum re tsam 'phel bar 'gyur ba'i rnam bzhag gsungs te/ lha'i phyag tshad rgyas par gzhan du bshad zin cing 'og tu'ang bshad par bya'o/ /

'jig rten gyi dbyibs kyang rags rtsis nas nang dang gzhan la sbyar nas gsungs te mi dang sangs rgyas kyi sku skyil mo dkrung du bzhugs pa'i lte ba man chod lta bu ni ri rab kyi sa mtshams man gyi dkyil 'khor bzhi brtsegs yin la/ lte ba yan chad lta bu ni ri rab ste/ lus kyi khog pa lto ba nas dpung pa'i bar du je sbom du gyur pa dang*/ de nas mgrin pa dang*/ gdong dang skra la sogs pa'i dbyibs dang 'dra bar gnas pas so/ /de bzhin du chos sku'i mchod rten gyi phyag tshad dang dbyibs kyang*/ dri med 'grel pa dang sogs nas 'byung ba lta bu'i mgrin ring dang bre chung ngur mi byed kyi/ lte ba man dang ri rab kyi sa mtshams man chad lta bu ni bang rim gcig tu bya la/ lte ba'i thad la bum gdan dang*/ dpung pa'i bar la bum pa stod je sbom du stong ba dang*/ mgrin pa phra ba lta bur bre'i mgrin pa phra ba dang*/ smin mtshams bar gyi gdong pa je sbom du song ba lta bu bre'i gdong dang*/ de nas gtsug tor dang*/ ral pa'i thor cog dang*/ ri rab kyi skra je phrar song ba ltar gdugs dang char 'khebs bya bar gsungs pas/ las mthun snang du bsags pa la legs par snang ba'i 'jig rten 'di ni/ phyi nang gzhan gsum thams cad la tshad dbyibs legs par 'grig pas chos mthun dang sbyong gzhi sbyong byed shin tu 'phrod pa'i 'jig rten yin no/ /gang dag mu stegs kyi gzhung nas bshad pa/ don la med pa'i drang don yin no snyam pa'i zhes smra bar byed pa dag gis ni/ sbyang gzhi dang mthun yul de dang sbyar ba'i nang dang gzhan gyi chos mthun mtha' dag drang don du khas len dgos pas/ dus kyi 'khor lo nges don cung zad kyang med pa zhig tu smra dgos par 'gyur ro/ / gnyis pa bcud kyi sems can la dbye ba dang*/ gnas dang*/ tshe tshad do| dang po ni/ rgyas par dbye na srid pa sum cu rtsa gcig tu gsungs te/ 'dod pa na bcu gcig gzugs na bcu drugagazugs med na bzhi'o/

/ dang po ni/ dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro/ mi dang lha min 'dod lha rigs drug rnams te/ drug ni/ rgyal chen bzhi/ sum cu rtsa gsum/ 'thab bral/ dga' ldan/ 'phrul dga'/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed do/ /gzugs bcu drug ni/ tshangs ris/ tshangs pa mdun na 'don/ tshangs chen/ 'od chung*/ tshad med 'od/ 'od gsal/ dgai chung*/ tshad med dge dge rgyas/ sprin med/ bsod nams skyes| 'bras bu che rnams mngon pa bzhin byas nas/ gnas gtsang ma la/ mi che/ mi gdung*/ shin tu mtho/ 'og min te bzhi las mi bgrong bar bcu drug tu byed pa yin gyi/ bye brag tu smra ba/ tshangs chen dang mdun na 'don gnas gcig tu 'dod pa lta bu min no/ /gzugs med bzhi ni/ nam mkha' dang*/ rnamashes dang*/ ci yang med pa dang*/ 'du shes med 'du shes med min skye mched de skye mched bzhi'o/ /'di dag gi sgra don sogs ni 'dir ma bshad kyang mngon pa dang 'dra bar bya la/ rgyu tshogs ni/ gzugs med bzhi po/ zad par nam mkha' sgom pa dang*| gzugs med kyi gnas bzhi mtshan gzhir ni/ bsam gtan dang po dang gnyis pa dang gsum pa bzhi par byas pa'i bzhi pa nas yas rim bzhin/ zad par rlung me chu sa bsgom pa dang*/ thun mong du tshul gyis stobs dang*/ 'dod lha drug po sbyin pa dang sngags bzlas pa'i stobs dang*/ lha min yang sbyin pa'i stobs dang*/ mi dge mi dge'i las kyi stobs dang*/ mi dge ba chung 'bring chen pos dud 'gro yi dwags dmyal ba rnams su skye bar bshad do/ /de rnams kyi sa bon nam ming yig ni/ gzugs med bzhi'i a ā aṃ aḥ rlung bzhi'i i ī e ai| me bzhi'i ṛ ṝ ar ār/ chu bzhi'i u ū o au/ sa bzhi'i l̥ l̥̄ al āl| 'dod lha drug gis ha hā ya yā ra rā/ lha min dang mi'i wa wā/ dud 'gro dang yi dwags kyi la lā/ dmyal ba'i k+ṣa yig go srid pa so gcig po de bsdu na/ 'gro ba rigs drug tu bshad/ stod smad mang por ro'i 'gro ba zhes pa yang yang gsungs shing*/

nang le'i lta ba rtag par 'gro ba ni drug ste zhes gsungs pas so| |mngon pa nas lha min zur du mi bgrong ba 'gro ba lngar bshad pa ltar 'dir yang bsdu na lngar bzhed de/ lha min ni/ spyir lha dang khyad par rgyal chen bzhir bsdus pas so/ /de las kyang bsdu na/ khams gsum dang*/ srid pa gsum dang*/ yang srid gsum mtha' dag dus kyi sbyor ba dag las zhes pa'i 'grel par/ mtho ris dang mi yul dang sa 'og dang gsum du yang bsdus nas gsungs so/ / gnyis pa ni/ gzugs med bzhi po ri rab kyi gtsug tor na skra mtshams/ rlung bzhi po dpral ba/ me bzhi po sna/ chu bzhi po kos kos bzhi po mgrin pa'i sum gnyis/ 'dod pa drug gi bzhi/ mgrin pa'i sum cha/ dpag tshad brgyad dang sum cha la cha bzhir bgos nas/ sum cu rtsa gsum ri rab kyi ste/ rgyal chen bzhi dpung pa man nas sa mtshams kyis bar te/ mngon pa bzhin du 'di'i gnas mang ngo*/ /ri rab khong seng 'og rwa gong ma bzhi'i 'og na gling drug la longs spyod kyi sa pa'i mi gnas zer/ gling drug la longs spyod kyi sa pa'i mi ri rab kyi rwa gong ma dang kha sbyar ba ni ri'-i 'khyil la gnas/ dang*/ 'dzam gling chen po la las kyi sa pa'i mi gnas so/ /'og gi dkyil 'khor bzhi po re re yang phyed mar byas pa'i gnas brgyad kyi dang po steng ma ni rinachen snang ba'i gnas zhes bya la/ de la phyed ma byas pa'i phyed gong ma la lha min dang 'og ma la klu gnas so/ /de 'og bdun la dmyal ba bdun te/ sa'i dmyal ba gcig dang*/ chu me rlung gsum gyi gnyis gnyis rnams so/ /dang po ni/ bseg ma'i chu'i/ gnyis pa gnyis bye ma'i chu'i dang*| 'dam gy-i chu'i/ de nas gnyis/ mi zad pa'i du ba'i dang me'i/ de nas gnyis| mun pa'i dang*/ ngu 'bod chen po drag po'i rlung gi dmyal ba'o/ /ngag yig gis/ rdo rje'i dmyal ba zhes bya ba rtsa ltung dang po dang ldan pa rnams kyi gnas te 'jig rten gyi ma bsdus pa'i rdo rje'i me lce dang bcas pa la dmyal ba brgyad pa rdo rje'i khab rtse mo rtag tu 'bar ba gzhung gzhan nas mnar med du bshad pa'i dod do/

/ gsum pa ni/ lo'i tshad ni 'og tu 'chad cing dgos kyang mi dgos te/ mi los 'jal ba'i tshe tshad med pas so/ /des na/ bskal pa'i tshad dgos la/ de yang sdig pa'i dbang gi ngan song dang*/ dge ba'i dbang gis mtho ris su bskal pa du mar gnas par gsungs so/ /bskal pa ni bzhi ste/ bskal pa chung ngu dang*/ bar ma dang*/ mchog dang*/ chen po rnams yin la/ bskal pa chung ngu ni/ chu zheng gnyis ka la dpag tshad gcig pa'i dang po gcig skra rtse zlum bu bkang ba las lo brgya brgya nas re re ston pas ma lus par stong pa'i yun la zhag gcig de sum cu la zla ba/ de bcu gnyis la lor byas pa'i lo brgya ni bskal pa chung ngu'i tshad yin la/ de la zhag gcig sogs rtsis pa'i rang lo brgya ni bar ma dang*/ de la zhag gcig sogs rtsis pas mchog gi bskal pa dang*/ de la zhag tu byas nas rtsis pa'i lo brgya ni bskal pa chen po yin la/ 'jig rten chags nas gnas pa'i yun ni bskal chen las kyang ring ste/ klu'i gnas dang dmyal ba dang por chung ngu'i tshe tshad/ de nas dmyal ba gnyis bar pa dang*/ de nas gnyis mchog dang*/ de nas gnyis bskal chen dang*/ dmyal ba brgyad pa 'jig rten sdud pa'i tshad du bshad do/ /mi dang*/ lha min dang*/ dud 'gro/ yi dwags kyi tshe tshad ma bshad la/ 'dod lha drug po skal chung gcig nas drug gi bar gyi tshe tshad do/ /gzugs dang gzugs med kyi tshe tshad la/ chos bzang gzugs med bzhi la / dang*/ tshangs pa bsam gtan bzhi pa/ dang*/ 'jig rten bsam gtan gsum pa/ 'das pa dang*/ dpal bsam gtan gnyis pa/ dang*/ dkar po'i bsam gtan dang po/ bskal pa rnams gzugs med na yas rim gyis sbyar/ rang rang gi mas rim nas gcig dang gnyis la sogs par sbyar dgos pa lta bur bstan pas/ gzugs kyi mi 'grel par/ de ltar na gzugs can rnams kyi bskal pa bcu drug ste gsungs pa ci yin brtag 'grel chen gyi lung dang bstun/ rnams mi gsal yang*/

gzugs med kyi bzhi po bskal chen du gsungs shing*/ mas rim nas gcig gnyis gsum bzhi sbyor bar gsal bar bshad pa dang*/ 'dod lha'i tshe bskal chung ngu bshad pas/ gzugs la bar ma dang mchog gnyis sbyar dgos la/ de yang 'og ma brgyad la/ bar ma gcig nas brgyad kyi bar dang*/ gong ma brgyad la mchog bskal gcig nas brgyad kyi bar sbyor ba las 'grel chung pad+ma can gzugs khams pa bskal pa 'bring po bcu drug sogs las med pas so zhes gsungs so/ ma 'das so/ / gsum pa la rtsom byed nyin zhag gi dang*/ des brtsam pa'i dus bzhi'o/ /dang po ni/ 'dir nyin zhag gi tshad gcig tu ma nges te/ srog chags bdun po rang rang gi dbugs nyi khri chig stong drug brgya la rang rang gi zhag re re byas pas so/ /srog chags bdun ni/ shig la sogs pa'i lus skyes phra mo dang*/ mi dang*/ yi dwags chen po dang*/ lha dang*/ lha min dang*/ nus pa'i ming can 'og min pa dang*/ gtso bo'i ming can srid rtse ba rnams so/ /de rnams kyi dbugs ni/ mi'i dbugs 'byung rngub gcig gi nyi khri chig stong drug brgya cha gcig dang*/ mi'i dbugs 'byung rngub gcig nyid dang*/ de sum brgya drug cu'i lo gcig dang*/ lo de nyi khri chig stong drug brgya ste dus bzhi rnams rim pa bzhin du bdun po'i dbugs yin la/ dbugs rang rang gi nyi khri chig stong drug brgya re ni rang rang gi zhag dang*/ de sum brgya drug cu ni rang rang gi lo yin pas/ phra mo'i lo gcig la ni chu tshod gcig las med pas zhag re la lo drug cu lon par 'gyur ro/ /yi dwags chen po'i zhag gcig la nyin zhag sum cu yod pas/ mngon par zla ba nyin zhag gi lnga brgya/ /zhes dang*/ bshes spring du/ lnga stong dag dang khrir yang 'chir mi 'gyur/ /zhes bshad pa rnams kyi kho rang gi nyin zhag gi yun 'di dang mnyam po yin la/ 'dir rang lo lnga brgya'i nges pa ni ma bshad do/

/de ltar na de'i lo gcig la ni/ mi'i nyin zhag khri dang stong brgyad brgya 'byung bas mi lo sum cu'o/ /lha'i nyin zhag gcig la mi lo gcig dang*/ lo gcig la mi lo sum brgya drug cu/ lha min gyi nyin zhag gcig la mi'i nyin zhag nyi khri chig stong drug brgya ste mi lo drug cu/ lo gcig la mi lo nyi khri chig stong drug brgya'o/ /nus pa'i zhag gcig la/ mi lo nyi khri chig stong drug brgya ste/ lo gcig la/ sa ya bdun bdun 'bum bdun khri drug stong*/ gtso bo'i zhag gcig la mi lo bye ba gnyis/ sa ya lnga/ dgu 'bum/ nyi khri yong ste/ lo gcig la ni zhag gcig gi lo grangs de sum brgya drug cus bsgyur bas mi lo ther 'bum dgu/ dung 'gyur gsum/ bye ba gsum/ sa ya gcig 'bum phrag gnyis rnams yong ba yin no/ /'on kyang 'di ni gtso bo chung ba gcig yin par byed dgos te 'di'i dbugs gcig la mi lo stong dang nyis brgya las mi 'byung bas so/ /'dir dngos su bstan pa'i gtso bo'i dbugs gcig la mi lo nyis khri chig stong drug brgya yong bar bshad pa ste| zhag tu longs na/ mi lo dung phyur bzhi/ bye ba drugs ya drugalnga 'bum drug khri rnams yong bas so/ /des na gtso bo chung ba 'di/ nam mkha' mtha' yas pa yin na brtag par bya'o/ /de ltar na rang rang gi dbugs drug la chu srang dang*/ de drug cu la chu tshod dang*/ de drug cu la nyin zhag dang*/ de bco lnga la phyogs dang*/ de gnyis la zla ba dang*/ zla ba gnyis la dus drug gi dus gcig dang*/ zla ba gsum la dus bzhi'i dus gcig dang*/ zla ba bzhi la dus gsum gyi dus gcig dang*/ zla ba drug la bgrod pa dang*/ de gnyis la lor byed pa ni kun la 'dra bar shes par bya'o/ /'dir rig byed kyi gzhung las skyes bu tshe lo brgya pa dbang po brgya pa zhes bshad pa la lung rigs kyi nges pa med de/ mi rnams kyi mchog gi tshe lo brgya'o/

/zhes pa ni rtog pas spros shing btags pa ste/ rdzogs ldan gyi tshe lo brgya las shin tu mang ba'i phyir ro/ /des na gtso bo chung ba'i 'pho chen g.yon pa la tshe lo brgya pa dang*/ g.yas pa la dbang po brgya pa zhes bya ste/ 'pho ba gnyis la nang gi zla ba gnyis dang dus drug gi dus gcig yong bas so/ /ji ltar na rang gi spyi'i chu tshod drug cu la zhag dang*/ chu tshod nyi khri chig stong drug brgya la lo yong ba bzhin du/ nang gi lo zla dbugs la chu tshod du byas nas byed pa'i phyir te/ dbugs drug cu la nang gi zhag gcigadabugs dgu brgya la phyogs stong brgyad brgya la zla bar bya la/ 'dir skyes bu rang rang gi 'pho ba re 'gro zhing*/ sum stong drug brgyas dus gcig 'grub pa'o/ /de bzhin du mi yi lo nyis brgya la yang sbyar te/ mi lo nyis brgya'i chu tshod kyi grangs dang dus bzhi chen po'i lo grangs mnyam pas so/ /'dir bu ston rin po ches/ dus bzhi chen po'i lo grangs dang gtso bor chung ba'i rlung dkyil 'khor bcu'i dbugs kyi grangs mnyam zhes gsung pa shin tu mi 'thad de/ kho rang gi dkyil 'khor lnga la kho rang gi dbugs grangs sum stong brgya las lhag pa yong mi srid la| srog chags gzhan gyi dbugs grangs ni de'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbugs grangs la sbyar don med pa'o/ / gnyis pa ni/ spyir gyi dus bzhi zhes bya ba ni/ rdzogs ldan dang gsum ldan dang gnyis ldan dang*/ rtsod ldan zhes bya ba bzhi la byed la/ 'di'i rnam gzhag lugs 'dir ma zad gzhung gzhan nas kyang 'byung ste/ skyes rabs la rdzogs ldan gyi sprin bzhin du gyur ro zhes sogs dang*/ ston pa shākya thub pa rtsod dus kyi sangs rgyas su bshad pa sogs yod pas so/ /'di'i dus bzhi ni/ sngon gyi 'khor los bsgyur ba lnga'i dus lta bu tshe lo dpag med nas cung zad kyang ma bri ba/ las dge ba bcu ka rdzogs par spyod cing*/

mi dge ba bcu ma tshang ba'i skabs ni rdzogs ldan dang*/ de nas tshe lo 'gribs pa'i mgo brtsams te dge ba bcu'i bzhi cha nyams pa dang*/ phyed nyams pa dang*/ bzhi gsum nyams pa rnams sum ldan gnyis ldan rtsod dus su byed par gsal lo/ /gzhung 'di nas 'byung ba las/ phal cher dus bzhi che chung gnyis bstan te/ che ba dh+ru ba stong pa la 'jug pa'i dus/ lo grangs sa ya bzhi dang gsum 'bum nyi khrir gsungs pa 'di dang*| chung ba 'khor los bsgyur ba 'khor ba'i dus lo grangs nyi khri chig stong drug brgya par gsungs pa gnyis yin la/ 'di la sangs rgyas bstan pa'i dus bzhi gcig dang*/ phyi dar drag po 'khor lo can nyid kyi dus bzhi'i gnyis su dbyer yod kyang*/ gnyis ka sa dum bu re re stong brgyad brgya par mnyam pas lo grangs mnyam par 'dod do/ kho bo ni/ 'di gnyis mi mnyam ste/ snga dar sangs rgyas bstan pa'i lo grangs la kla klo ma zhugs gong gi lo stong lnga brgya po lhag pas so| |des na bstan pa snga dar gyi dus bzhi/ phyi dar dang 'khor lo can gyi dus bzhi| dh+ru ba stong pa la 'jug pa'i dus bzhi ste gsum du bya'o/ /'di'i bar pa ni/ bsdoms pa'i lo grangs nyi khri chig stong drug brgya dang*/ re re la lnga stong bzhi brgya par mnyam la/ de yang dum bu re re dus bzhi lo grangs phyed dang lnga brgya par 'byung ba rnams bsdoms pa yin la/ snga mi'i phyi ma gsum de dang 'dra yang*/ rdzogs ldan la drug stong dgu brgya yod pa yin no/ /'khor los bsgyur ba'i 'khor tshul gyi skabs su/ drag po 'khor lo can rang nyid kyis dus bzhi kho na bshad pa ma yin nam/ ji ltar sangs rgyas pa'i bstan pa snga dar la dus bzhi bya zhe na/ rgyal po'i rgyab tu gsum ldan zhes pas rgyal por rang nyid kyi gsum ldan/ rtsod pa'i dus kyang mdun dag tu zhes pas/ sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rtsod ldan dngos su bstan la*/

shugs la/ de'i gsum ldan sogs kyang dngos su nges par grub pas so/ /rgyas par 'og tu bshad par bya'o/ /dus bzhi chen po ni/ bsdoms pa'i lo grangs sa ya bzhi dang*/ gsum 'bum nyi khri yin la/ de gtso bo chung ba'i 'pho chen gnyis kyi yun tshad yin pas/ phyed mar bgos pas sa ya gnyis| 'bum drug khri de ni 'pho ba re'i yun du 'gyur zhing*/ bsdoms pa'i lo grangs la bcus bgos pa'i bzhi 'bum gsum khri nyis stong ni 'pho chung re re'i yun tshad yin/ 'pho chung bcu po'i steng nas/ bzhi dang*/ gsum dang*/ gnyis dang*| gcig rnams rim pa bzhin du rdzogs ldan dang gnyis ldan rnams kyi yun tshad do/ /grangs ni/ 'pho chung re re ba'i tshad de nyid/ bzhi dang*/ gsum dang*/ gnyis kyi bsgyur ba dang ma bsgyur ba'i grangs so/ /'dir bsdoms pa'i lo grangs de sgrub pa'i tshul ni/ gza' brgyad kyi rgyu skar rdzogs par 'khor ba'i yun tshad la/ gza' rang gi zhag gcig tu byas pa'i zhag phyed dang gnyis la mi lo brgya yin pas/ zhag gsum la nyis brgya/ zla gcig la nyis stong*/ lo gcig la nyi khri bzhi stong 'byung la/ de ltar gza' rnams

gza'i lo gcig gi yun la mi lo gnyis 'pho 'di bsgyur gzhi/ bsgyur byed mi lo brgya tham pa yin la/ bsgyur gzhi la gza'i lo brgya tham pa zer ba 'di brtag kyi lo brgya'i yun tshad de mi lo brgya tham pas bsgyur ba la/ sa ya gnyis dang bzhi 'bum 'byung la 'di gtso bo 'pho chen gcig gi yun tshad du byas na/ bcu chas lhag pa'i skyon yod pas/ bcu cha sbyong ba'i phyir du gnas gnyis su byas pa'i 'og ma bcus bgos pa'i thob nor gyi gong ma sbyangs pa'i lhag ma la/ sa ya gnyis dang 'bum drug khri 'byung ba 'di gtso bo'i 'pho chen gcig gi yun yin pas/ de gnyis kyis bsgyur bas sa ya bzhi dang*/ gsum 'bum nyi khri po 'byung ba yin no/ /de ltar na gza'i lo gza'i lo gcig gi yun rang 'babs lo brgya zer ba 'di brtag brgya pos mi lo dgu cu bsgyur bas mchog rgyu yin pa la brgyas bsgyur na bcu cha sbyong ba ni rgyud kyi sdeb sbyor gyi khyad yin nam/ rgyu mtshan gzhan rnyed par dka'o/ / gnyis pa ni/ 'dzam gling chen po bye brag tu bshad pa la drugs gzhi la dum bu bcu gnyis/ nam mkha' la khyim 'khor bcu gnyis/ de gnyis la 'khor byed bcu gnyis thun mong du dus sbyor bcu gnyis/ dus sbyor la rten 'brel bcu gnyis/ de dag la blang dor bcu gnyis so/ /dang po ni/ gling bdun pa| phyi nas lan tshwa'i rgya mtshos 'khor zhing nang gangs can chen pos non pa'i lhag mar gyur pa/ zheng du dpag tshad nyi khri lnga stong*/ phyi'i mtha' skor la sum 'bum| nang gi mtha' skor la de'i phyed yod pa 'di la/ mchu zheng mnyam pa'i dum bu bcu gnyis byas pas re re'i phyi mtha' la stong phrag brgyad/ sum brgya so gsum cha re/ nang mtha' la de phyed yod pa pad 'dab lta bu bcu gnyis yod pas lho gling gsum/ nub gling gsum/ byang gling gsum/ shar gling gsum du gnas la/ dbus gling bzhi la/ 'dzam bu gling dang*/

nub ba lang spyod dang*/ byang sgra mi snyan dang*/ shar lus 'phags po zhes dngos su bshad cing*/ gling g.yog brgyad brgyad la/ mngon pa nas/ rnga yab dang rnga yab gzhan/ g.yo ldan dang lam mchog 'gro/ sgra mi snyan dang sgra mi snyan gyi zla ba/ lus dang lus 'phags zhes bshad pa bzhin gyi ming 'dogs dang gling dngos las chung par bshad pa sogs mi 'dod pas/ che chung mnyam po dang*/ ming la'ang lho gling shar ma dang nub ma zhes sogs kyi tha snyad las mi 'dod do/ /gling dbus ma bzhi'i dkyil na/ shar du rlung zlum po/ lho ru me gru gsum/ byang du chu zla gam/ nub tu sa gru bzhi rnams la rim bzhin du/ dpag tshad stong phrag bdun dang*/ brgyad dang*| dgu dang*/ bcu'i tshad du gsungs na'ang*/ 'og tu 'grel pas shar zlum po phyed pa dang*/ lho gru gsum dang*/ byang zlum po dang*/ nub tu sa gru bzhi rnams nang lus kyi dbyibs dang sbyar nas gsungs te/ mngon par/ shar gyi lus 'phags zla gam 'dra/ /zhes sogs dang tshul 'dra la/ 'on kyang byang dang nub gnyis go bzlog go /rtsa ba'i rgya dper yang*/ pūrbaṃ bā yār+dha bṛt+taṃbha bti zhes 'byung ba'i ar+dha phyed la 'jug pas/ rtsa ba dang dngos kyi 'grel par rlung zlum por bshad pa mi legs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa bdun gyi skar ma gnyis dang bzhi cha re la khyim du byas pa'i khyim bcu gnyis nam mkha' la 'khor ba la nam mkha'i khyim 'khor zhes bya bar grags pas/ khyim gyi gzhi ni rgyu skar la bya'o/ /des na thog mar rgyu skar gyi rnam gzhag bshad na/ tog gzungs nas/ drang srong skar ma la dga' bas skar ma'i mtshan nyid dang byed las bshad/ rma bya chen mo las/ smin drug nas bzung nas bdun tshan bzhi dang*/ shar dang*/ lho dang*| nub dang*/ byang phyogs rnams bsrung zhing skyong bar bshad/ garga'i mdo la sogs pas/ skar ma rnams re re zhing re rer rgyud/ grangs/ dbyibs/ rtag longs|

kha zas/ rigs kyi lha dang drug drug gis bshad pas/ tha skar ni/ rgyud drang srong rta len gyi/ grangs skar ma gsum/ dbyibs rta'i mgrin pa lta bu/ skar khongs la rtag longs yud tsam sum cu/ kha zas sbrang rtsi dang sha lha ni dri za la lhar 'dzin dri za'i bur yang bshad do/ /rgyud gzhan nas skar ma 'di rnams lha mor bshad do/ /bra nye ni/ bharga'i rgyud/ skar ma gsum/ dbyibs mo mtshan/ rtag longs snga ma bzhin/ kha zas til 'bras/ lha gshin rje'o/ /smin drug ni/ garga'i rgyud/ grangs drugadabyibs spu gri longs spyod sngar bzhin/ zas zho/ lha me lha'o/ /snar ma ni/ go'u ta ma'i/ grangs lnga/ dbyibs shing rta/ longs spyod yud tsam so lnga/ zas zho dang sbrang*/ lha ni skye dgu'i bdag po/ mgo ni/ ba ra dh+wa tsha'i/ grangs gsum/ dbyibs ri dwags mgo yud tsam sum cu/ zas ri dwags kyi sha lha zla ba'o/ lag ni/ ljang*/ sngon gyi grangs gcigadabyibs sog le/ yud tsam bco lnga/ lha drag shul can no/ /nabs so ni/ gnas 'jog gi skar ma gnyis/ dbyibs khang pa'i gdung*/ yud tsam so lnga/ zas mar dang khu ba| lha nyi ma'o/ rgyal ni/ garga'i/ skar ma gsum/ dbyibs ril ba/ yud tsam sum cu/ sbrang dang yos/ lha phur bu'o/ /skag ni/ mdza' bo'o/ /drug gam lnga/ sbrul mgo bco lnga/ sbrul sha sbrul lo/ mchu ni/ ser skya'i/ lnga'am/ drugasum cu/ til/ lha spen pa'o/ gre ni/ go tam/ gnyis/ rtsig pa/ sum cu/ 'bras| til/ khyab 'jug go /dbo ni/ e ta'i/ gnyis/ khri ltar 'phred la gnas pa/ zhe lnga/ khre/ nyi ma dang gshin rje'o/ /me bzhi ni/ 'od bsrung gi lnga/ lag pa/ sum cu/ bya sna tshogs kyi sha me lha'o/ /nag pa ni/ ka t+ya'i/ gcigapad+ma'i snying po/ sum cu/ shing toganyi ma can no/ /sa ri ni/ ka t+ya'i bu chen po'i/ gciganor bu rin po che/ bco lnga/ phye dang til 'thugarlung lha can no/ /sa ga ni/ kat+ya'i bu rgan pa'i/ bzhi/ ra'i rten mgo zhe lnga/ til dang me tog rgya sran/ dbang po dang me lha can no/

/ lha 'tshams ni/ spen pa'i/ bzhi| glang po'i sna/ sum cu/ chang dang sran chung*/ nyi ma can no/ snron ni/ legs byed kyi/ gsum/ them skas/ bco lnga/ sa lu dang 'bras thug go/dbang po'i/ snrubs ni/ ka t+ya na'i/ gsum/ seng ge'i ral pa/ sum cu/ nags kyi rtsa ba sogs/ lha ni sdom pa can no/ /chu stod ni/ kat+ya'i/ bzhi/ mchod rten/ sum cu| n+ya gro ta'i zas/ chu lha'o/ /chu smad ni/ stag dgu'i/ grangs bzhi/ gom pa g.yon pa'i rjes/ so lnga/ sbrang yos/ kun+da lhar 'dzin pa'o/ /rgyu skar nyer brgyad byed pa'i tshe dgos pa byi bzhin/ sred med bu'i/ gsum/ glang mgo drugarlung za/ tshangs pa'o/ /gro bzhin ni/ pho dpal gyi/ gsum/ lnga lta bu/ sum cu/ mar sar/ khyab 'jug go /mon gre ni/ gnas pa'i/ bzhi/ bya lta bu/ sum cu| byi ba'i sha nor lha'o/ /mon gru ni/ be rtse'i/ brgyad dam gcigame tog gi phung po/ bco lnga/ ra sha/ chu lha'o/ khrums stod ni/ skyo ba'i las kyi/ gnyis/ shing rta/ sum cu/ lug gi sha ra 'ba' zhig 'tsho ba'i lha'o/ khrums smad ni/ nor rgyal gyi/ gnyis/ shing rta/ zhe lnga/ bal sran/ sbrul lhar 'dzin pa'o/ /nam gru ni| drang srong dbang po'i/ so gnyis te gnyis dang 'brel ba gru sum cu/ sha dang phye| nyi ma'o/ /rgyud 'di rnams ni drang don sha stag go /de rnams las tha skar| mgo nabs so/ /dbo/ me bzhi/ nag pa/ sa ri rnams rlung*/ bra nye/ smin drugargyal/ mchu*/ gre sa gakhrums stod rnams me/ lag skagasnrubs/ chu stod| mon gre/ khrums smad/ nam gru rnams chu/ snar ma/ lha mtshams/ snraun/ chu smad| byi bzhin/ gro bzhin/ mon gru rnams sa khams yin par drang srong gargas bshad mod kyi/ skar ma 'di rnams kyi dbyibs dang khams la sogs pa rgyud 'grel 'dir mi gsal lo/ /de ltar rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad du grags kyang*/ byi bzhin ni/ longs spyod nyung bar bshad pa ltar skar khongs kyang gro bzhin dang gang sngon la yod mi shes pa lta bur mig skar la mngon sum gyi grub pas dor nas nyi shu rtsa bdun du byas pa'i steng nas khyim 'jog la/

de yang skar ma gnyis gnyis dang bzhi cha re khyim rer byas nas/ tha skar/ bra nye/ smin drug gi rkang pa gcig rnams lug khyim/ de'i gzhi gsum/ snar ma/ mgo'i phyed rnams glang khyim| de'i phyed/ laganabs so'i bzhi gsum rnams 'khrig pa'i khyim/ de'i bzhi cha/ rgyal/ skag rnams skar ka ṭa'i khyim/ mchu/ gre/ dbo'i bzhi cha rnams seng ge'i khyim/ de'i bzhi gsum/ me bzhi/ nag pa'i phyed rnams bu mo'i khyim| de'i phyed/ sa ri/ sa ga'i bzhi gsum rnams srang khyim/ de'i bzhi cha/ lha mtshams/ snron rnams sdig khyim/ snrubs/ chu stod/ chu smad kyi rkang pa rnams gzhu khyim/ de'i bzhi gsum/ gro bzhin/ mon gre'i phyed rnams chu srin gyi khyim/ de'i phyed/ mon gru/ khrums stod kyi bzhi gsum rnams bum pa'i khyim/ de'i bzhi cha| khrums smad/ nam gru rnams nya'i khyim du bshad pa rnams ni/ gling dum bu kun tu khyim gyi ming 'dogs dang skar ma dang*/ rkang pa de rnams la khyim de rnams su byed pa ni khyad par med mod kyi/ khyim gyi yun tshad la/ chu tshod mang nyung dang*| de yong ba yang skar ma so so'i longs spyod mang nyung dang*/ de yang skar khongs yang dog mngon sum gyi grub pa dang mthun par 'byung ba dang*/ gong gi garga'i skar ma'i bstan bcos nas/ longs spyod mang nyung bshad pa 'di rnams ni gling chung dum bu 'di ka'i dbang du byas pa'i rnam bzhag yin no/ /de bzhin du| dbyar nyi karka ṭa dang dgun nyi chu srin du bzlog par bshad pa yang*/ gling dum bu de'i dbang du byas pa dang*/ 'di'i nang nas kyang*/ kai la sha'i dum bu'i dbang du byas pa yin par shes dgos so/ /de ltar na gling chung 'di'i dbang du byas nas lug khyim la chu srang mkha' dgu lag ste/ chu tshod bzhi dang chu srang lnga cu/ glang la mkha' dus mig ste/ chu tshod bzhi dang chu srang nyi shu/ de ltar de gnyis la chu tshod phyed kyi khyad/ 'khrig pa la mkha' mkha' gnyis te/

chu tshod gsum dang chu srang nyi shu/ de ltar na de gnyis la chu tshod gcig gi khyad/ kar seng bu mo gsum la rim pa bzhin du chu tshod lnga dang drug dang phyed dang bdun te/ de ltar 'khrig kar la chu tshod gcig dang chu srang bzhi cu/ kar seng la gcigaseng ge bu mo la phyed kyi khyad zhugs pa dang*/ srang sogs drug po snga ma'i lugs zlog tu gnas te/ de ltar na de khyim bar yangs pa drug ni karka ṭa nas gzhu'i bar dang*/ dog pa drug ni/ chu srin dang 'khrig pa'i bar drug yin te/ yangs pa drug la bsdoms pa'i chu tshod so lnga/ dog pa drug la nyi shu rtsa lnga 'byung ba 'di ni/ chu gter srog dang chu srang me ni nyin zhag so sau'i dus su 'phel 'grib bgrod pa'i yan lag gis zhes pa drug cu'i drug chas 'phel 'grib byed pa sham+bha la'i dbang du byas kyi/ 'grib pa dang 'phel ba drug chas so zhes pa drug cu'i drug chas 'pheb 'grib byed pa 'dzam gling chung ngu 'di'i yul dum bu drug gi nang nas gnyis pa kai la sha'i dbang du byas nas gsungs pa yin zhing*/ dbyangs 'char gyi rgyud la dus sbyor chu tshod 'dir bshad pa dang ma mthun pa yang dum bu gzhan gyi dbang du byas pa yin pas gling chung ngu 'di'i dum bu rnams kyang dus sbyor gyi yun tshad dang nyi ma ldog mtshams mi mthun pa yin pas dus sbyor dum bu drug tu grags pa'i rtsi tshul legs par shes dgos pa yin no/ /'di dag cung zad zhib par 'dzam gling chung ngu'i khyad chos kyi skabs su bshad par bya'o/ /de ltar spyir gling so so dang khyad par yul so so la khyim gyi longs spyod mi 'dra bar yong ba ni rang rang so so la snang ba'i skar khongs yangs dog gi dbang gis de la nyi zla sogs kyi spyod pa bul myur dang*/ 'char ba'i skar khongs rdzogs pa bul myur gyi yin pa las ma 'das shing*/ rgyu mtshan des na/ khyim skar 'di dag kyang nyi ma'i go la bzhin du mtho dman du byas nas 'khor te/

dper na/ gling chung 'di'i dgun nyi ldog dus/ nyi mas skar ma/ phul dang 'grogs te 'di'i nam mkha'i shar nas nub kyi bar du phyin pas/ srod la nub tu bya sbom bzhug gam gro bzhin mon gre nub ri'i rtse dang*/ mgo lag rgyal gsum shar ri'i rtser la de'i bar ni/ de ring nyi mas spyad pa'i khyim drug po yin zhing*/ de rnams khyim bar dog pa'i mthar thug drug po yin pas nyi ma thung ba'i mthar thug pa dang*/ mtshan mo nabs so nas bre'i bar skar khongs yangs pa'i khyim drug po shar nas nub kyi bar la bgrod dgos la de rnams khyim bar yangs pa'i mthar thug yin pas mtshan mo ring ba'i mthar thug 'byung zhing*/ nyin zhag de nyid la sgra mi snyan gyi nyin mtshan go bzlog pas na/ 'dir khyim drug po shar nas nub kyi bar la bgrod dgos la de rnams khyim bar yangs pa'i mthar thug yin pas mtshan mo ring ba'i mthar thug 'byung zhing*/ nyin zhag de nyid la sgra mi snyan gyi nyin mtshan go bzlog pas na/ 'dir khyim bar dog par snang ba drug po gling der yangs par snang ba las ma 'das shing*/ de ltar 'byung ba yang*/ rang rang gi nam mkha' la sgur por byas nas mtho ba'i tshe yangs pa dang*/ gshong mor byas nas dma' ba'i tshe dog par snang ba las ma 'das so/ /'di yang phal cher mngon sum gyis grub ste/ dog pa'i mgo lag rgyal gsum dang*/ phul sbo gzhug gsum sogs skar ma che ba dang gsal bar snang zhing*/ yangs pa'i wa nas phul gyi bar phal cher skar ma chung bar snang la/ che chung yang nam mkha' nyid nas che chung mnyam pa gcig yod kyang*| mtho dman gyi snang mkhan la nye ring gi che chung du snang bar grub ste/ zhi gza' gnyis la skar chen du grags la/ mig dmar/ spen pa skar chung du snang ba yang dma' dang mthon po'i gzar bshad pa bzhin mtho dman gyis yin pa bzhin no/ / gsum pa la/ sa gzhi la dus dang*/ rgyal po gnyis 'khor tshul dang*/ nam mkha' la gza' chen po bcu 'khor tshul lo/

/dang po la/ dus 'khor tshul dang*/ 'khor lo bsgyur ba 'khor tshul lo/ / dang po ni/ da ltar dang sngon gyi mngon pa kha cigagling bzhi'i dus bzhi thams cad mnyam po yin te/ 'dzam gling na dbyar nyi ldog pa'i nyin zhag de nyid la gling bzhi ka'i dbyar nyi ldog pa dang*/ 'di na ston nyinamatshan mnyam pa dang dgun nyi ldog pa dang*/ dpyid nyin mtshan mnyam pa'i nyin zhag de nyid la gling gzhan gsum na'ang de rnams yod pa yin te/ de lta min na/ nam phyed nyi ma nub pa dang*/ /nyi ma phyed dang 'char dus gcig/zhes pa mi srid pas so zhes zer ro/ /'di ni shin tu mi rigs te/ nyin mtshan gyi rnam gzhag la sogs pa mngon sum dang mi mthun pa'i rgyud 'di dang shin tu 'gal ba'i phyir dang*/ 'di dang mi bstun na'ang*/ mdzod kyi 'grel bshad du/ 'di ni ston dpyid nyin mtshan mnyam pa'i dus kyi nyin zhag gnyis la srid kyi gzhan la mi srid par bshad pa dang*/ 'gal ba'i phyir dang*/ gtso bor rigs pas gnod pa'i phyir te/ gling 'di'i nyi ma nub nas/ sang shar shar gyi bar dang*/ byang sgra mi snyan gyi nyi ma shar nas/ dgong mo nub nub kyi bar yun mnyam mi mnyam/ mi mnyam na/ rtsa ba'i dam bca' dang 'gal snyam na/ dgun nyin ldog khar/ 'dir nyin mo yud tsam nyi shu rtsa bzhi las med cing mtshan mo yud tsam so drug yod pas/ byang sgra mi snyan gyi nyin mo la 'di'i mtshan mo dang mnyam por byung bas gling thams cad kyi dgun nyi ldog kha'i nyi ma thung mnyam yin pa'i dam bca' la gnod tshabs shin tu che ste blun po'i blo'i 'jug pa la dgag pa rgyas par bya mi dgos so/ /yang mngon pa ba kha ciga'agrel bshad kyi lung gtso bor bzung nas lho byang dbyar mnyam dang*/ shar nub ston dpyid dang de mthun du 'khor ba'i sgo nas nyi ma'i go la lcags sgrog gam mtshon cha'i 'khor lo bzhin du 'khor te/ mtshon cha'i 'khor lo bzhin du rgyu/ zhes rma bya chen mor bshad pas kyang ngo zhes zer ro//

'dis kyang gling 'di'i dbyar kha byang bgrod mthar thug gi nyin mo yud tsam so drug byas pa'i mtshan gang de la byang sgra mi snyan gyi byang bgrod mthar thug nyi ma ring mtha' yin pas yud tsam so drug yod par khas blangs pas 'di'i nyi ma shar nas kyang yun ring por byang sgra mi snyan gyi nyi ma mi nub pa dang*/ 'di'i ma rgas gong du byang du 'char ba sogs su 'gyur ba dang*/ 'di'i byang bgrod las lho bgrod mthar thug gi nyi ma 'char snga ba dang 'char ba sogs mtho bar 'gyur ba'am/ yang na lho bgrod kyi dus su shar nub kyi 'gram du yol bas bsgribs pa'i phag nas nyi ma 'gro dgos par thal ba sogs kyi gnod cing*/ gtso bor ni/ 'dir sa dum bu bcu gnyis la dus bzhi rim can du 'khor ba dang nyin mtshan mnyam pa dang bgrod pa gnyis kyi mthar thug rim gyis 'khor bar gsungs pa dang 'gal bas las snang so so'i dbang gis gnyis ka srid par khas len na ma gtogs lugs de dag ni 'dir mi 'dod do/ /'o na 'di'i rang lugs kyi dbyar dgun ston dpyid sogs kyi dus rnams g.yas su 'khor ram g.yon du 'khor zhe na| 'di la dus kyi 'khor lo'i tshul khong du chud par rlom pa'i mkhas rlom kha cig na re/ 'og gi sa'i go la 'am dus bzhi yang g.yon du 'khor te/ nam mkha'i nyi mas khyim la bskor ba'i dbang gis sa gzhi'i dus 'khor ba gang zhig nyi mas khyim la g.yon du bskor ba'i phyir te rang bgros g.yon du bskor ba'i phyir dang*/ khams le'i nga gsum pa'i 'grel par/ 'dir shar gyi phyed du lug

go |dbang ldan du glang ngo*/ byang gi phyed du 'khrig pa'o/ /zhes sogs g.yon du bskor nas shar gyi phyed du nya'o/ /zhes pa ni 'og la khyim dgod pa'o/ /zhes dang*| tshigs bcad drug cu'i 'grel par/ lhun po'i lho yi dum bu 'dir lug la nyi ma gnas pas dpyid kyi dus sa ga'i zla ba byed do/ /me yi zur gyi phyed dum bu gnyis pa la snron gyi zla ba byed do/ /de bzhin du me'i zur gyi phyed dum bu gsum pa la chu stod kyi zla ba byed do/ /zhes sogs g.yon du bskor nas/ bden bral gyi zur gyi phyed gzhan gyi dum bu la nag po'i zla ba byed do/ /zhes sogs gsal bar bshad pas so zhes zer ro/ /'di ni shin tu mi rigs te/ tshigs bcad nga lnga nga drug pa rtsa 'grel gyi legs par bkag pa'i phyir te/ gang phyir ri la skye bo rnams kyi nyin mtshan mnyam par 'gyur te lug nyi srang gi nyi ma la'o/ / zhes pas/ dum bu so so nas bca' ba'i bdun pa de rang rang phan tshun ltos nas gcig tu dpyid nyin mtshan mnyam pa'i zhag de la bdun par ston nyin mtshan mnyam pa dang*/ gcig tu ston nyin mtshan mnyam pa'i zhag de la bdun par dpyid nyin mtshan mnyam par 'gyur zhes spyir rnam par bzhag nas so so la sbyar ba| gling chung 'dir lug khyim du dpyid nyin mtshan mnyam pa'i zhag de la byang sgra mi snyan du lug khyim/ ston nyin mtshan mnyam pa dang*/ 'dir srang khyim du ston nyin mtshan mnyam pa na byang du srang*/ dpyid mnyam pa dang*/ de bzhin du cung zad bden bral gyi zur du glang sdig nyi ma/ gnas pa dang*/ dbang ldan gyi zur phyed kyi char gnas pa la yang*/ zhes de gnyis glang dang sdig pa la yang sbyar ba nas g.yas su bskor te/ bcu gnyis pa me'i zur gyi phyed gzhan la gnas pa dang*/ rlung gi zur gyi phyed gzhan la gnas pa la nyi ma nya dang bu mo la gnas pas nyin mtshan mnyam pa gnyis su 'gyur te/ zhes tshigs bcad nga lnga par nyin mnyam pa la sbyar ba'i 'jug tu/

nga drug pas nyi ma ldog mtshams la sbyar nas kyang g.yas bskor du gsal bar gsungs pa 'di na da lta dpyid gnas pa de'i dbyar sleb pa na nub tu 'pho zhing*/ 'di'i ston sleb pa na byang du 'pho nas nub tu dbyar gyi sleb| 'di'i dgun sleb pa na dpyid shar du sleb nas byang du dbyar dang nub tu ston 'byung ba'i tshul gyi g.yas su 'khor ba yin no/ /'o na snga ma'i lung rigs kyi don ci yin snyam na/ rigs pa ni 'gal bas khyab pa yin la/ lung gi don ni| 'khor tshul g.yas su 'khor yang da lta yod tshul g.yon bskor du yod pa yin te/ 'di'i dpyid dus de nyid na shar na dbyar dang byang na ston dang nub na dgun yod pa dang*/ zla ba yang 'di'i dpyid zla tha chung gi dus de nyid na/ 'di'i me zur gyi dum bu na dbyar zla ra ba dang*/ de'i shar ma na dbyar zla 'bring po dang*| shar drang po na dbyar zla tha chung la sogs pa g.yon bskor du gnas yod par gsal bar gsungs pa yin pas/ 'khor tshul dang gnas tshul 'khrul pa'i grub mtha' 'di lta bu yang rnam dpyod zhib mor rlom pa'i rtsing po yin no/ /des na 'dir snron gyi zla ba byed do/ /sa ga'i zla ba byed do zhes sogs ni lo tsā bas don 'gyur byas pas 'khrul gzhi bzos pa yin te/ dbyar zla ra ba byed do/ / dpyid zla tha chung byed do zhes sogs su 'gyur gzhan la yod pa ltar sgra drang 'gyur byas na 'khrul gzhi med par gnas pa la shong gi mkhas khyad kyi skabs 'dir 'khrul gzhi bzos zhing*/ 'dul ba rtsa 'grel du skar ma'i ming gis zla ba bstan yod pa rnams dbyar zla 'bring po nya'i 'o zhes sogs bod la grags che ba la dgongs nas cog ros don 'gyur byas pas 'dul 'dzin la 'khrul par bskyed pas mkhas pa'i mkhas pa la yang 'khrul pa cung zad 'byung bar nges so// de ltar gnas tshul dang 'khor tshul 'khrul ba ni nam mkha'i khyim 'khor la yang mang du byung snang ste 'og tu bshad par bya'o/

/ gnyis pa ni/ bcom ral gyi rtsod dus 'khor los bsgyur ba 'byung bar bshad pas mngon pa dang 'gal zhes bkag pas 'jigs nas/ kun mkhyen bu ston gyis kyang 'khor los sgyur ba 'khor bar bshad pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'khor ba yin zhes gsung la/ kha cigabastan pa lnga stong du gnas pa 'dzam gling chen po mtha' dag gi lo grangs bsdoms pa'i dbang du byas par thag bcad nas/ dum bu dum bur 'khor bar yang yang bshad pa rnams khyad du bsad de/ mi 'khor bar dus gcig la dum bu thams cad du kla klo cig char du 'joms par 'dod cing*/ rgyal po'i rgyab tu sum ldan zhes sogs kyang*/ rgyab kyi sa'i dum bu la mi byed kyi/ rgyab phyi ma dang don gcig pas rgyal po'i phyi zhes pa dang*/ mdun zhes pa sngon du zhes par bsgyur nas 'chad par byed do/ /skabs 'di'i mdun rgyab ni/ bu ston rin po che dang bla ma dam pa yang priṣ+ta rgyab dang phyi ma gnyis ka la 'jug pa las phyi zhes bshad par bya'o zhes gsungs ngo*/ /'di dag ni rang dga' dang 'dod rigs kyi bshad pa kho nar snang ste mdun gyi tshig mnyam po la/ kla klo rnams kyang g.yul du bcom ste rang gi chos la bgod pa byas nas mdun du rnam par rgyu/ /zhes pa'i mdun 'di sngon du zhes par bshad ma shes nas rang sor 'jog dgos kyi 'dug pa'i phyir dang*/ 'di dang le'u 'di'i 'jug dang*/ nang le sogs su kla klo dang 'khor lo can gnyis ka sa dum bu la 'khor bar yang yang bshad pa dang*/ dum bu dum bu zhes dang*/ dum bu gang du zhes sogs kyi tshig thams cad nus med du 'gyur te/ gcig car du 'khor ba'i phyir ro zhes dang*/ dus rnams dag gi lo'i grangs ni zhes sogs dang*/ sa gzhi dag la dus bzhi nus pa'i tshad du 'jug ces sogs don med du 'gyur te/ sa gzhi la dus bzhi'i lo grangs la phan rgyu stong brgyad brgya las med pa'i phyir ro/ / sa re re la dus mnyam du stong brgyad brgya re yod pa bsdoms pas nyi khri chig stong drug brgya 'byung ngo zhe na/
