/zhes pa'i gsal zhes pa'ang gsal byed kyi gsal du snang bas gza' lhag pas mi gsal la gcig po de dman par byas na gsal ba zhag tu 'gyur zhes par snang zhing*/ bla ma dam pas/ dper na zla ba gsum gyi dh+ru ba la gza' bzhi 'byung*/ zla ba gsum gyi mi gsal zhag ma bdun gyis bgos pa'i lhag ma lnga 'byung bas gcig sbyong ba yin zhes gsung yang*/ gsal zhag gi grangs res gza' dang bstun dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan du mi snang bas da dung rgyu mtshan btsal bar bya'o/ /'grel tshig des/ res gza' dang bstun pa'i phyir du gnas gnyis su byas pa'i 'og ma bdun gyis bgos nas e mthun lta zhing ma mthun na snon 'brid byed par bstan pa'ang dka' bar snang bas lag len 'di yang bla ma snga ma dag gis sbyar bar zad do/ gza' lnga'i rtsis 'di rnams sdu na gsum du 'du zhing*/ rags pa dkyil 'khor gyi rtsis/ 'bring po khyim gyi rtsis/ zhib pa skar ma'i rtsis zhes bya'o/ /dang po ni/ /drag gza'i dal ba bar pa dang*/ zhi gza'i rkang 'dzin longs spyod du grags shing*/ gnyis pa ni/ dal dag dang rkang 'dzin dag par grags pa dang*/ gnyis pa ni/ myur rkang gi cho gas dag par byas pa'i 'bras bu yin no/ /de yang dkyil 'khor ni gza' rang rang gi rgyu skar gyi 'khor lo rdzogs par 'khor ba'i nyin zhag la sogs pa yin la/ de yang drag gza' gsum la zhag gi rjes 'brang med pas mig dmar la ri klu dus dang*/ phur bu la so me chu gter dang*/ spen pa la drug ro ri mkha' zla ba rnams nyin zhag gi grangs yin la/ zhi gza' gnyis la lhag pa la zhag gya bdun chu tshod nga brgyad/ chu srang bcu gnyis rnams dkyil 'khor yin pas rjes 'brang gzhug pa'i phyir du thams cad brgya yis bsgyur nas 'khor los phud pas nyin zhag gi brgya cha ri bug ri klu byung bas bgo bya'ang brgyas bsgyur nas 'god pa yin la/ dkar po la nyin zhag nyis brgya nyer bzhi dang chu tshod zhe gnyis yod pas chu tshod gzhug pa'i phyir du gnyis ka bcus bsgyur nas 'khor los phud pas ri rgyal mig byung ba nyin zhag gi bcu cha'i dkyil 'khor yin pas bgo bya'ang bcus bsgyur te/

'di'i bcus bsgyur bcus bgod 'di paṇa chen shākya shrīs ma mkhyen pas paṇa chen rgyug pa'i 'phrang du grags so/ /zhi gza' gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor dang po yang rgyu skar 'khor tshad kyi dkyil 'khor ma yin gyi/ rkang pa'i 'gros rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor yin no/ / drag gza'i dkyil 'khor de rnams kyis rgyu skar gyi chu tshod stong drug brgya nyi shu la bgos pa'i rnyed nor rjes 'brang dang bcas pa thams cad kyi gza' so so'i nyin zhag re'i rtag longs dang nyin zhag la khyim zhag dang tshes zhag byed tshul sngar bshad pa bzhin byas pa'i grub 'bras rnams ni zhag nyer gnyis kyi rtag longs dang de dag sum cus bsgyur ba rnams zla ba gsum po so so'i rtag longs dang*/ khyim zla'i rtag longs bcu gnyis kyis bsgyur ba rnams ni lo'i rtag longs su shes par bya zhing 'bras bu rnams 'dir bris na yi ge mang gi dogs shing blo kha phyogs pa la 'di tsam gyi rtogs par nus la/ ma phyogs pa la mgo 'khrug pa'i rkyen du 'gyur bas kyang ma bris so/ /dkyil 'khor de rnams kyis gsal zhag la bgos pa'i rnyed nor rnams ni gza' so so'i rtsis gzhi 'di la rgyu skar 'khor zin pa'i grangs yin la/ lhag ma rnams skar mas bsgyur bas bgos pa'i nor rnams rkang rtsis ma byas pa'i rags rtsis kyis skar ma gang gi steng du sleb rtogs par nus la/ lhag ma rnams rgyud 'grel du dbugs kyi bar las ma gsungs shing*| 'dod na zad zad bar du so sor bsgyur zhing bgos pa rnams ni chu tshod man gyi longs spyod dpyad zin rnams 'char ba yin no/ khyim rtsis kyi rgyu mtshan nyi ma'i skabs su bshad zin zhing skar ma'i rtsis kyang skar ma phyed dang bcu bzhi po rkang pa'i chu tshod kyi grangs mi mnyam pas ri mo so sor bshad la/ snga rkang dang phyi rkang gnyis kyang sdom grangs mnyam pa gcig ma byung na snga rkang la 'phel ba dang phyi rkang la 'grib pa shed mtshungs pa mi yong la/

grangs de yang snga rkang gnyis sdoms pa phyi rkang bdun sdom pa gnyis mnyam pa'i nges pa med de/ skar ma yar bdun dang mar bdun lugs 'byung lugs zlog gi tshul gyis chu tshod mnyam par ma nges pa'i phyir ro/ /der ma zad phyi rkang gi bdun pa ni phyed pa yin pas kyang der ma nges so/ /des na lugs 'byung lugs zlog gi rim pa dang rim min gang yin kyang*/ rkang bzung sdun ma bcu bzhi la ma bab kyi bar du skar ma'i longs spyod chu tshod drug cu yin pas drug cus lhag ma rnams bsgyur ba dang*/ bcu bzhi pa la bab pa yan phyed ma yin pas sum cus bsgyur la/ snga rkang dang phyi rkang la spyad zin dang ma spyad pa sdoms pa sogs ni sngar bshad pa ji lta ba bzhin te rgyu mtshan la khyad par med pas so/ / gnyis pa ni/ rang rang gsal zhag tu grags pa byed pa la rang rang gi rtsis 'phro sbyin dor dgos pa rnams byed pa rnams yin te/ rtsis gzhi 'di'i ya mtha' me mkha' rgya mtsho la lag pa gdengs can zla bas sbyangs ma thag gi thog mar rang rang gi dkyil 'khor rdzogs ma thag pa lhag chad med pa yin na sbyin dor mi dgos kyang*/ dkyil 'khor rdzogs rjes dkyil 'khor tshar gnyis pa gcig gi steng nas zhag la sogs pa thogs re 'das tshar na gang 'das de bsres nas lhag ma rnams dang bcas pa 'khor los phud pa'i lhag ma dang*/ yang na sngar gang 'das de'i lhag ma dang spyod rgyu'i grangs de dor nas 'khor los phud pa'i lhag ma dang gcig tu yongs pas na/ 'dir mig dmar la rtsis gzhi'i sngar 'das zin bsres shing*/ gza' gzhan bzhi mgo brtsams na da spyod rgyu rnams sbyong bar mdzad pa yin la/ 'das zin bsres pa dang da spyod rgyu'i 'dor ba gnyis gnad gcig tu yong ba 'di yang rnam pa kun tu ma nges kyang gza' lnga'i skabs kyi rtsi tshul 'di lta bu la nges pa yin pas khyad med kyang 'dir gcig la bsre ba dang bzhi la sbyong ba mdzad pa ni sdeb sbyor sogs kyi dgos pa tsam du zad do/

/dper na mig dmar gyi dkyil 'khor ri klu dus kyi steng nas/ nyin zhag ri dus gcig sngar 'das la/ lnga brgya nyi shu da spyod rgyu yin pas ri dus gcig gis bsres pa dang*/ lnga brgya nyi shu sbyangs nas rtsis pa gnyis la khyad med pa bzhin no/ /de bzhin du drag gza' gzhan gnyis la'ang sbyar la zhi gza' gnyis la ni nyin zhag gi brgya cha dang bcu cha sngar 'das pa'i lhag ma gang lus rtsis kyi gzhi 'di'i lo dag gi steng nas da spyod rgyu dor nas rtsi ba yin no/ /de ltar rtsis pa'i grub 'bras la rang rang gi skyes khyim sbyong ba dang sbyangs rjes de ma thag nas rang rang gi lho bgrod kyi khyim drug la rim pa yin pas khyim rkang gi longs spyod bu lon dang*/ de rjes kyi khyim drug byang bgrod rim min yin pas nor du 'gyur tshul sogs ni nyi ma la sbyar ba bzhin no/ /'dir drag gza'i khyim rtsis rang rang gi dal bar la byed cing*/ zhi gza' gnyis kyi nyi ma bar pa la byed pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ zhi gza' gnyis dang nyi ma khyim gyi longs spyod khyad par med pas yin no/ /dal

drag gza'i/ dag gis nyi par dang*/ nyi dag gi zhi gza'/ rkang 'dzin dag pa gnyis la sbyong ba ni mthon po'i gza' yis dma' ba'i gza' la spyod sbyong zer ram/ dgos par gsungs pa gang zhig zhi gza' las nyi ma mtho la de las drag gza' gsum mtho bas yin no/ /rtsis tshan gsum po de'i rgyu mtshan la/ dkyil 'khor gyi rgyu mtshan ni/ rags pa ni 'og nas zla ba'i phyogs dang nyi ma'i bgrod pa dag ces sogs so/ /lo brgya la gza' dgu'i rang zhag phyed dang gnyis su byed pa'i skabs dang*/ zhib par/ zla ba la ni sa skyes longs spyod chu tshod dgu cu dag ste zhes sogs tshigs bcad gnyis kyi bstan te/ gza' rang rang gi rgyu skar rdzogs par 'khor ba rnams bsdoms pa'i lo grangs la gza' kun gyi zhag gcig tu byas zhing*/ gza' so so'i rgyu skar 'khor ba'i phyed la rang gi mtshan mor mdzad pa na/ zla ba'i phyogs te nyi ma'i bgrod pa dag dang sa skyes zla ba dgu rnams dag gis mtshan mo'o/ /zhes sogs kyis zla ba'i mtshan mo ni zla ba phyed dang*/ nyi ma'i mtshan mo ni lo phyed dang*/ sa skyes kyi mtshan mo ni zla ba dgu| de bzhin du bla ma'i lo drug pa sangs zla skyes gnyis kyi bgrod pa re re/ nyi skyes kyi lo bco lnga/ mun can gyi lo dgu rnams mtshan mo'i char bshad pas de rnams ldab tu gyur pa ni/ rang rang gi zhag re re rgyu skar rdzogs par bshad pa rnams kyi dkyil 'khor rags pa bstan to/ /de yang nyi ma dang zhi gza' gnyis ni lo res rgyu skar rdzogs pa zhib rtsis mi dgos la/ gzhan rnams ni rags rtsis yin te/ zla ba la zhib par zhag nyer bdun sogs dkyil 'khor yin kyang 'dir zla gcig tu bshad pa'i phyir dang*/ sa skyes kyi dkyil 'khor la nyin zhag ri klu dus su bshad pas de sum cu bgos na zla ba nyi shu rtsa gnyis dang zhag nyer bdun yongs la/ 'dir zla ba bco brgyad las ma bshad pa'i phyir dang*/ bla ma'i so me rgya mtsho sum brgya drug cus bgos na lo bcu gnyis dang nyin zhag bcu gnyis yong la/

'dir lo bcu gnyis las ma bshad pa'i phyir dang*/ spen pa'i drug ro ri mkha' zla ba rnams su brgya drug cus bgos na/ lo nyer dgu dang nyin zhag gsum brgya nyer drug las mi 'byung bas/ lo sum cur zhag so bzhis ma longs kyang 'dir lo sum cur bshad pa'i phyir dang*/ sgra gcan gyi zla phyed kyi dkyil 'khor la bzhi brgya drug cu byung ba lo bcu dgu dang zla ba gnyis yod kyang*| 'dir lo bco brgyad du bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na zla ba la ni sa skyes longs spyod chu tshod dgu bcu zhes sogs tshigs bcad don bzhi don lnga pa gnyis kyi ni zhib par rtsis ji ltar bstan zhe na/ gza' lnga'i khyim zla gsum gyi longs spyod bsdoms pa'i chu tshod kyi grangs ni dbu ma'i lo gsum gyi zhag grangs dang*| mjug rings kyi lo gsum gyi longs spyod ni phyogs gsum gyi zhag grangs dang sbyar nas bstan te/ de yang zla ba gcig gis sa skyes kyi longs spyod la chu tshod dgu bcu 'byung zhes pa ni 'jig rten la grags pa khyim zla bco brgyad kyis rgyu skar 'khor ba zhag re la chu tshod gsum spyod pa'i dbang du byas pa yin kyang*/ de'i steng du zhi gza' gnyis kyi zla re'i chu tshod brgya so lnga re re bsnan pas sum brgya drug cu dang*/ de zla ba gsum gyi tshe na lo gsum zhag grangs stong dang brgyad cu po 'byung zhes dngos su bstan nas drag gza' gzhan gnyis kyi longs spyod dngos su ma bstan pas/ mig dmar gyi nang du bsdus par shugs la go zhing*/ longs spyod 'di ni gsum gyi'o zhes pa'i tshig zur dang*/ de ma thag tu zla gcig gi bla ma'i longs spyod la chu tshod drag po rkang bcas dang*/ spen pa'i longs spyod la chu tshod phyed dang lnga dngos su bshad pas/ mig dmar gyi dgu cu po'i steng nas de gnyis kyi chu tshod bco lnga dang chu srang zhe lnga po phri dgos par grub la/ de yang zhib tu rtsi na/

rgyu skar gyi chu tshod stong drug brgya nyi shu po la mig dmar gyi dkyil 'khor ri klu dus kyi bgos pas zhag re la chu tshod gnyis/ srang nyer gcigadabugs gnyis/ de'i bcu cha dgu rnams khyim zla gcig la nyin zhag so phyed dang gcig tu gsungs pas des bsgyur bas chu tshod gnyis cung lhag byung ba ni zla gcig gi longs spyod dang de zla ba nyer gnyis dang*/ zhag re'i rtag longs zhag nyer bdun gyis bsgyur ba rnams bsdoms pas dkyil 'khor 'grub pa yin no/ /de bzhin du gza' gzhan la'ang rang rang gi dkyil 'khor gyi rgyu skar chu tshod la bgos pa'i zhag dang zla ba'i rtag longs bsags pas rgyu skar gyi chu tshod du nam longs pa de'i tshe na rgyu skar 'khor ba yin pas de la zhag grangs su byung pa de dkyil 'khor du grub pa yin no/ /gza' lnga'i dkyil 'khor ri klu dus la sogs pa lnga po bsdoms pa'i grangs nyi khri drug stong brgyad brgya nyi shu rtsa dgu'i rgyu mtshan ni/ dbu ma'i lo gsum gyi zhag grangs gza' lngas bsgyur bas lnga stong bzhi brgya po/ zla ba'i yon tan lngas bsgyur bas nyi khri bdun stong las/ 'khor byed 'dor ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis bgrod pa gcig gi nyin zhag brgya brgyad cus dman pas nyi khri drug stong brgyad brgya nyi shu'i steng du/ mngal gyi zla ba dgu'i bu lon zhag dgu bsres pa las grub bo/ khyim rtsis kyi rgyu mtshan ni/ dbu ma'i lo gsum phyogs gsum gyi zhag gi steng nas zla gcig sgra gcan dang mjug rings la gzhan zla ba sum cu so phyed dang bdun po yon tan brgyad kyis bsgyur ba las/ nyis brgya go gza' lnga'i dal rkang lnga bsdoms pa la grangs 'di byung ba yin/ gnyis 'byung ba/ gza' lnga'i dal rkang gi grangs rkang grangs bsdoms pa dngos 'di yin/ kyis bgos pa yin la/ myur rkang gi rgyu mtshan ni lo gsum phyogs gsum zhag gi steng du mngal gyi bu lon zhag dgu bsnan pas zhag stong dang brgya

gza' lnga'i myur rkang lnga bsdoms pa'i rkang grangs 'di 'byung*/ so bzhi 'byung ba rnams kyis zhag re'i drug cu'i chu tshod re re ba stong myur rkang gi grangs 'di bsdoms pa dngos 'di yin/ dang brgya so bzhi po gza' lnga'i myur rkang gi grangs la so sor bgos pa las grub pa ste/ rkang pa so so'i grang la mang nyung ni khyim so so'i rdzogs yun ring thung dang*/ skar ma so so rdzogs pa'i yun ring thung gi yin tshul nyi ma la sbyar ba'i rigs pas shes par bya ste 'dir rgyas par bris na yi ge mang gi dogs pas bsdus so/ mjug rings kyi longs spyod ni/ sgra gcan gyi longs spyod las btsal dgos te/ 'di ltar gza' lnga'i khyim rkang la ma spyad pa'i zla ba gcig po yon tan brgyad kyis bsgyur ba ni sgra gcan mjug rings gnyis kyi thun mong gi longs spyod yin te/ nyi ma'i khyim rkang dang po'i phyed la gsum dang*/ zla rkang gi zla ba myos byed ces pa dang po dang bcu gsum pa'i tshes 'char ba'i lnga po ste brgyad po de yin pa'i phyir/ brgyad po de'i steng nas phyed ni mun pa med pa'i rang bzhin yin pas sgra gcan gyis mi spyod pa'i phyir na rags rtsis dus kyi nyin zhag ces pa lo gcig la dus drug tu byas pa'i dus gcig ste zla ba gnyis la zhag drug cu 'byung bas zhag drug cu drug cu na nyin zhag re 'chad cing*/ zhib rtsis drug cu re bzhi na nyin zhag re 'chad pa de zla ba'i longs spyod kyi steng nas nyams shing nyi ma'i longs spyod la lhag par 'gyur bas rags rtsis zhag re la chu tshod gnyis gnyis lhag pas khyim zla re na tshes zhag re rags rtsis la lhag por 'byung ba de zla re chu tshod phyed phyed sgra gcan gyis ma spyad pa'i dbang gis yin par gsungs te/ mdor na zla nyi sgra gcan gsum gyi longs spyod so so la re bzhi cha dang so gnyis dang bcu drug cha bu lon du song ba'i don yin no/

/de ltar sgra gcan gyi zla ba gcig gi longs spyod chu tshod phyed dang brgyad so gnyis kyis bsgyur ba ste zla ba gnyis kyi longs spyod la chu tshod bco lnga 'byung ba de/ zla phyed kyi longs spyod chu tshod gsum dang chu srang zhe lngas bgos pas chu tshod bzhi thob pa ni/ mjug rings kyi zhag re'i rtag longs yin la/ der ma zad/ slar yang sgra gcan gyi zla ba'i longs spyod las chu srang bdun dang phyed phrogs nas de gsum gyi bsgyur bas/ nyi shu rtsa phyed gsum 'byung ba yang de'i rtag longs su 'gyur ro/ /'di ni nyi ma'i nyin zhag gi rtag longs la chu srang nyer drug yod kyang tshes rtsis kyi skabs su 'og ma mes thob ces chu srang nyi shur byas pa byed pa la ltos pa bzhin du/ 'di yang byed pa la ltos pa yin gyi grub mtha' la ma ltos te/ nyi ma'i gang spyod mjug rings kyis kyang spyod pas chu srang phyed dang bzhi chad par gsungs so/ /'on kyang 'dir byed pa nyid kyi dbang du byas nas nyi ma'i rtag longs la 'di'i rtag longs kyi sbyangs pa'i lhag ma chu srang phyed dang gsum lus pa ni/ 'di'i dgos kyi rtag longs te de yang rgyu bar chu srang phyed bcas gnyis spyod ces pa lo gsum gyi bar du chu srang phyed dang gsum gsum ni nyin re bzhin nyi ma las lhag por spyod la/ de yang myur 'gros kyi tshe kha shar du bltas nas spyad pas nyi ma'i shar du dgongs mo char bar rtsom la| de nas phyogs gsum la zhag re re zhing chu tshod gnyis gnyis rtag longs su 'gyur bas zhag dang po na mthong ba mthong yang zla gcig gi bar du du ba med par mthong bas ngos zin pa dka'/ des na mtha'i zla phyed/ phyir la log pa'i zla phyed de zla gcig gi bar du ba dang bcas par mthong zhing*/ de nas yang zla gcig du ba med pa'i skar ma bzhin du mthong ste/ phyogs gsum phrag gnyis nyi ma dang bral bar 'gyur bas phrag gnyis ka'i ring la chu tshod gnyis gnyis zhag re zhing spyod do/

/de nas yang lo gsum gyi bar du dal 'gros byas nas zhag re la chu srang gsum gsum spyad pas nyi ma dang mnyam por rang du 'gyur la slar de bzhin du 'khyog 'gros byas par snga dro nyi ma'i nub tu mthong bar rtsom pa man chod snga ma bzhin du sbyar te/ lo gsum gyi longs spyod rnams bsags pa la chu tshod zhe lnga 'byung ba phyogs gsum gyi zhag grangs dang mthun pa yin no/ /'di la 'khyog nyur gnyis dngos su bshad la 'gros gzhan gnyis med pa dang yod par 'dod pa mi mthun pa byung yang*/ dal 'byung gi 'gros ma byas na myur 'khyog mi shes pas na yod par 'dod pa 'thad do/ /de ltar na mjug rings kyi rgyu skar 'khor ba la nyi ma dang mnyam pas lo gcig gis chog kyang 'gros bzhi rdzogs pa la lo 'gros bzhi rdzogs pa la lo drug dang zla ba gsum gong du gsungs kyang*/ bcu gnyis dang zla ba drug dgos te/ myur dal 'khyog 'byung re re zhing lo gsum phyogs gsum dgos pas so/ /zhi gza' gnyis kyi 'gros bzhi la yang 'di'i rigs pa sbyar nas rtsis bar bya'o/ /bzhi pa dus sbyor bshad pa la/ spyir bshad pa dang*/ bye brag gling chung 'di'i dus sbyor bshadapa'o/ /dang po ni/ gong du phra dbugs dh+ru dang zhes sogs kyis bstan pa'i srog chags so so'i nyin zhag thams cad la rang rang gi dus sbyor 'char te rang rang gi 'pho chen bcu gnyis po thams cad rang rang gi dus sbyor yin pa'i phyir te/ gtso bo'i 'pho chen gnyis la dus bzhi chen po rdzogs par dngos su bshad pa dang*/ rgyal po lo ni mtha' dag rjes su nyin zhag dus sbyor chu tshod dag dang chu yis srang rnams te/ zhes sogs rgyas par gsungs pas so/ /bye brag mngal skyes rnams la/ lte ba'i rtsa 'dab bcu gnyis las dus sbyor bcu gnyis kyi rlung 'pho ba bcu gnyis rgyu ba rnams sna bug g.yas g.yon du 'pho zhing*/ de yang lte ba'i g.yon gyi dus sbyor rnams sna bug g.yon dang g.yas kyi dus sbyor rnams sna bug g.yas nas 'char ba'i tshul gyi rgyu la/

rtsa chen bcu gnyis po re re la 'dab ma lnga lnga gyes pa'i g.yas kyi cha drug las sa chu me rlung nam mkha' rnams bsdud rim dang*/ g.yon gyi cha drug las nam mkha' rlung me chu sa rnams skye rim du rgyu ba sna bug gnyis las kyang de bzhin te/ gnyis ka'i dbus dang steng dang khur tshos dang ka ba dang mchu rnams rim pa bzhin du nam mkha' rlung me chu sa rnams rgyu ba'i gnas yin la/ g.yon gyi lnga la yi ge a -i ṛ u l̥ rnams gza' sgra gcan zla ba lhag pa sangs mjug rings rnams kyis bdag byed la/ g.yas kyi lnga la yi ge l̥̄ ū ṝ ī ā rnams 'char zhing gza' spen pa phur bu mig dmar nyi ma dus me rnams kyis bdag byed/ re re yang rags rtsis la chu tshod re re ste 'pho chen re re la chu tshod lnga lnga zhib par rtsi na/ 'pho mtshams su dbugs nga drug bzhi cha sos dman pa rnams g.yas 'pho g.yon 'pho la 'byung ba dang*/ de yang sa dum bu bcu gnyis kyi mngal skyes so so la dus sbyor rnams sa dum bu'i dbang gis nam mkha'i khyim bar mi mnyam pa dang de 'byung ba yang nang gi dus sbyor gyi dbang gis yin pas so sor nges pa dang*/ dum bur re re la yang yul dum bu drug la sogs pa so so'i dbang gis so sor re re ye shes kyi rlung du rgyu bas chu tshod lnga la stong brgyad brgya rgyu ba'i steng nas nga drug bzhi cha nges pa sogs shes par bya la/ phyi rol gyi dus sbyor ni/ rgyu skar gnyis dang rkang pa re re 'char ba la lug la sogs pa'i dus sbyor du bzhag la/ phyi'i dus sbyor 'di yang gtso bor nyi ma la sbyar nas lo re la dus sbyor bcu gnyis su bzhag pa'i skabs mang zhing 'dis mtshon nas rang rang gis rgyu skar gnyis dang rkang pa re spyod pa'i bar la dus sbyor du bzhag pa sgra gcan dang spen pa sogs gza' re zhing dus sbyor bcu gnyis tshang bar yod pa yang shugs kyi thob bo/

/zhag re zhing gi dus sbyor grags che ba dang spang blang bshad pa rnams ni/ zhag re la rgyu skar nyer bdun tshar re 'char ba'i skar ma gnyis dang rkang pa re re ni rdzogs rdzogs kyi bar la dus sbyor du bzhag pa 'di yin la/ 'di dang dbyangs 'char sogs su dus sbyor gyi rtsis dang rnam bzhag gsungs pa rnams ni gtso bor nyi ma la sbyar ba lo gcig gi nang nas 'das khyim dang 'das pa'i zhag rnams dang por rtsis nas de gzhir byas te zhag re'i dus sbyor bcu gnyis po'i steng nas nyin mo cha bdun thur ma btsugs pa'i dus de phan la sngar 'das dang da lus pa rnams gang yin dang*/ da ltar ba de la gtang skal du grags pa'i rtsi tshul sogs yin no/ /phyi'i dus sbyor 'di dag nang gi dus sbyor gyi dbang gis bzhag pa yin mod kyi/ phyi'i dus sbyor la nang bzhin du 'pho mtshams dbu ma'i dus sbyor ni dngos su gsal bar yang ma bshad cing don la bzhag pa yang dka' mod kyi/ 'on kyang zhag re'i phyi'i dus sbyor re re la rags rtsis chu tshod lnga lngar dang des dkyil 'khor lnga lngar bshad pa dang ye shes kyi cha la zla nyi sgra gcan gsum gyi bu lon 'byung tshul sogs ni bshad do/ /gtso bor phyi la sbyar ba'i dus sbyor 'di dag gi rnam gzhag dbyangs 'char gyi rgyud la brten nas rgyas par bshad pa'i yi ge zur na yod pa ltar shes par bya la/ 'dir khams dang zhing bdag gsungs tshul cung zad bshad na/ khams ni/ dbang sgrub gnyis las nag pa sa ga lug glang yin pas rlung*/ de bzhin du 'khrig kar me/ seng ge bu mo chu/ srang sdig pa/ gzhu chu srin ye shes/ bum pa nya nam mkhar bshad/ ye le'i rgyud kyi dag pa'i skabs su/ chu srin bum pa nya gsum thugs rdo rje'i zhal nag dmar dkar/ lug glang 'khrig gsum gsung rdo rje'i zhal dmar dkar nag

kar seng bu mo gsum sku rdo rje'i zhal dkar dmar nag srang sdig gzhu gsum ye shes rdo rje'i zhal ser dmar dkar po ste/ dkar po rnams snying stobs/ dmar po rnams rdul/ nag po rnams dang ser po rnams mun pa'i yon tan du bshad/ ye le'i khyim gyi khams nyid bshad pa'i skabs su/ chu srin nas 'khrig pa'i bar rnams phung po drug gi rnam shes 'du byed tshor ba 'du shes gzugs ye shes kyi phung po yin pas nam mkha' rlung me chu sa ye shes kyi khams/ karka ṭa nas gzhu'i bar drug po de las lugs zlog tu bshad pa rnams khams ma mthun pa ci zhe na/ dbang sgrub tu gsungs pa ni yi ge'i sgo nas yin te/ de yang khams le'i brgyad par rdo rje nyi ma'i skabs su 'byung ba dag las ni lho bgrod bskyed rim byang bgrod drug sdud rim mdzad 'dug 'dir gsung yin dgongs pa brtag ni byang bgrod la nyi ma 'phel bas bskyed rim dang*/ shes rab gtso che ba'i nyi ma 'phel ba dus sbyor sogs dang bstun dbang gi yin nam/ lho bgrod la nyi ma 'grib pas bsdus rim du byas pa'i yi ge'i sgo nas bzhag pas ni/ ye le'i khams nyid ston pa dang mthun la/ dbang sgrub kyi yi ge ni g.yon g.yas kyi dus sbyor thabs shes su gnas pa bzhin du phyi'i zla ba gnyis gnyis kyi thabs shes su sbyar nas thabs la bskyed rim thung ngu dang shes rab la sdud rim ring po byas pa'i rnam gzhag yin zhing*/ rgyud kyi dag pa'i skabs ni/ rdo rje'i bzhi'i rdul mun snying stobs sbyar ba'i nang tshan gyi mdog dang*/ rdo rje bzhi po yang bskyed rim du bstan pa yin pas lus bsam dang gnas skabs la ltos nas bstan pa tsam yin la/ rang gi ngo bo'am lus kyi sgo nas ni ye le'i brgya dang dgu cu par bshad pa de nyid gtso bor bzung dgos so/ /des na dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor yug gi skabs su khyim bcu gnyis kyi khams dang mdog kyang de nas bstun nas bshad pa yin no/

khyim gyi zhing bdag ni/ rags pa dang phra bganyis las/ lo la 'khor ba'i khyim gtso bor gyur pa rags pa'i dbang du byas na karka ṭa'i zla ba seng ge'i nyi ma/ lug dang sdig pa'i mig dmar/ 'khrig pa bu mo'i lhag pa/ gzhu dang nya'i phur bu/ glang dang srang gi pa sangs/ chu srin bum pa'i spen pa yin par khams le dang ye le'i gnyis kar du gsungs shing*/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud dang rdo rje gdan gzhir 'di dang mi mthun zhing de gnyis kyang mi mthun te gzhan du bshad zin to/ /phra ba zhag re la dus sbyor bcu gnyis rdzogs par 'char ba dang re re yang chu tshod lnga lnga'i dbang du byas nas nang gi 'pho chung re dang phyi'i chu tshod re la yi ge gang 'char dang khams gang yin dang bdag gang gis byed bshad pa ni/ nyi ma lug khyim na yod pa'i khyim rags pa ma rdzogs kyi bar la nyi ma'i 'od zer shar ma thag nas gzung ste chu tshod lnga'i bar la lug khyim dang de nas lnga'i bar la glang khyim sogs 'char ba'i lug la'ang chu tshod lnga'i chu tshod dang po la yi ge nya yig khams nam mkha'/ gza' sgra gcan/ nang gi gnas sna bug g.yon gyi dbus nas 'char ba yin/ de na chu tshod gcig la yi ge dzha/ khams rlung gza' zla ba/ nang gi gnas sna bug g.yon gyi steng nas 'char ba sogs sngar bshad pas shes la/ des na glang gi chu tshod dang po la/ yi ge tsā mgo chu srin nas bzung gsal byed ka sogs 'char phyin glang la/ nga sogs 'char ba a rigs snyam pa rtag/ ring po/ khams sa/ gza' spen pa sogs ring po dud rim du 'char ba sogs kyi dus sbyor gyi khams dang*/ bdag po'i rnam gzhag kyang bshad do/ /bye brag gling chung 'di'i phyi'i dus sbyor la/ 'dzam gling chung ngu la yul dum bu drug ste/ lho nas byang du rim pas/ 'phags yul dang*/ bod dang*/ li yul dang*/ rgya nag dang*/ kai la sha dang*/ sham+bha la rnams te/ de drug la nyin mtshan ring thung gi bar khyad rim pa bzhin du zhag gcig gi bcu cha dang dgu cha dang*/

brgyad cha dang*/ bdun cha dang*/ drug cha dang*/ lnga cha rnams gsungs pas lnga cha la chu tshod bcu gnyis dang*/ drug cha la bcu dang*/ bcu cha la drug rnams yong ba ni rtogs sla la/ bdun cha la chu tshod phyed dang dgu dang*/ chu srang bzhi dang*/ dbugs gcig dang*/ dbugs kyi bdun cha lnga rnams 'byung*/ brgyad cha la chu tshod phyed dang brgyad/ dgu cha la chu tshod drug dang chu srang bzhi bcu re rnams 'byung ngo/ /de ltar na chu gter srog dang chu srang me ni nyin zhag so so'i dus su 'phel 'grib bgrod pa'i yan lag gis// zhes bshad pa ni/ sham+bha la'i dus sbyor lnga cha'i dbang du byas pa yin la/ gzhan du na sham+bha la la drug cha'i dbang du mdzad pa kho na'o/ yul 'di la gangs ldan chen po zhes kyang grags so/ /'di'i zhag re zhing gyi chu srang gsum dang dbugs bzhi po 'di ni nyin zhag gsumabargya re lnga'i phyed kyi zhag brgya brgyad cu gya phyed dang gsum gyis bsgyur ba la chu tshod bcu gcig cung lhag las mi 'byung bas lnga cha yin par 'dod pa rnams ni mi 'thad de/ 'di'i thad du tshad 'di la lhor bgrod pa'i 'pho ba'i nyin zhag la chu tshod so drug gis nyin mor 'gyur zhing*/ nyi shu rtsa bzhis mtshan mor 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsal bar gsungs pas 'gyangs khyad kyi tshad chu tshod bcu gnyis par gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /dum bu gnyis pa kai la sha'i nyin mtshan 'phel 'grib ni/ nyin zhag so sor de ni dbugs zung chu srang gsum/ /zhes pas bstan la nyin mtshan ring mtha' la chu tshod so lnga dang thung mtha' la nyer lngar 'gyur ba yin 'gyangs khyad kyi tshad/ no/ /dum bu gzhan rnams la ni/ 'grel par/ 'phags pa'i yul du/ nyin mtshan so so la chu srang gnyis 'phel ba'am 'grib par bya ste zhes pa tsam las gzhan la ma gsungs shing*/ kai la sha'i dang 'phags yul gyi 'di gnyis ni khyim zhag gi dbang du mdzad pa yin te/ kai la sha'i chu tshod bcu po dang 'phags yul gyi chu tshod drug po chu srang sogs su byas pa la zhag sum brgya drug cu'i phyed brgya dang brgyad cus bgos pa'i rnyed nor

'phags yul kai la sha yin pa'i phyir ro/ /tshul de dum bu gzhan la'ang sbyar na/ gangs can chen po la chu srang bzhi/ bod la chu srang gnyis dang dbugs gcigadabugs kyi drug cha gnyis/ li yul la chu srang gnyis/ dbugs gnyis dbus kyi sum cha gnyis/ rgya nag la chu srang gnyis/ dbugs bzhi/ de'i bdun cha gsum cung lhag rnams 'byung la/ de la dpags nas nyin zhag tshes zhag la 'phel 'grib kyang rtsis pas shes so/ des na khyim rang rang gi yun tshad sngar bshad pa'i lug gi dus sbyor la ni chu srang du 'gyur mkha' dgu lag ste mkha' dus mig ni glang la 'gyur/ zung dag la yang mkha' mkha' gnyis te mda' ro'i chu tshod du 'gyur ku li ra dang seng ge la'o/ /bu mo la ni phyed bcas drug ste nges par srang sogs rim pa min pas de bzhin thams cad 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa rnams ni yul dum bu lnga pa kai la sha'i dbang du byas par gsungs la/ g.yul rgyal gyi rgyud nas gsungs pa da lta dus sbyor gyi yig cha rnams su 'byung ba/ nam mkha' mkha' zung lug gi tshad/ /nam mkha' rig byed mtshe ma glang*/ /stong pa nor lha zung 'khrig pa/ /mkha' so karka ṭa ru dran/ /mkha' dus me rnams seng ge la'o/ /nam mkha' mkha' mtsho bu mor dran/ /rim pa'o rim pa min pa las/ / srang sogs zlog go gangs ri'i bdag /ces bshad pa dang 'di'i rgyud tshig shin tu ma mthun pa ci zhe na skyon med de/ g.yul rgyal de ni gangs ldan chen po'i dbang du byas par bshad pa'i phyir te/ der/ karka nyin mo sum cu drug /mtshan mo nyi shu rtsa bzhi'o zhes bshad pa'i phyir dang*/ khyim yun thung ba drug po rnams bsdoms pa la nyer bzhi dang ring ba drug po rnams bsdoms pa la so drug 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /de yang ring ba'i karka ṭa la chu srang nyi shu dang*/ bu mo la chu srang bcu'i khyad zhugs la seng ge la mnyam por snang yang*/ g.yul rgyal gyi lugs dang 'di'i 'khrig pa mnyam por 'gyur la/

de'i 'khrig pa dang*/ 'di'i lug zer ram/ lugs la'ang chu srang bcus 'di mang ba ci zhe na/ mang nyung ni lnga cha dang drug cha'i dbang gis yin te/ glang la'ang g.yul rgyal nyi shus nyung ba'i phyir ro/ / lug 'khrig ha cang ma mthun pa ni/ drang srong gis sbas pa yin pas go zlog nas bshad dgos par bla ma dam pa sogs gsungs ba rigs te/ ma log na khyim rkang go log dgos par thal bas so/ /'di gnyis kyis mtshon nas bdun cha brgyad cha sogs la'ang yun tshad so sor shes dgos te zur du rtsi bar bya'o/ /sa skya pa grags pa seng ges yul drug gi dus sbyor rgyas par sbyar ba dag la ni yid ches bya bar dka' ste/ g.yul rgyal nas 'byung ba'i gangs can chen po'i tshad dang mi mthun pa'i/ klu nor mig ni lug gi tshad/ /lag pa 'byung mig glang yin no| zhes sogs rang dgar rang 'dod kyis sbyar ba mang du snang ba'i phyir ro/ / de ltar na dus sbyor 'di la yul drug gi dus sbyor dang*/ dum bu drug gi dus sbyor zhes pa gnyis shes dgos te/ yul drug ni gling chung 'di la ji skad bshad pa bzhin 'grel chen du gsungs pas mi bya mi rung la/ gling chung 'di la yod pa bzhin du rgyu mtshan mtshungs pas gling gzhan la'ang sbyar dgos par gsal la/ drug po'i nang nas bod du ni bod kyi dus sbyor legs par rtsi bar bya ba yin gyi da lta bshad pa byed pa dang lag la len pa dag ni lnga cha drug cha gang rung la rten par snang ngo*/ /dum drug ni/ ril po dang*/ phyed pa dang*/ gsum cha dang*/ dgu cha dang*/ bcu gnyis cha dang*/ sum cu cha'i dus sbyor du bshad pa rtsis lo lta bu'i rtsis 'bras 'char ba rnams yin te/ gzhan du bshad zin pa las shes par bya'o/ /lnga pa rten 'brel bcu gnyis ni/ chos mngon pa las 'byung ba'i ma rig pa nas rga shi'i bar yin la/ gzhung 'dir de dag gi mtshan nyid dang byed las dbye ba lta bu sogs rgyas par mi 'byung bas rnam gzhag rgyas pa ni mngon pa las shes par bya la/

'dir nang gi 'pho chen bcu gnyis dang rten 'brel bcu gnyis sbyar ba'i skabs mang zhing*/ bsgrub ler mngal gyi zla ba bcu dang*/ dang po bcu legs par sbyar/ skye rga gnyis mi gsal yang*/ skye ba ni rtsa ba'i skabs dang*/ rga ba ni spyir na chu tshod 'gyur ba'i gnas skabs thams cad rga ba yin mod kyi/ der mngal gyi skabs ni lus rdzogs pa dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog dang*/ btsas ma thag pa ni ngag rdzogs pa las rgyal mchog dang*/ de nas lo bco lnga'i bar ni sems rdzogs pa thig le'i rnal 'byor dang*/ lo bcu drug gi skabs ni bde ba rdzogs pa phra mo'i rnal 'byor du gsungs la/ rten 'brel tha ma gnyis las rgyal mchog la tshang bar bshad pas rga shi yongs grags rang la ma sbyar zhing*/ de dag rten 'brel de dag tu 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan gsal bar yang ma gsungs mod kyi/ gnas skabs de dag tu rten 'brel de dag gi mtshan nyid shas che ba tsam nas bzhag par gsal te/ rgyas par 'og nyid du bshad par bya'o/ /'dir ni spyir gzhung lugs gzhan du rten 'brel rnams zla ba dang phyogs dang zhag la 'char tshul dang*/ shar la rten nas skye ba dang*/ las dang*/ phyogs dang*/ rkun po dang*/ nad pa rnams brtag pa dang*/ mig 'gul ba dang*/ rna ba ngu ba dang*/ rkang lag sogs lus kyi cha shas 'khrig pa dang g.ya' ba la sogs pa'i ltas la rten pa'i rten 'brel gyi mtshan ltas mang po bshad pa rnams 'dir 'bras bu phal cher ma nges pa dang*/ nges pa rnams rtsis kyi 'bras bu gzhan las rtogs pas rgyas par ma mdzad par/ 'grel chen du gsungs pa ltar/ spros pa rgyas pa rnams dor nas/ zla ba la 'char tshul dang*/ tshes la 'char tshul gnyis dngos su rgyas par dang phyogs la 'char tshul ma sbyar yang 'char ba tsam du gsungs nas/ mnyam mi mnyam gyi 'bras bu cung zad dang bcas pa rnams/ tshigs bcadabargya bcu gsum pa la sogs pa lngas gsungs pa rnams kyi don bsdu na/ spyir khyim zla bcu gnyis po re re la rten 'brel re re 'char ba'i rags pa lo gcig la tshar gcig rdzogs pa dang*/

phyogs re re la re re 'char ba'i 'bring po lo gcig la tshar gnyis rdzogs pa dang*/ zhag re la re re 'char ba'i phra ba zla re la tshar gnyis gnyis rdzogs pa rnams gsungs so/ /de'i dang po ni/ chu srin gyi khyim nas gzung ste gzhu'i bar la ma rig pa nas rga sha'i bar 'char bar gsungs la/ chu srin gyi khyim ni/ spyir nyi mas phul gyi bzhi cha rdzogs nas gzhu khyim rdzogs pas de rjes de ma thag nas 'dzin pa yin la/ khyim der nyi ma zhugs ma thag tu dgun nyi sdog par mang du bshad pa ni kai la sha'i dbang du byas pa yin pas bod du nyi mas skar ma der ma sleb pa'i skar khongs gcig gi gong du dgun nyi ldog ste/ dbyar nyi karka ṭa'i khyim du sleb ma thag ldog par bshad pas/ rgyu skar drug dang rkang pa gsum/ 'das tshe dbyar gyi nyi ma ldog ces brjod rgyu min kyang*/ rgyu skar drug pa'i rkang pa gsum 'das tshe dbyar gyi nyi ma ldogaces da ltar grags pa bod kyi dbang du byas pa yin zhing*/ de nas drug zhe lnga re rdzogs rjes/ ston nyin mtshan mnyam pa dang*/ dgun nyi ldog pa dang*/ dpyid nyin mtshan mnyam pa rnams 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ khyim de dag gi rags par ni zla ba bcu gnyis dang sbyar la/ de yang kha cig na re/ dpyid 'bring nag pa lug gi khyim/ /zhes grags pa ltar na/ chu srin rgyal zla la bab kyang*/ /'dir/ rgyal gyi zla bar nyi ma chu srin la son zhes sogs kyi 'grel par rgyal 'das shing mchu mjug pa'i mtshams su chu srin zhes dang*/ rgyal dang mchu'i mtshams su chu srin gnas par bshad pas/ mchu zla la chu srin/ dbo la bum pa/ nag zla la nya la sogs pa bstan par 'dod cing*/ de yang mchu srin rgyal la gtso che yang*/ mchu la srid pa'i dbang du byas zhes 'chad pa ni mi rigs te/ skabs 'dir zla ba mar ngo sngon 'gro mdzad nas rgyal gyi nya ba'i phyis nyin mchu zla'i mgo tshugs la de nyin ma rig pa 'char ba nas brtsams te/

chu srin gyi khyim gyi mar ngo la lugs zlog dang*/ de bzhin du bum khyim gyi mar ngo la 'du byed nas brtsams te lugs 'byung 'char ba la de bzhin du nya la rnam shes sogs sbyar zhing*/ de ma thag gi 'grel par yang yar ngo sngon 'gro'i rgyal zla'i yar ngo la spro rim dang mar ngo la sdud rim/ mchu zla'i yar ngo la sdud rim dang mar ngo la spro rim du gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ des na rgyal zla'i mar ngo la chu srin gnas par bshad pas de'i sngon gyi yar ngo la chu srin yod pa 'gog mi nus pas na rgyal dang chu srin sogs sbyar te/ rgyal zla chu srin gyi khyim la ma rig pa 'char/ mchu zla bum pa'i khyim la 'du byed/ dbo zla nya'i khyim la rnam shes sogs sbyar ba ni rags pa zla ba la 'char ba'o/ /phyogs la 'char ba ni| yar ngo sngon 'gro'i rgyal gyi zla smad ma rig pa mchu'i yar ngo 'du byed/ mar ngo'i rnam shes/ dbo'i yar ngo gzugs sogs so/ /tshes zhag la 'char ba ni/ rgyal gyi mar ngo'i tshes gcig la ma rig pa/ gnyis pa la rga shi gsum pa la skye ba nas/ bcu gnyis la 'du byed de lugs bzlog ji bzhin dang*/ de nas bcu gsum la ma rig pa dang*/ bcu bzhi la rga shi mi 'char bar rang dang bcas pa'i gnyis gnyis dor nas 'char bas bcu gsum la skye ba bcu bzhi la srid pa/ bco lnga la len pa/ tshes bcu drug lhag pa'i skabs byung na sred pa ste/ mar ngo la lugs zlog de ltar dang*/ mchu'i zla ba'i mar ngo la 'du byed nas brtsams te lugs 'byung gi tshes bcu gnyis la ma rig pa/ bcu gsum pa la sngar bzhin 'du byed rnam shes gnyis dor nas ming gzugs bcu bzhi la skye mched drugabaco lnga la reg pa/ de bzhin du dbo zla'i mar ngo la rnam shes nas brtsams te lugs snga ma bzhin gyi lugs zlog nag pa'i mar ngo la ming gzugs nas brtsams te lugs 'byung snga ma bzhin sbyor bar gsungs la/ yar ngo rnams la ni|
'og tu rgyal gyi dkar po'i phyogs kyi tshes gcig la ma rig pa'o/ /

gnyis pa la 'du byed spro ba'i rim pa'o/ /nag po'i phyogs kyi tshes gcig la ma rig pa'o/ /gnyis pa la rga shi ste de ltar nye bar bsdud pa'i rim pas ces sogs dang*/ mchu la 'du byed nas 'go 'dzin pa dang*/ dbo la rnam shes nas 'go 'dzin pa sogs bshad pas gsal bar bstan te/ rgyal la ma rig pa nas rga shi'i bar bcu gnyis dang*/ tshes bcu gsum la rnam shes/ bcu bzhi la ming gzugs/ bco lnga la skye mched rnams 'char ba dang*/ mchu zla la 'du byed nas/ ma rig pa'i bar bcu gnyis kyis rjes su tshes bcu gsum la ming gzugs sogs te/ de bzhin du dbo zla sogs la'ang sbyar bar bya'o/ /de ltar na rgyal zla'i phyogs gnyis ka la ma rig pa nas mgo 'dzugs pas yar ngo sngon 'gro'i rgyal zla ril po la ma rig pa'i zla ba dang mchu zla ril po la 'du byed kyi zla ba zhes sogs su brjod par bya ba yin no/ / drug pa blang dor bcu gnyis la/ gza' sogs lnga la dang*/ dbyangs sogs bdun la rten pa'i blang dor ro/ /dang po la/ gza' tshes/ skar sbyor/ byed pa la brten pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gza' bcu po ngo bo'i sgo nas/ sgra gcan/ zla ba*| lhag pa/ pa sangs/ 'jug rings rnams zhi gza'/ gzhan lnga drag gza' yin pas zhi gza' blang bya dang*/ drag gza' dor bya yin la/ zhi gza'i yang bar pa gsum po shin tu zhi ba dang*/ gzhan gnyis cung zad zhi ba/ de gnyis kyi yang 'jug rings lus zhi*/ bsam pa drag sgra gcan ni de las zlog bar pa gsum yang mas rim bzhin du zhi ba yin no/ /drag gza' yang dus me dang spen pa shin tu drag po dang gzhan gsum cung zad drag pa po/ de gsum gyi yang phur bu ni lus drag po/ bsam pa zhi ba/ de las nyi ma dang de las mig dmar drag la/ de las spen pa dang*/ de las mjug ma drag pas de ni drag gza'i mthar thug yin no| |nag rtsis las gza' 'di rnams dar zhud gyod pa sogs bshad pa dang*/ 'dir khams le'i gya bzhi par/

zla skyes lhag blon po phur/ gnyis myur 'gros/ / sa skyes mi dmar/ mjug rings gnyis 'khyog 'gros/ /spen pa pa sangs gnyis dal 'gros stobs dang ldan par 'gyur zhing 'gros gzhan la stobs med par gsungs pa dang cung zad bstun par mngon na'ang 'dir de tsam las mi gsal lo| |'on kyang stobs dang ldan par bshad pa'i 'gros kyi ring la/ gza' de dar ba dang*/ de'i de ma thag pa'i 'gros zhud pa dang*/ de'i de ma thag tu rgud pa dang*| 'gros bzhi pa la gyod par 'dod pa 'dra bas tshes rtsis kyi re gza' bzang ngan rtsi ba la/ gza' lnga'i 'gros bzhi shes par byas nas 'di'i blang dor bya'o/ /yang tshigs bcad nga gcig par/ rang gi zhing la yang dag gnas rnams gal te de la dgra dag gyur na nges par 'thab pa'o/ /skar ma la ste gzhan la 'thob pa min par nges shing 'dir ni phan tshun mtshungs pa dag tu bstan zhes par| |sngar bshad pa'i khyim gyi zhing bdag gi gza' rnams gza' rang rang gi bdag byed pa'i khyim de'i skar ma'i steng du rang gi dgra'i gza' byung na nam mkha' la gza' 'thab pas sa gzhi la mi 'thab pa sogs 'byung la skar ma gzhan gyi steng du 'dzom yang mi 'thab pas mthun par gnas ces bya'o/ /dgra zla ni/ mig dmar dang lhag pa/ phur bu dang pa sangs/ mjug rings dang spen pa| rigs dang sbyar na/ nyi ma dang zla ba yang dgra zla'o/ /de bzhin du rang rang gi skyes skar steng du dgra zla byung na'ang 'thab pa'o/ /tshes kyi blang dor ni/ spyir mdo sngags gzhan du/ tshes brgyad bcu bzhi dang bco lnga rnams yar ngo mar ngo yin kyang dus bzang du gsungs la/ la lar tshes gcig rnams gnyis dang*/ la lar tshes bcu rnam pa gnyis kyang dus bzang du bshad pa dang*/ tshes 'd-i la bya ba 'di byas na bzang zhes sogs kyang bshad la/ 'dir ni/ dga' ba/ bzang po| rgyal ba/ stong pa/ rdzogs pa rnams nam mkha' rlung me chu sa'i khams yin pas khams so so dang mthun pa'i zhi rgyas dbang drag sogs bya zhing zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi khams bskyed rim dang*/

nag phyogs sdud rim du 'byung bas skye shing 'phel bar bya ba'i las rnams yar ngo dang*/ 'gog cing 'grib par bya ba'i las rnams mar ngo la bya ba tsam don thob la 'byung ba tsam ma gtogs tshes kyi blang dor rgyas par gsungs so/ /skar ma'i blang dor ni/ rgya nag gi gzhung las/ 'grub skar bzhi la gang yang bzang*/ /rme skar bzhi la gang yang ngan/ g.yang skar bzhi la nor mi btang*/ /dgra skar bzhi la dgra la rgal/ /'gron skar bzhi la lam du 'jug/gshin skar bzhi la gshin las bya/ /bzlos skar bzhi la gshid sogs spangs/ /zhes sogs dang*/ skar ma rang gi ngo bo'i sgo nas bzang ngan la sogs pa mang du gsungs mod kyi/ 'dir ni gza' tshes dang sbyar ba'i 'phrod kyi sgo nas dag ma dag gi gza' dang tshes zhes pa tsam las ma gsungs la| de ni 'phrod sbyor gyi skabs su bshad par bya'o/ /sbyor ba'i blang dor ni/ dang po sel ba la chu tshod lnga spang*/ drug pa shin tu skrangs dang*/ bcu pa skrangs pa gnyis la chu tshod drug drug spang*/ dgu pa zug rngu la chu tshod lnga spang*/ bcu gsum pa kun 'joms dang*/ bco lnga pa rdo rje la dgu dgu spang*/ bcu bdun pa shin tu ltung dang*/ bcu dgu pa yongs 'joms dang*/ nyer bdun pa 'khon 'dzin rnams ril po spang bar bshad pas de rnams spang bya dang gzhan rnams blang bar bya'o/ / byed pa ni/ rtag pa'i byed pa sha ku ni'am bkra shis dang*/ rkang bzhi dang*/ klu dang*| mi gdugs pa'am/ kiṃ pū gh+naṃ ste bzhi dang*/ res kyi byed pa/ ba baṃ/ bā la baṃ| kau la baṃ/ tai ti laṃ/ ga ra dzaṃ/ ba ni dzaṃ/ biṣ+ti stai/ rnams las tha ma spang bya yin no| /bdun po'i bod skad ni/ gdab pa/ byis pa/ rigs can/ til brdung*| khyim skyes/ tshangs pa/ 'jug phod do/ / gnyis pa la/ dbyangs/ phyogs/ dus/ skabs/ grangs/ 'phrod/ las rnams la rten pa'i blang dor ro/ / dang po ni/ 'char rgyu'i dbyangs kyi gtso bo ni rang byung gi yi ge lnga zhes pa|

a i ṛ u l̥ rnams yin la/ gang la 'char ba bzhi'i gtso bo ni tshes dga' ba bzang po rgyal ba stong pa rdzogs pa rnams yin zhing*/ dbyangs tshes de gnyis dang gza' skar 'phrad pa'i blang dor ni/ tshes dang po la dbyangs a dang lhan cig skyes dang smin drug shar na dbyangs dang po ming yig dang po yod pa rnams la ngan pas gza' skar tshes dbyangs de rnams kyi nyin gang zag de na na'ang 'chi bar 'gyur la g.yul du zhugs na'ang 'chi'o/ /de bzhin du tshes gnyis pa la lhag pa dang mchu/ gsum pa la phur bu dang skag bzhi pa la pa sangs dang mon gru/ lnga pa la spen pa bra nye shar na yang dbyangs de dang de ming yig dang por yod pa rnams la 'chi ba'i sbyor bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du tshes dga' ba la dbyangs a 'char ba dang*/ lhan cig nyi ma res gza' la shar na g.yul du rma 'byung na nad tshabs chen por 'gyur zhing bzang po la res gza' zla ba byung na 'bras bu de ji lta ba bzhin no/ /de dag ni tshes re dbyangs re 'char ba'i dbang du byas pa'i rnam gzhag phra ba yin la/ de las rags pa phyogs dang zla dang bgrod pa lo dang lo drug cu re la dbyangs re 'char ba'ang gsungs te/ nag pa sa ga gnyis kyi zhag drug cu la/ zhag bcu gnyis phrag lnga po a sogs lnga rim pa bzhin du 'char ba dngos su gsungs nas snron dang chu stod sogs zla ba gnyis gnyis la dbyangs lnga tshar re 'char bar bshad pa ni phyogs la 'char ba ste phyogs la zhag bco lnga re yod kyang zhag bcu gnyis la rags rtsis kyi dbang du mdzad pa'o/ /zla ba la dbyangs re 'char zhes pa'ang*/ zhag don gnyis re la zla bar byas pa ste/ lo gcig la dbyangs lnga tshar gcig 'char ba'o/ /bgrod pa lo drug cu la 'char ba ni/ zla ba drug la dbyangs re re 'char bas lo phyed dang gsum la dbyangs lnga rdzogs la dbyangs re 'char thems nyer bzhis lo drug cu rdzogs pas so/ /lo la 'char ba ni/ lo re la dbyangs re 'char bas thebs bcu gnyis kyi lo drug cu rdzogs pa yin la/

lo drug cu la 'char ba ni/ lo bcu gnyis bcu gnyis la dbyangs re re 'char bas lo drug cu la 'char thebs gcig rdzogs so/ de ltar na de dag gi dbyangs dang po 'char ba'i dus la dga' ba dang*/ gnyis pa 'char ba'i dus la bzang po sogs ni phra rags kun la 'dra zhing*| dang po'i dus la dga' ba de nyid byis pa dang*/ gnyis pa'i dus gzhon nu dang*/ gsum pa'i dus la lang tsho dang*/ bzhi pa'i dus la dar la babs dang*/ lnga pa'i dus la rgan po ste/ de bzhin du rang dus su rang rang byis pa nas/ gnyis pa'i dus gzhon nu sogs kun la sbyar bar bya zhing*/ dkar phyogs*/ nag phyogs kyi tshes dang po lnga la a i ṛ u l̥/ bar pa lnga la a e ar o al/ gsum pa la ha ya ra ba la ste thung ngu bco lnga/ nag phyogs la ring po bco lnga dang*/ de dang mthun pa'i gsal byed kyang dkar phyogs nag phyogs la 'char tshul dang bcas pa dang yang zhag re la yud tsam sum cur byas nas/ yud tsam re la dbyangs gsal de dag 'char ba'ang gsungs so/ 'di dag la dbyangs 'char gyi rgyud las bshad pa mang du byas pa rnams ni/ gzhan phal cher 'di dang 'dra bar snang na'ang*/ 'chad rgyu'i dbyangs ni/ a i u e o lnga la nam mkha' rlung me chu sa'i khams su bzhag pa dang*/ gsal byed kyang spyi 'gros dang mthun pa byas pa yod do/ /der nyin mo la dum bu lnga dang mtshan mo la lnga byas nas dbyangs lnga tshar re nyin mtshan so so la 'char ba dang*/ dbyangs de lnga nang gi sna bug gi shar lho nub byang dbus lnga nas rim bzhin 'char bas/ dbyangs phyogs gang nas 'char ba'i dus der phyogs de la 'grul spang ba sogs kyang bshad do// phyogs kyi blang dor ni/ nag rtsis nas lo re la phyogs dkar nag bshad kyang 'dir zhag re la dkar nag rtag par gsungs la/ de yang rang nyid spyir 'grim 'grul dang*/ zor gtor 'phen pa dang*/ g.yul sprod pa sogs gang byed kyang kha gang blta ba'i g.yas dang*/ rgyab tu drag gza' rnams gnas zhing g.yon dang mdun du zhi gza' rnams gnas pa byung na shin tu bzang la/

zlog na ngan pa dang gza' 'dres nas gnas na 'bring por shes par bya'o/ khyad par du rnal 'byor ma dang*/ biṣ+ti dang*/ drag po dang*/ sgra gcan gyi 'char tshul gsungs pa'i/ dang po ni/ tshangs ma dang*/ drag mo dang*/ gzhon nu ma dang*/ khyab 'jug ma dang*/ phag mo dang*/ dbang mo dang*/ tsa mun+t+ra dang*/ dpal mo ste brgyad po rnams/ tshes gcig nas brgyad kyi bar la rim pa bzhin du/ shar dang*/ byang dang*/ shar lho dang*| lho nub dang*/ lho dang*/ nub dang*/ nub byang dang*/ byang shar nas 'char la| yang de bzhin du dgu nas bcu bzhi bar la drug dang*/ bco lnga'i snga phyi la rnal 'byor ma phyi ma gnyis phyogs snga ma bzhin dang dkar phyogs gnyis ka 'char bas tshes de dang*/ de'i tshe rnal 'byor ma 'char ba'i phyogs de spang bar bya'o/ /biṣ+ti ni/ yar ngo'i tshes bzhi'i phyi cha dang*/ brgyad kyi snga cha dang*/ bcu gcig gi phyi cha dang*/ bco lnga'i snga cha dang*/ bco brgyad kyi phyi cha dang*/ nyer gnyis kyi snga cha dang*/ nyer dgu'i snga cha rnams la rim pa bzhin/ shar/ lho/ nub| byang bzhi dang*/ me shar lho dang*/ bden bral lho nub / rlung nub byang dang*/ dbang byang shar ldan rnams nas 'char ba'i spyir biṣ+ti 'char ba'i tshes dang bye brag phyogs de dang de spang dgos so/ /drag po ni/ phyogs brgyad nas khyim phyed dang gnyis gnyis bar la 'char te/ shar dang/ byang shar/ byang dang*/ rlung bzhi po byang gi phyogs yin pas/ byang bgrod kyi khyim drug gi bar la phyogs bzhi po de nas 'char te/ chu srin dang bum pa'i phyed la shar nas dang*/ bum pa'i phyed dang*/ nya la byang shar nas 'char ba sogs so/ /de bzhin du nub nas me'i bar bzhi lho'i phyogs yin pas lho bgrod kyi khyim drug gi ring la ste karka ṭa dang seng ge'i phyed la nub nas 'char ba sogs yin pas khyim de dang de'i bar phyogs de dang de spang bar bya'o/ /g.yul rgyal las/ zla ba'i phyogs kyi dang nyin zhag gi dang*/

dus kyi drag po dang rnam pa drug ni don med par gsungs so/ /sgra gcan thun byed pa dang*/ rtsa ba'i sgra gcan gnyis gsungs pa'i dang po ni/ nyin mo thun phyed pa brgyad dang*/ mtshan mo thun phyed pa brgyad du byas nas thun re la rgyu la/ rgyu sa'i phyogs ni/ shar nas rlung nub byang */ dang*/ de nas lho dang*/ de nas dbang ldan dang*/ de nas nub dang*/ de nas shar lho me dang*/ de nas byang dang*/ de nas bden bral dang*/ de nas shar du rgyu la/ de yang res gza' nyi ma la yod pa'i tshe shar nas mgo brtsams zhing*/ zla ba la byang*/ mig dmar me/ gza' lhag bden la/ phur bu lho/ pa sangs nub/ spen pa la rlung mtshams nas 'go brtsams te nyin mtshan gnyis ka la rgyu bar bshad do/ /dbyangs 'char du zla stod la nyin mo g.yas skor dang*/ mtshan mo g.yon skor/ zla smad de las bzlog par bshad do/ /rtsa ba'i sgra gcan ni/ nyin zhag re la gling bzhi 'khor ba de'i gdong dang mjug ma sogs gang gang na 'dug bltas na/ dus de'i tshe gdong mjug la ma thug par byas nas bya ba snang che ba rnams byed cing*/ khyad par g.yul sprod pa dang*/ zor gtor 'phang ba sogs gal che'o/ /de yang sgra gcan gyi gdong dang mjug ma gnyis lta ba dang lte ba gnyis te bzhi ru phyogs bzhi ka 'dus pas phyogs re la skar ma bdun bdun bkod nas/ gdong skar ma gang gi steng nas 'dug pa de phyogs de'i dbus su byas nas g.yas su gsum dang g.yon du gsum byas nas gdong skar bdun de nas g.yas bskor gyis bcal ba'i skar ma bdun po lta ba/ de nas bdun po la mjug ma/ de nas bdun po la lto ba yin te/ dper na gdong pa shar drang po na yod pa'am/ lho drang po'i skar ma bdun lta ba/ de nas nub drang po mjugade nas byang drang po lto ba yin par shes par byas nas/ rang nyid lto bar gnas te lta ba la bltas na dus me g.yas dang*| sgra gcan g.yon du song bas shin tu rgyal bzhin bya ba 'grub/

/de yang mtshan mo ni gdong mjug rtsis pa'i mig skar nyid kyis dngos su mthong ba'am/ ma mthong na skar khongs rtsis pas shes la/ dbyar sprin gyis bsgribs nas mi shes pa lta bu la sa sros ma thag skar ma gang gis nam skyel ba'i skar ma 'char nas skar khongs kyi tshad dpag 'grig po bya zhing*/ /nyin mo ni nyi dag rtsis nas nyi ma skar ma gang gang gi steng nas yod pa nges par byas nas de nas bcal ba'i skar khongs 'jal ba'am/ /nam skyel ba'i skar ma de nas bsgrangs pa'i bcu bzhi pa de nam langs mtshams su 'char ba nas brtsams te bcal bar shes par nus te/ sgra gcan chen po rtsa ba'i sgra gcan du grags pa 'di ni sa'i stobs su bshad pa'i rnal 'byor ma dang*/ biṣ+ti dang drag po kun las stobs che bas 'di kho na la blang dor gtso bor bya bar gsungs so/ /'dir ni de tsam las ma gsungs la/ g.yul rgyal du/ bum stong zhes bya ba/ lug khyim gyi ring la shar dang glang khyim gyi ring la lho na gnas pa sogs phyogs bzhi la shar nas g.yas skor gyis khyim re re 'khor bas/ lug seng gzhu gsum la shar/ glang bu mo chu srin gsum lho/ 'khrig srang bum gsum la nub/ karti sdig nya gsum la bum stong byang na yod pas khyim de dang de'i bar la phyogs de dang der 'grim 'grul spang zhing ci nas byed dgos na bum pa chus bkang ste gom pa brgya tsam gyi bar du 'khyer ba sogs dang*/ gang gi rlung sna bug gi shar nas rgyu ba'i dus su shar 'grim 'grul gyi mgo mi rtsom pa sogs mang du bshad kyang g.yul rgyal gyi spros pa phal cher ni snying po med par 'dir lan mang du gsungs so/ /dus kyi blang dor la/ phyi'i dus sbyor ni/ da ltar 'char bzhin pa'i khyim dang*/ de nas g.yas skor du bgrangs pa'i khyim bdun pa ni de'i tshes nub bzhin pa yin te/ de gnyis gang rung gi steng na/ dus me dang*/ nyi ma dang*/ sa skyes dang*/

spen pa rnams yod pa'i dus su dge ba'i bya ba la zhugs na rim bzhin du 'chi ba dang na ba dang*/ rma dang nor nyams pa rnams 'byung bas spang la/ sgra gcan dang zla ba dang*/ lhag pa dang pa sangs yod rim bzhin du dgra nyams pa dang rang nyid rgyas pa dang g.yul las rgyal ba dang*/ dga' ba dang bcas pa'i nor thob par 'gyur bas blang bar bya'o/ /'di ni phra mo'i rnal 'byor rlung sbyor mi shes pas phyi'i dus sbyor rtsis nas blang dor bya rgyu yin la/ rlung sbyor shes pas ni nang gi dus sbyor las blang dor byas te/ sna bug g.yon gyi rlung rgyu ba'i dus su bzang la/ g.yas kyi rgyu ba'i dus su ngan pa dang*/ g.yon gyi yang dbus shar lho byang nub rnams nam mkha' rlung

dbyangs zer ba 'dug kyang bdag gis rlung gis bzos pa yin brtag dpyad zhu/ gis me chu sa'i rlung rgyu zhing sgra gcan zla ba lhag pa pa sangs mjug rings rnams kyis*/ bdag byed pas snga ma snga ma las phyi ma'i dus bzang ba dang*/ g.yas pa'i lugs bzlog la khams kyang lugs zlog dang gza' yang*/ spen phur bkra shis nyi ma dus me rnams kyis bdag byed pas snga ma snga ma las phyi ma phyi ma ngan pa dang*/ khyad par dus sbyor mkhan po'i rlung de rnams rgyu ba'i tshe pho nya bas g.yul gyi slad du dris na g.yas kyi nam mkha' la dus me shar dus yin na 'thab mo ba 'chi ba dang*/ rlung la nyi ma shar dus yin na 'pham pa dang*/ me la sa skyes pa'i rma dang*/ chu la bla ma'i tshe 'dum pa dang*/ sa la spen pa'i tshe 'thab mo mi 'byung la/ nad pa'i dri ba yin na/ de lnga la rim pa bzhin 'chi ba dang*/ nad yun ring po dang*/ rma dang bde ba dang btang snyoms su 'gyur/ g.yon gyi sgra gcan sogs lnga po 'char ba'i tshe g.yul gyi dri ba byas na/ dgra bo nyams pa dang 'pham pa dang rma dang*/ dgra las don rnyed pa dang dgra dbang du 'gyur ba rnams gsungs so/ /yang dus sbyor bcu gnyis po la g.yo ba dang brtan pa mnyam pa dang ste gsum gsum du byas nas dang po la bya ba bsgrubs na myur du 'grub pa dang brtan pa la bsgrubs na myur du mi 'grub pa dang mnyam pa la 'bring por gsungs so/ /de yang lug glang 'khrig gsum/ kar seng bu mo gsum/ srang sdig gzhu gsum/ chu bum nya gsum rnams kyi dang po rnams kyi dang po rnams g.yo ba dang*/ bar pa rnams brtan pa dang*/ phyi ma rnams mnyam pa yin no/ /'dir ni de tsam las ma gsungs so/ /dbyangs 'char gyi rgyud du mang po gsungs pa rnams dang*/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud du dus sbyor so so'i skar ma la skyes pa rnams kyi tshe ring thung sogs kyi ltas mtshan mang du bshad pa rnams ni yi ge zur du yod pa las shes par bya zhing/

rdo rje gdan bzhi'i le'u dang por yang dus sbyor rnams ro hi ta dang*/ mo ha ti dang*/ bha ṭa sogs kyi ming 'dogs zur pa mdzad nas de dag las skyes pa'i mi rnams kyi tshe ring thung longs spyod dang*/ bshis bzang sogs bshad de 'dir yi ge mang gi dwogs pas de nyid du blta bar bya'o/ / bzhi pa la/ rten 'brel gyi skabs la rten pa'i blang dor ni/ ma rig pa dang rnam shes la sogs pa gcig pa dang*/ gsum pa dang*/ lnga pa dang*/ bdun pa dang*/ dgu pa dang*/ bcu gcig pa ste mi mnyam pa rnams kyi dus ni dge ba'i bya ba rnams la shis shing myur du 'grub pas de dag la zhi rgyas rnams 'grub par bya la/ 'du byed dang ming gzugs sogs dang gnyis pa dang bzhi pa drug pa dang brgyad pa dang bcu pa dang bcu gnyis pa rnams kyi dus ni dge ba'i bya ba rnams mi shis shing mi 'grub pas bsad bskrad sogs drag las re tsam ma gtogs dge ba rnams bshol bar bya'o/ /tshe'i skabs la gzas bdag byed tshul ni/ 'dir khams le'i brgya bcu gnyis par/ re gza' bdun dang sgra gcan gyis lo la bgos nas spyod la/ de yang 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad byas nas/ nyi mas lo drugazla bas bco lnga/ mig dmar lo brgyad/ lhag pa bcu bdun/ spen pa bcu/ phur bu bcu dgu/ sgra gcan bcu gnyis/ pa sangs kyi nyer gcig ste| shar nas dbang ldan gyi bar la bskor zhing*/ phyogs rnams nyung ba kha 'cham dang mtshams rnams mang ba kha 'khyar te/ gnyis ka la gnyis ka 'phel bar mdzad| 'di ni bsdoms pas skyes bu tshe lo brgya dang brgyad thub pa gcig gi dbang du byas shing*/ res gza' gang la gang skyes pa de nas mgo brtsams te bskor bar bya la/ brgyad po de la dbyangs sde pa brgyad po so sor 'char zhing spyod de/ sde pa brgyad la yang*/ dbyangs 'char gyi rgyud la sogs pa 'jig rten la grags pa dang*/ 'di nas bshad pa rang byung gi brjod pa gnyis/ dang po la a ka tsa ṭa ta pa ya sha rnams kyi sde ste/

a'i sde ni/ a i u e o bar pa lnga 'dra la/ ya'i sde pa ni/ ya ra la wa/ sha'i sde ni/ sha ṣa sa ha rnams yin la/ 'dir ni a i ṛ u l̥/ ha ya ra wa la/ ka tsa ṭa pa ta rnams kyi sde rnams yin pas nyi ma zla ba dang*/ nam mkha' rlung me chu sa ye shes kyi khams yin zhing*/ nyi ma'i ring la nyi ma'i khams kyi a i ṛ u l̥ rnams spyod pa dang*/ zla ba'i ring la zla ba'i khams kyi yi ge ha ya ra wa la rnams spyod pa sogs sbyar bar bya zhing dbyangs re res ji tsam spyod pa ni/ rang rang gi lo grangs rnams sum brgya drug cus bsgyur te lngas bgos pas shes so/ yang nang gses so so la yang*/ nyi ma'i nyi ma nyi ma'i zla ba/ nyi ma'i mig dmar sogs brgyad brgyad du bgos nas spyod par yang gsungs la/ de rnams kyi nyi ma mig dmar spen pa sgra gcan te phyogs kyi rnams spyod pa'i ring la skyes bu de la nad mang ba dang*/ longs spyod nyams pa sogs 'tshe ba byung zhing mtshams kyi bzhi'i ring la zhi ba dge ba 'byung bar bshad do/ /nang tshan gyi bgo tshul ni/ nyi ma'i lo drug po zhag sum brgya drug cus bsgyur bas nyis stong dang brgya drug cu 'byung la/ de'i steng nas nyi ma'i nyi ma la zhag brgya nyi shu/ nyi ma'i zla ba la sum brgya tham pa/ phyogs pa rnams la nyi ma'i steng du dang*/ mtshams pa rnams la zla ba'i steng du zhag bzhi bcu re bsnan ste lo re la zhag nyi shu re 'byung ba yin no/ /de bzhin du zla ba'i nang ses la/ zla ba'i nyi ma dang*/ zla ba'i zla ba sogs sbyar bar bya'o/ /'dir de ltar tshe lo brgya dang brgyad pa la sbyar ba las ma gsungs mod kyi rigs pa sbyor na de'i phyed lnga bcu nga bzhi'i dbang du byas na/ gza' rnams kyi yang sngar gyi lo grangs kyi phyed de/ nyi ma'i lo gsum/ zla ba'i lo phyed dang brgyad/ mig dmar gyi bzhi/ lhag pa'i phyed dang dgu sogs la nang gses dang bcas pa sbyar bar bya zhing*/

lo brgya dang brgyad kyi sum gnyis/ bdun cu don gnyis dang*/ sum cha so drug gi dbang du byas nas yang gza' rnams kyi rang rang gi lo grangs kyi sum gnyis dang sum cha sogs la sbyar nas shes par bya dgos par mngon ste/ g.yul rgyal du lo brgya nyi shu dang*/ brgya tham pa dang*/ brgyad cu dang*/ drug cu rnams la rim bzhin/ mchog gi tshe dang*/ dbu ma'i dang*/ 'bring po dang*/ tha ma'i tshe rnams su bshad cing*| gza' ni mjug rings dang bcas pa'i gza' dgu la sbyar nas nang gses la sbyor tshul de dang bcas pa bshad/ 'go 'dzin tshul yang gza' dgu po re re'i thob skal gyi skar ma gsum gsum sbyar nas rang rang gi skar ma de la dang por skyes pa'i gza' de nas 'go bzung ste skor ba dang*/ skar ma'i chu tshod drug cu'i cha dang po dang*/ gnyis pa dang gsum pa dang bzhi pa rnams la skyes na rim pa bzhin mchog gi tshe la sogs pa bzhir 'gyur tshul sogs shin tu rgyas par bshad de/ phal cher la nges pa med par 'dir bzung la/ spro na der blta bar bya'o/ /'phrod la rten pa la/ gza' skar gyi 'phrod ni 'grub sbyor bdun la gang yang bzang*/ 'chi sbyor bdun la gang yang ngan/ /sreg tshes bdun la gang yang 'bring*/ /zhes grags pa ltar te/ de yang res gza' bdun dang go rim bzhin| me bzhi gro bzhin tha skar dang*/ /lha mtshams rgyal dang nam gru dang*/ / snar ma rnams 'dzoms 'grub sbyor te/ /dag pa'i gza' zhes skabs 'dir bshad| |lha mtshams smin drug mon gre dang*/ /tha skar mgo dang snar ma dang*/ / me bzhi rnams 'dzoms 'chi sbyor te/ /ma dag pa yi gza' zhes gsungs/ /yang res gza' bdun dang go rim bzhin/ bcu gnyis bcu gcig tshes bcu dang*/ / gsum drug gnyis dang tshes bdun rnams/ /'dzoms pa sreg tshes zhes byar grags| |zhes bya'o/ /skyes skar ming skar dang gza' 'phrod ni/ rang rang gi skyes skar shes na rab/ mi shes na/ ming skar la'ang g.yul rgyal ba rnams ni rten par byed la 'dir ni ming skar la rten pa dngos su ma gsungs so/

/des na skyes skar nas mgo brtsams nas skar ma dgu dgur byas pa'i cha gsum byas nas skyes skar nas bgrangs pa'i gsum pa lnga pa bdun pa dgu pa ste mi mnyam pa'i gnas kyi skar ma de'i steng na zla ba dang lhan ciganyi ma mig dmar spen pa dus me gdug pa'i gza' bzhi rdzogs par yod na de'i tshe g.yul du zhugs pa dang na ba yin na 'chi ba yin la/ gnyis pa bzhi pa drug pa brgyad pa bcu ste mnyam pa'i gnas na yod pa'i tshe yin na/ myur du rgyal ba dang po'i sar 'gyur zhes gsungs zhing*/ 'dir ṭīka byed pa dag gis 'phrod kyi dgu tshan gcig nyid la sbyar mod kyi de lta na dgu tshan 'og ma gnyis bkod pa don med du 'gyur bas dgu tshan gnyis ka'i gnyis pa gsum pa sogs rtsi bar bya'o/ /'di la ni skar ma'i stobs zhes gsungs la/ gdengs can gyi 'khor la gsum las/ sbrul 'khyog pa lnga ni/ 'khyog lnga rtsa rgyud dgu 'byung ba la rtsa rgyud re re nas tha skar nas mgo brtsams pa'i skar ma gsum gsum bkod/ /rtsa rgyud gcig la rang gi skyes skar dang sdig zla ces pa sdig gza' bzhi dang zla ba rnams 'dzoms pa'i tshe na 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /'khyog bzhi pa ni/ 'khyog bzhi la/ rtsa rgyud bdun 'byung la/ smin drug nas brtsams te rtsa rgyud re la skar ma gsum gsum dang*/ rtsa rgyud kyi bar stongs su re re bkod pa yin la/ 'khyog gsum pa ni/ 'khyog gsum la/ rtsa rgyud lnga 'byung la/ lag nas brtsams te rtsa rgyud re la gsum dang*/ bar stongs su gsum gsum bkod nas/ skyes skar dang zla ba gnyis rtsa la zhugs na g.yul du thog mar zhugs pa de rgyal bar 'gyur la/ bar stong gi rtsa la zla ba gnas na g.yul du phyis nas zhugs pa de rgyal bar 'gyur zhes gsungs so/ / 'dir ni de tsam las ma gsungs pas dbyangs 'char du/ skar ma dang gza' 'phrad pa'i 'phrod la brten pa'i rtsis/ le'u lnga par rkang pa brgya pa'i 'khor lo dang drug par rkang pa brgyad cu rtsa gcig pa dang*/

bdun par skyes bu lam du 'jug pa rtag pa dmar po'i 'khor los ni ri dwags brtag pa sogs nyi shu rtsa gsum dang*/ brgyad par rdzong phebs sam mi phebs brtag pa'i 'khor lo gnyis la sogs pa mang du bshad pa rnams kyang phal cher sngar bshad pa ltar snang la spro na der blta bar bya'o/ /de bzhin du da lta kun la sprad pa'i kun dga' dus dbyig tu grags pa'ang phyi rol pa'i gzhung du snang zhing 'di dang mi mthun te/ 'dir bzang shos rang du bshad pa'i rgyal phur la/ de mdung la nad kyi 'jigs pa 'byung*/ zhes bshad pas so/ /de bzhin du sa nang 'phrad pa dngos grub sbyor zhes sogs gza' skar 'byung ba rtsis pa'i 'phrod sbyor la'ang yid brtan mi snang ste| 'dir gza' skar gyi khams bshad pa dang*/ khams mthun pa re re tsam las mi snang ba'i phyir ro/ /grangs kyi blang dor ni/ rgyal po dgra zla gnyis lta bu'i ming gi dbyangs yig grangs mang po rgyal la nyung ba 'phags pa dang pho nyas ming dang por brjod de rgyal zhing phyis brjod pa de 'pham par bshad la/ pho nyas byas pa 'di lta bu byas na bzang ngam zhes pa'i tshig gi dbyangs kyi grangs su byung ba de dang por bcu yis bsgyur ba la/ khyim bcu gnyis bsre/ slar yang de lngas bsgyur te/ nye 'khor mthong sa na yod pa'i skye bo'i grangs bsres na bdun gyi bgos pa'i lhag ma la gcig dang lnga dang thig le shar na drag gza' rnams shar bas ngan la/ gnyis dang bzhi dang drug shar na zhi gza' shar bas shin tu bzang bar bshad do/ /las la brten pa'i blang dor ni/ sgyogs su grags pa la sogs pa'i 'phrul 'khor rnams yin la/ de la gzhan phyogs 'joms pa'i dang*/ rang phyogs bsrung ba'i dang*/ bde ba skyed pa'i 'phrul 'khor te gsum du bya'o/ /dang po la/ thang rdzong 'bebs pa rdo rje'i dang*/ chu rdzong 'bebs pa gru'i dang*/ ri rdzong 'bebs pa me'i 'phrul 'khor dang*/ ral gri 'khor ba gri gug gi dang*/

rtse mo 'byed pa rlung gi dang*/ rtsig pa 'jigs pa gur gyi dang*/ go cha 'jig pa lcags mda'i 'phrul 'khor rnams so/ /dang po ni/ spyir gong gis rtsa ba sgra gcan sogs la rten pa'i g.yul rgyal dang*/ de dag gi stobs kyi g.yul du 'phel ba'i dgra bo rnams rdzong rnams su bros na 'phrul 'khor 'di dag gis gzhol bar gsungs shing*/ de thams cad kyang rang gnas bsrung ba'i don du byin/ zhe sdang dang chags pa'i dbang gis mi bya bar gsungs pa rnams ni dngos bstan drang don tsam yin la/ nges pa'i don du dbyangs 'char ba dang*/ de la rten pa'i sgra gcan sogs kyi sa'i stobs bshad pa thams cad nang gi dbyangs dang gza' dang rnal 'byor ma la sogs pa nang le nas 'byung ba rnams kyi blang dor du shes nas nyams su blangs pa las/ las kyi rlung dang thig le la sogs pa'i dgra rnams skyon med skyed pa'i rtsa la sogs pa'i nang gi rdzong du zhugs na rdo rje'i rnal 'byor khyad par can gyi 'phrul 'khor rnams kyi tshar bcad pa dang sbyor ba dngos su gsungs pa'i gsal kha med kyang don la thob pas de lta bu'i nges don sbyor tshul ni/ rdzogs rim gyi ngo sprod dang mtha' gcod du shes par bya rgyud yin pas/ 'dir drang don rnams kyang gzhan la gnod pa byed pa'i thabs 'ba' zhig tu bsam nas thar pa don gnyer du rlom pa'i gdul bya dag gi don du mi gnyer zhing 'chad pa po dag gis kyang de ltar 'chad pa ni rdo rje 'chang la sun 'byin pa'i rnam par 'gro bas legs par slab par bya'o/ /de ltar na 'phrul 'khor 'di dag la yang gzhan nas 'byung ba'i spros pa rgyas pa rnams dor nas 'dir dngos su bstanapa rnams kyi don mdor bsdus te brjod na/ dang por rdo'i 'phrul 'khor la/ che chung 'bring gsum gsungs te/ sgyogs rkang bzhi po'i srid du khru bcu drug pa dang*/ bcu bzhi pa dang*/ bcu gnyis pa rnams te/ zheng gi sboms su gru bzhi'i zheng la srid kyi khrung grangs dang mnyam pa'i sor tshad de/

khru bcu drug pa la zheng du sor bcu drug sogs so/ rkang bzhi'i sgrom gyi rgya ni/ che ba la rtsa ba khru bcu dang*/ rtse mo khru lnga gru bzhir gsungs kyi/ 'bring tha ma la tshad ma gsungs na'ang dpags pas shes so/ /rkang pa bzhi po la gdang bu ni/ rgyab tu gcig dang phyogs gzhan gsum la ni/ bzhi ste lho byang gnyis drang thad du byas nas mdun gyi gdang bu bsnol mar bya zhing rgyab kyi gcig por rtsa bar bya/ lho byang gnyis po'i steng ma gnyis kyi dbus drang thad du sor nyi shu bzhag pa'i g.yas g.yon gnyis su lcags kyi gzer bu shin tu bzang ba gnyis kyi bar du chug par/ o log bcu'am 'khrul mig zhes gsungs pa sgyaugs kyi sba bar grags pa/ srid du khru drug pa dbus bud med kyi zhud bu'i rnam pa can/ sbom pa'i sboms su khru phyed dang gsum pa/ gzer bu bzhi po la rten pa'i phra sar sor nyi shu pa/ de las phyi rol du lhag pa'i bum pa'am cha ga la sor sum cu yod pa/ dbus kyi sbom pa'i dbus drang por sgyaugs mda'i rtsa ba leb por byas pa'i zheng la sor bcu bzhi dang srab 'thug sor bdun pa gcig bcug pa'i sgyogs mda'i de'i srid pa khru bcu bzhi yod pa'i khru gang pha rol du lhag pa'i leb pa dum bu gsum du byas pa'i mtshams gnyis su sgyogs thag 'dogs pa'i a long lcags kyi dbyug gu zlum po sboms su sor drug pa'i zlum skor la sor drug cu pa la thag pa bzang po lnga bcu re gdags par bya zhing*/ sgyogs mda' de byin gyis phra ba ba lang gi 'jug ma ltar byas pa'i rtse mor lcags kyi gnya' non leb mo zheng la sor bcu gnyis pa dbyibs zlum por byas par bsdoms pa'i nang du 'ur rdo 'dogs pa'i lcags kyi mdzub mo'i rtse la leb mor sor drug gi tshad dang de ldan pa bcu gnas sgyogs mda'i shing dang bcas pa'i lcags gzer gnyis kyi gnya' non steng nas 'chug med du btab pa'i mdzub rtse cung zad 'khyog pa la/

'ur rdo 'ur mthil pags pa la byas pa nas dbyibs can srid du sor nyer bzhi/ dbus kyi zheng la sor bcu gnyis pa/ g.yas g.yon gyi the'u gnyis re re la khru phyed dang gsum sna gcig shin tu dam pa dang*/ gc-ig shos stod tsam du btags pa'i mthil du rdo ba bcug ste rgyab kyi sa gzhi'i dbus la tshangs thig byas nas g.yas g.yon du mtho re bar du bzhag pa'i ri mo brgyad brgyad byas nas brdeg pa'i g.yon phyogs su brdeg na 'di'i g.yas phyogs dang zlog na sna g.yon phyogs dang*/ dbus su brdeg par 'dod na/ dbus kyi ri mo'i steng du lag pa gnyis kas 'ur mthil rdo dang bcas pa bzung zhing*/ ring bar 'dod na nang du dang*/ thung bar 'dod na phyi ru nye bar bzung*/ theg pa 'then mkhan stobs dang ldan pa thag pa'i grangs kyis 'then pa btang bas dang por myur du nam mkhar 'gro zhing song nas 'phral la lhung ste gang 'dod phye mar byas nas rdo ba sa 'og tu 'gro ste rdo rje'i thog 'bab pa ji lta ba bzhin te 'di dang 'gran par nus pa'i mtshon cha ni gang yang med do/ /gnyis pa gru ni/ tshigs bcad brgya so gsum pa dang so bzhi pa gnyis kyis gsungs pa la 'grel pa'ang zhib po'i lugs mdzad cing chan ṭīka mdzad pa dag gis kyang 'bru non gang shes byas mod kyi don longs par bshad pa ye mi snang la/ 'dir ka ba dang snying po dang dpung pa'am kha gdengs zhes pa rnams ngos zin pa shin tu dka' zhing*/ de dag ngos ma zin pa dang*/ 'og gi nang dang steng gi nang zhes pas 'khrul nas gru gnyis thog mar 'dod pa'ang byung mod kyi/

rang lugs ni/ 'dir 'phrul 'khor bzhi gsungs te/ chu'i dang*/ glang po che'i dang*/ rta'i dang*/ mi'i 'phrul 'khor ro/ dang po la/ shing sboms su sor bzhi dang srid du khru bcu bzhi pa gzhan gsum la srid ma gsungs par sboms sor nyer bzhi dang nyi shu dang bcu drug ces gsungs pa rnams la 'di byed gsal kha ma gsungs shing*/ kha cigade dag gi gzhung shing bstan pas/ ka ba drug bshad pa rnams gzhung shing de la 'phreng 'gel du btang bar bzhed pa bzhin bya dgos par mngon la/ de ltar na yang*/ snying po re re nyi ma'i khru zhes dang*/ 'grel par/ snying po re re ni/ bcu gnyis po zhes pa'i snying po shing*/ snol ba'i re mig la byas/ re mig re re la khru bcu gnyis par byas na shin tu mi 'grig par snang bas/ snying po ni ka ba de gnyis kyi bar stong yin pas na snying po re re'i zhes pa drug sgra rtsa ba la yod pa ltar snying po re re'i ka ba la nyi ma'i khru zhes par gsal la/ gru chung srid du khru bcu bzhi pa 'di'i zheng du 'phred la btang ba'i ka ba drug po'i srid ni khru bcu gnyis pa ste gru la nar thabs cung zad 'byung ba'i ched do/ /'dir dpung pa zhes pa 'gyur rnying 'ga' re las kha gdangs zhes 'byung bas de gnyis ka gcig tu 'dod pa mang na'ang tha dad du snang ste/ ka ba dpung pa drug drug dang dag gis zhes pa'i ka ba drug ni 'phred la btang pa de yin la/ drug ni 'dir dpung par bshad pa/ da lta thong gug stong pa 'di'i dod phyogs rer drug drug ste bcu gnyis byed par gsal la/ 'di'i steng 'og gi nang gi spang leb zhes yang yang 'byung ba na/ da lta thong gug stong pa lugs ltar mi byed| 'phred kyi ka ba'i sna mo 'di ma btsugs shing de'i bug pa la ma thug tsam du bzhi gdangs zhes pa mthil dang logs kyi spang leb rnams ngos gnyis la shor drug nas 'jug par re yang byed pa yin no/ /de ltar na 'di'i thad kyi 'grel pa 'bru non dka' shos 'og ni nang dang steng gi nang la khru ni zung gi bar dag la ste khru gnyis kyi bar la'o/

/ka ba drug dang nang gnyis kyi snying po re rer 'gyur ro zhes pa ni nges pa'o/ /zhes pa'i snying po ni 'phred la steng 'og tu btang ba'i ka ba drug po'i gnyis gnyis kyi bar gyi pang leb stong pa rnams la brjod par bya ba yin zhing*/ 'og gi de bzhin du 'og dang steng dang shar dang nub la sogs su yang 'og dang steng gi shar dang zhes sogs brjod par bya ba yin pas khru do pa'i spang leb gru bzhi'i ngos gnyis gnyis zur bcag pa'i rnon po byas pa ka ba dang 'phred gdam/ kha gdang gi shor du bcug cing*/ ngos gzhan gnyis kyi re re rnon po dang*/ re re shor du brus pa/ gcig nang du gcig bzhugs par byas nas chu mi 'chor ba'i dam po bya zhing*/ de yang ma zad/ lpags pa dang*/ spra tshil dang chu dar la sogs pas gdam nas dam por bya bar gsungs so/ /chu rlabs bsrung ba'i skyor ma steng du langs pa de'i tshad ni/ gru chung 'di la khru do bya zhing de'i steng la kha skyor gyi shing ring po phyogs kun tu btang bar bya zhing*/ 'og gi char bson pa'i ka ba'i rtsa ba la/ spang leb bzo ba'i sham lta bu re byed dgos par mngon no| |gru gzhan gsum la ni/ 'di ni rigs pa sbyar ba'i tshad bya ste shing sbom phrang sor drug pa la/ srid du khru bcu bzhi dang zheng du khru bcu gnyis gsungs pas| shing sdoms su sor nyer bzhi pa la srid du khru nga drug dang zheng du khru zhe brgyad par gsal zhing des 'gre'o/ /spang ni glang po'i la khru gsum dang */ rta'i la phyed dang gsum dang*/ mi'i khru gnyis bya bar dngos su gsungs shing*/ snying po'i grangs kyang drug dang*/ brgyad dang*/ bco brgyad dang*/ so drug dang*/ de nyis 'gyur dang rgya mtsho chen po rgal ba la khru stong phrag gi bar du bya bar gsungs la/ snying po de'i phyir rol du yang skya ba 'dzin pa rnams rgyu ba'i bya 'dab lta bu la de ni srid du khru phyed dang gsum pa'i ka ba'am gdang shing rnams bad pur mgo rog gi rnam par gru'i mthil gyi ka ba dang gzhung shing dang kha gdangs rnams la btsugs pa rnams kyang spang leb kyi bar rnams bsdoms shing zur bzhir ka ba bzhi steng du de dag g-i btsugs pa yang nang gi ka ba rnams dang de dag gi zur gyi bar stong bzhi po spang leb kyi dam du bsdams nas lhag ma spang leb kyi ma bsdams pa rnams su skya ba 'dzin pa rnams kyi rgyu sa bya la skya ba 'dzin mkhan yang gru chung 'di la rgyab tu drug gi 'phul ba dang mdun nas drug gis 'then par bya zhing*|

gzhan la ni snying po'i grangs kyis brgyad dang bco brgyad la sogs pa stong gi mthar thug pa bya/ yang na ka ba rnams kyi khung bur dar cog btsugs nas mthun pa'i rlung dang sbyar nas gdug pa'i rdzong la sogs pa gang 'dod du 'gro bar gsungs so/ gsum pa ni/ shing gi brtan pa gru bzhi khru bzhi pa bsra ba zhig gi dbus su shing 'khrang ba sboms su sor bcu gnyis gru bzhi srid zhu gsum pa gcig brtan par btsugs nas shing leb kyi grwa bzhir lcags kyi a long la btags pa'i thag pa bzang pos ka ba'i rtse mor bcings pa la rdzong la ston pa'i phyogs gnyis go cha btsan pos g.yog cing zur bzhir rgyal mtshan dpangs su khru lnga pa sboms su khru gang pa bzhi yang btsugs ka ba'i rtse la thag pa ring po gdams par byas la/ slar yang phyogs gnyis su btags pa'i thag pa 'og phyogs su spyi mdud byas pa'i sna la yang thag pa ring po btags nas/ de'i nang du skyes bu dpa' bo dang me sgyogs rgyag pa'i 'bru mar dang spra ba la sogs pa tshang bar byas te/ rdzong gi smad nas 'dren pa'i steng nas gtong ba gang rung byas te steng 'og gi thag pa gnyis ka dam du bzung nas rdzong gi drang thad nas me rgyab pas dgra bo'i gnyis rdzong mes shig par bya'o/ / bzhi pa ni/ 'og tu chu'am rlung gis 'khor ba'i 'khor lo rtsibs la khru byed dang gsum pa'i tshad can brgyad la sogs par lte ba'i srog shing la sor gnyis gnyis bzhag nas dam du btsugs shing 'og tu gnam bstan la lcags kyi rtse mo rnon po dang ldan pa'i srog shing bkod de bde klag tu 'khor ba'i bde mo chu skor gyi 'khor lo'i rnam pa byas pa'i steng du thog phub pa'i steng nas dgra bo 'gro ba'i lam yod par byas srog shing steng der 'thon pa la ral gri gcig gam brgyad la sogs pa btags pa rnams myur du 'khor bas dgra'i rkang pa gcod par 'gyur ro/ / lnga pa ni/

kha cig nam mkha' la thag pa drangs pa'i rlung gi 'phrul 'khor gyis rang gi mkhar dang dgra'i mkhar gyi bar thag shes par byas nas sa gzhi'i 'og la gshor brus pa'i nang nas zhugs te dgra mkhar gyi nang gi 'og nas me 'dzug par 'gyur rnying 'ga' re'i don du 'dod na'ang yi ge'i don la bzhugs par mi snang bas/ sngar gyi me sgyogs byed pa'i 'phrul 'khor ji bzhin du byas nas 'phrul 'khor skyes bu me cha dang bcas pa de dgra bo'i thang rjong gi steng du sleb pa zhig bya ba'i thabs su thog mar mda' la sogs pa la thag pa phra mo btags steng gi nam mkha' nas 'phangs pa'i sna la thag pa shin tu bzang ba btags pa'i thag pa de rang gi mkhar gyi steng du drangs te phyogs gnyis ka nas skyes bu du mas legs par brkyang ste 'then pa thag zam gyi thag pa ltar byas pa de la a long lta bu dkon zhing de la yang thag pa ring po phar phyogs su son pa btags/ a long de la 'phrul 'khor de btags nas phyogs gzhan nas 'then pas dgra'i thang ljong gi steng du sleb pa na de'i khang pa'i gzhi dang mdun sa la me lhung bar byas pas bsreg par 'gyur ro/ / drug pa ni/ 'og nas 'chad pa'i shing rta lta bur 'phang lo shin tu bde ba'i 'phrul 'khor gyi steng du lcags sam shing las byas pa'i khang pa zlum po shin tu bsra ba byas te/ dgra mkhar gyi 'obs rnams sa ros bkang nas/ stobs ldan du mas drangs te mkhar gyi 'gram rtsar sleb pa na gur nang du skyes bu dpa' bo du mas rmang rko ba sogs pa byed par gsal lo/ / bdun pa ni/ 'di dang sa 'og ral gri dang*/ shing rta rnams kyi rtsa 'grel la 'gyur mi mthun pa mang po dang*/ de la rten pa'i 'dod mi mthun pa mang zhing bzo byas lag khrid kyis bshad dgos pas shin tu dka' bar yod na'ang*/ 'dir mdor bsdus brjod na/ wa zhes lcags mda' mda' thung gi 'gro sa shing wa chu lta bu zheng sor drug pa/

srid lcags mda'i tshad kyi wa zhes pas bstan par 'dod pa yod kyang*/ da lta mda' thung byed pa ltar na/ mda'i tshad kyi ma nges kyi/ gzhu bo che gang bar nus pa'i tshad las smad du cung zad lhag pa dang bcas pa/ shing de'i smad kyi char lcags kyi dbyug pa gru bzhi sor drug pa rgya gram du btsugs pa ltar bshad kyang steng phyogs su btsugs na mda'i 'gro sa 'thog pas phyogs gzhan gsum du btsugs pa'i g.yas g.yon gnyis la gzhu'i chang bzung shor gyi steng nas skal ba bskyon de g.yo med du btags/ rgyab tu btsugs pa'i lcags kyi dbyug gu lag pas bzung nas gang 'dod du 'khyer ba'i lag cha byed/ shing de'i gzhu rgyud phyogs kyis rtse mor bug pa gru bzhi pa kha gdangs lcags kyi legs par gril ba gcig gshor zad mtshams kyi leb la gdod bug pa de la thur du zug pa'i bug pa zhig shing gi rtse nas stod pa'i lcags kyi dbyug gu gru bzhi gcig btsugs bug pa gru bzhi'i dbus nas zhugs te steng nas 'khrul shing du grags pa gzhu rgyud ston pa'i lcags kyi ra mgo'i 'dzub mo rtse gug pa nyis bshibs lta bu gcig rtsa ba phug ste bcug nas 'phrul mig gi bug pa che ba'i ma 'gram gyi nang du yang dbyug gu gru bzhi pa'i rtse mo bcug pa'i logs kyi phyi nang gnyis nas bug pa byas par lcags kyi dbyug gu mthe'u chung gi tshad sor gsum pa gcig gi mgo la lcags thag btags nas phur pa 'og ma a long g.yo ba dang bcas pas btags te mi 'gyur bar byas pa'i mthe'u chung gi rtse mo lta bu de bcug nas bsdams zin pa na/ gzhu bo che la rdog pa gtad pas legs par bkang ste rgyud mdzub mo la dkon/ mdzub dbrag tu mda'i ltong bcugagang 'dod du 'khyer te gnad du bsnun dgos par/ lcags kyi mthe'u chung ston pa na 'phrul shing 'gyel na go cha dang bcas pa'i glang chen lus po phug nas 'joms par 'gyur ro/

/ gnyis pa la/ pho brang bsrung bar ral gri'i 'phrul 'khor dang*/ rgyal rigs 'thab pa shing rta'i tshad do/ /dang po ni/ rgyal ba'i pho brang dang dmag gi sgar sgo lta bu gnod pa 'byung ba'i lam/ ngos gnyis g.yang sa'am rtsig pas chod pa lta bu'i sar pa dang po khru bzhi pa phru do'i spang dang ldan pa lta bu'i lam gyi srod phyogs gnyis su shing bzang po srid gru bzhi sboms mtho gru bzhi pa gnyis kyi khru do sa'i 'og tu btsugs khru do dong gi nang du rjen par 'then pa'i khru phyed do'i sar 'phrul shing bde blag tu 'khor bar nus pa'i gdang bu gcig btsugs de'i steng gi sor drug gi gnas su thag pa bzang po'i bcus phur brgyag pa'i 'ching lugs kyi shing gnyis bcings pa'i thag pa'i dbus su ral gri rnon po'i chang bzung bcug pa 'phrul shing la gzer gyi dgar/ de'i rtse nas btags pa'i thag pa zhig gis ral gri re zhig mi 'khor ba'i phyir du phyin ci log tu 'then nas ral gri'i rtse dang lhan cig steng du drangs te ral gri'i 'khor lo'i gshor lta bu zhig ma gtogs pa'i steng thams cad spang leb kyis g.yog te thog phug pa la sa cung zad kyang g.yogaspang leb gnyis kyi bar gyi gshor lta bu'i kha mtshams su ral gri'i rtse mo dang thag pa sten pa'i lcags leb chung ngu bzhag la/ spang leb bsnan pa na 'bud par 'gyur zhing de ma thag tu ral gri 'khor nas rkang pa brgya stong du gcod par bya'o/ /gnyis pa la mtshan nyid ni/ rtsa 'grel la rten/ lag khrid lta bus zhib tu bshad par bya la/ dbye ba la 'dren byed kyi sgo nas rta'i dang*/ glang po che'i shing rta gnyis te/ dang po'i 'phang lo khru phyed dang gsum pa srog shing la de bzhi ldab cung zad lhag dang bcas/ glang po che la gnyis ka nyis 'gyur/ 'dren byed kyi grangs kyi sgo nas rta glang gang yin kyang gsum dang lnga dang bdun gyis 'dren pa tsam mi mnyam pa'i dang*/

gnyis dang bzhi dang drug gis 'dren pa mnyam pa'i shing rta'o/ /mtshan nyid kyi sgo nas srog shing bzhi'i sna gnyis gnyis la 'khor lo bzhi bzhi bskon pas 'khor lo brgyad pa/ g.yul du phyir mi ldog pa'i shing rta chen po/ srog shing gnyis la 'khor lo bzhi pa nyams pa'i shing rta/ 'khor lo gcig pa lha rnams kyi shing rta sde bzhi gsungs so/ /bde bar spyod pa'i la/ ltad mo la 'gro ba'i don du khang bzang*/ dpyid kyi dga' ston gyi don du phyogs 'khor/ ldum ra bcu pa'i don du chu'i 'phrul 'khor ro/ /dang po la/ lha'i khang bzang brtsegs bzhi pa ni/ shing gi ka ba srid du khru nyi shu dang zheng du sor nyi shu pa bzhi sgyogs kyi rkang bzhi ltar gdangs bus bsgres pa ste/ 'og tu khru gang dang steng du khru gang dor ba'i bar gyi khru bco brgyad po la 'og ma khru drug dang*/ de nas lnga dang bzhi dang gsum gyi sa rnams su sgyogs shing ltar ngos mi mnyam pa ma yin par phyogs bzhi ka'i gdang bu rnams mnyam por yong ba byas nas btang bar bya ba'i shing sgroms kyi smad kyi cha la khru phyed dang bdun pa byas pa'i gdeng bu rnams kyi steng spang leb kyis byas pa'i thog lnga dang khang brtsegs bzhi par bshad la/ rgyal po rnams la ltad mo'i khang brtsegs ni rtse gsum par bshad pa ma gtogs tshad kyi gsal kha ma gsungs kyang snga ma la dpag nas shes par bya ste| rtse gsum po'i 'og gi mthil gyi thad kyi gdang bu so so'i phyi la bya 'dab lta bu bya ba'i rtsegs 'og ma la gdang bu khru gsum pa dang*/ gnyis pa'i rtseg ma la/ phyogs thams cad du khru gcig 'khor ba la spang leb kyis bkab pa bya bar shong 'gyur du byung yang*/ 'gyur gzhan du rtseg gnyis pa la khru do dang gsum pa la khru gcig gis skor bar bshad pas shong 'gyur gyi 'di rgya dpe ma dag pa'i skyon du gsal lo/ / gnyis pa ni/ bkod pa phal cher de dang 'dra ba la 'og bzhi glang po che'i shing rta'i tshad dang 'khor lo brgyad dang srog shing bzhi pa'i shing rta'i steng du khang brtsegs bya ba dang bya 'debs med pa'i 'khrul shing dang*/

lag pa dang*/ de dag la bu mo rnams 'khor ba'i bstan pa dang bcas pa zhig gsungs so/ / gsum pa ni/ ldum ra'i gnas mtho sar dma'i chu drangs pa'i phyir du/ shing la sogs pa byas pa'i sbubs 'khyog po zhig byed pa yin la/ de yang ldum ra'i phyogs kyi sbubs drang po la khru bzhi'i tshad dang steng nas chu blug pa'i phyir du dkyil du bug pa yod pa cig la rtsa ba'i 'phrul 'khor zhes bya la/ 'di'i ldum ra phyogs kyi sne mo la bum pa'i dbyibs can lto ba che zhing mgrin pa ring ba zhig gi sbubs dang sbyar/ chu'i phyogs kyi sner mor/ spang gang yod las mi thung ba'i sbubs drang po zhig dang bsegs sbyor du sbubs rtse sprad pa thams cad rlung sang cung zad kyang med par bsdams/ bum pa'i bsham du yang sbubs kyi bug pa las mi che ba'i bug pa byas pas 'gags byed dam pos re zhig rlung chu mi 'chor bar bkagachu la gtad pa'i sbubs rtse chu zab mo'i nang du bcings te rlung mi 'khor bar byas nas/ rtsa ba'i 'phrul 'khor gyi steng gi bug pa nas chu blug ste sbubs thams cad legs par gang zhing drang rgyu'i cha dang dbyer med du 'dres pa na| steng gi bug pa dam du bkag cing bum pa'i bsham gyi bug pa 'gags byed de drag shul gyis ston pa na bum pa'i lto ba che ba'i rlung gis nus pas ji srid 'dod kyi bar du chu 'drongs nas 'dod pa'i bya ba bye par 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa bye brag 'dzam gling chung ngu'i gnas tshul la'ang spyi'i dang bye brag sham+bha la'i 'o*/ dang po ni/ chos mngon pa nas/ dbus nas byang du ri nag po dgu 'das pa na ri bo gangs can dang*/ de'i pha rol na spos ngad ldan pa'i ri bo ste de gnyis kyi bar na mtsho ma dros pa dang*/ de'i bar na shing 'dzam bu pṛk+ṣa dang*/ chu de la gaṅgā dang*/ pak+ṣu dang*/ sin+dhu dang*/ shī ta ste bzhi 'bab pa dang*/ de dag dang nye ba na/ ri gser gyi bya skyibs dang*/
